    A('Autodialer','One button, with the lead detail on screen.','Places the call, captures duration, starts the recording. Duration is what enforces the 20-second connect floor, which is what makes points safe to ship.'),
    A('Send the brochure','WhatsApp, one press.','Consent-checked. A customer who has withdrawn gets a refusal with the reason, not a silent failure.'),
    A('Send the price','WhatsApp.','Carries the date each price component was last confirmed.'),
    A('Send a quotation','WhatsApp or email.','Freezes the price and scheme versions live at that moment. A quotation that reprices itself later is worthless in a dispute.'),
    A('Add an alternative choice','A second vehicle on the same enquiry.','Its own brochure, price and quotation. Common on a real floor and currently unrecorded anywhere.'),
    A('EMI calculator','Inline, never leaves the call.','Bank, tenure, rate, processing fee, and the date the rate was confirmed. Rates come from a maintained table refreshed monthly and approved by a human, never inferred by a model: a rate quoted to a customer is a commitment.'),
    A('Car availability','Approximate days if booked today.','Approximate, and it says so. Sales sees the exact allocation. Until the DMS read strategy is settled, allocation is entered by the sales admin.'),
    A('Bay availability','Approximate service window.','Approximate only. The service advisor confirms the appointment, because only he knows the work involved.')]),
   N('My enquiries','built','The whole book, at every stage.',
    'Today is the morning; this is the year. Different job, same row.',[
    A('Stage chips','Filter to one of nine stages.','New, Assigned, Contacted, Meeting, Test drive, Quotation, Negotiation, Booked, Delivered. Meeting replaces Qualified because it is what a floor actually says. Retail is not a stage: it is a delivery chain step, and modelling chain steps as stages is the error that produced twelve stages before.'),
    A('Row','Opens the record.','Goes to Enquiry record.'),
    A('Call','Opens the console.','Available on every row, not only due ones.')]),
   N('Enquiry record','built','Everything that ever happened to one enquiry.',
    'The evidence. There is no edit control anywhere, and not because it is hidden: UPDATE and DELETE are revoked at the database.',[
    A('Activity ledger','Every event, newest first, with its actor.','A human actor and System never look the same. A decision and an automatic act carry different weight in a dispute.'),
    A('Call this customer','The only action on the screen.','Goes to Log a call. Reading a record never changes it.')]),
   N('Search','built','Phone first, from four digits.',
    'Every inbound call starts here. Names are unreliable across three scripts; a number is a number.',[
    A('Search box','Phone, then name, then enquiry number.','Results use the same standard row as every other screen.'),
    A('Filters','Stage, Source, Model, Status.','Kept in a separate panel. Typing and narrowing are different intents.'),
    A('No match','Offers to file the enquiry.','Goes to File an enquiry. The miss is the most valuable moment on this screen: someone new is on the phone.')]),
   N('Add enquiry','built','Capture and qualify. Renamed from File an enquiry.',
    'Two stages on one screen. Stage 1 saves in four fields so nothing is ever lost on a live call. Stage 2 qualifies, saving as it goes. A twenty-field form on a live call means the telecaller fills it from memory afterwards, and the data then looks complete and is partly invented.',[
    A('Stage 1 · four fields','Phone, name, model interest, source.','Saves immediately. The enquiry exists and has an owner from this point.'),
    A('Stage 2 · vehicle','Variant, colour, alternative choice.','The alternative choice can be sent to the customer as its own brochure and price.'),
    A('Stage 2 · intent','Expected booking date, expected delivery date.',''),
    A('Stage 2 · buyer type','First time, additional, replacement, exchange.','Controlled list. It changes which questions follow.'),
    A('Stage 2 · exchange','Car to exchange, evaluation needed, date, showroom or customer place.','Feeds the used car evaluator queue.'),
    A('Stage 2 · meeting','Showroom visit or home visit, with date and time.','Creates the commitment and its deadline.'),
    A('Stage 2 · test drive','Needed, preferred date.',''),
    A('Stage 2 · finance','Needed, bank preference, EMI calculated inline.','The rate table is shown with the date each rate was confirmed.'),
    A('Phone · first field','Checks for a duplicate as you type.','A match offers the existing record instead of creating a second one. One customer, one record, across every department.'),
    A('Model and Source','Controlled lists, never free text.','Both end up in a GROUP BY. That is the test for every field in the product.'),
    A('Branch','Sets which rooftop owns it.','Decides which working hours govern the clock. The wrong branch means the wrong deadline and the wrong person blamed.'),
    A('Add enquiry','Creates the lead.','Assignment runs by the chosen mode. The lead appears in someone Today, or in a branch pool.')]),
   N('Notifications','built','Only what needs this person.','',[
    A('Any row','Opens the enquiry.','Every notification states why it was sent. One that cannot say why should not have been sent.'),
    A('Cannot be switched off','Two of them.','Lead assigned to you, and commitment due.')]),
   N('My profile','built','What the system believes about you.','',[
    A('Working hours','The branch hours, day by day.','Read only. Set by the dealer admin.'),
    A('Why they are here','They explain the clock.','A lead arriving at 21:40 starts its clock at the next open, and the delay is recorded against the branch, not you.')]),
   N('My score','p7','Designed, not built.',
    'Points need call duration to enforce the 20-second connect floor. Duration needs telephony. Shipping a score before its anti-gaming control exists teaches a floor to game it.',[
    A('Base points','Test drive 8, visit 5, quotation 4, callback 2, postponed 1.','Dealer-configurable rows, not code. Every scoring outcome also demands a fact.'),
    A('Difficulty multiplier','Hot 1.0, warm 1.5, cold 2.5, very cold 3.5.','Computed at assignment and frozen. Hidden from the executive. On raw points the person taking easy leads looks best; weighted, he is worst.'),
    A('Anti-gaming rules','Six moves, six controls.','Under 20 seconds earns no points and no penalty. Closures demand a fact. Bands are never manager-set. Waivers count against the manager who granted them.'),
    A('Points are not targets','Two numbers, never merged.','Points measure behaviour, which you control. Targets measure outcome, which you partly do not. Merged, the combined number is gamed within six weeks.'),
    A('The score wallet','Points animate into it as they are earned.','Positive in settled green, negative in overdue red. It shows the movement, never a total that jumps: a figure that changes with no explanation beside it is a number nobody trusts.'),
    A('The monthly list','Every point earned and every point lost.','Each row names the action that caused it. A score you cannot audit is a score you cannot argue with, and one people will assume is wrong.'),
    A('Negative points','Only three things.','Not logging an outcome at all, letting a first response lapse with no attempt, and a commitment missed with no note. The rule is: penalise concealment, never outcomes. Penalise a lost lead and you get fake dispositions, which is how not-interested reached 31% of all closures.'),
    A('Every penalty has a safe path','A way to do the right thing and avoid it.','A penalty with no safe path is a pressure, and a pressure produces the behaviour it was meant to stop.')]),
   N('The daily welcome','p7','Once a day, on the landing screen, dismissible.',
    'Not a pop-up over the screen and never blocking the queue. Three parts: what was genuinely good, what today holds, and one line of encouragement.',[
    A('What was good','Drawn from yesterday.','"You closed 19 of 24. Best on the floor."'),
    A('What today holds','The queue, named.','"6 late, 12 due. Meera Joshi first."'),
    A('On a bad day','It must not invent a positive.','A person who had a bad day and is told they were wonderful learns the product does not tell the truth, and then disbelieves the rest of it. It says something true and forward-looking instead.')]),
   N('Lead score','p7','A score on the enquiry itself, not the person.',
    'Built from the call transcripts, the messages sent, and the activity on the lead, updating until conversion.',[
    A('It shows its reasons','Always, next to the number.','"Rising: asked about finance twice, requested a test drive, mentioned a deadline." A number with no reasons is a number a floor stops believing in a fortnight, and then they stop believing the rest of the product.'),
    A('It never overrides a human','It ranks and it flags.','It does not close a lead, does not reassign, and does not change a difficulty band.'),
    A('It depends on transcription','So it depends on telephony.','It arrives after recordings, not before.')])]),

  N('Digital desk manager','spec','The telecalling floor manager. Lands on Floor today.','',[
   N('Floor today','spec','His team today, not his own book.','',[
    A('Five headline figures','Due, late, unassigned, median response, contacted in 24h.','Scope is his team. Not the branch, not the group.'),
    A('By person table','Due, late, logged, median response, load.','Four columns chosen so effort can be told from outcome. Load is a bar because a manager at 10am compares shapes.'),
    A('Exception card','Names the problem and the likely cause.','Offers both fixes: move the work, or fix the data that caused the bad assignment. A card with no action is a report.'),
    A('Breaching now','Windows closing in under 10 minutes.','The only list on the floor still recoverable. Goes to Assignment.')]),
   N('Assignment','spec','Where unowned work gets an owner.','',[
    A('The rule, stated on screen','Round robin weighted by load, inside working hours.','Visible because a floor will otherwise invent one. Arguing about the rule is cheaper than arguing about fairness.'),
    A('Assign all by the rule','One press for the whole queue.','A suggestion, not a decision. Automation that cannot be overridden gets worked around.'),
    A('Override','Requires a typed reason.','Writes a row naming the manager, the reason and both telecallers. Not to police him: to make a pattern visible.')]),
   N('Team scores','p7','Raw against weighted, with both ranks.',
    'Depends on the points engine. Not in this release.',[
    A('The comparison table','Same five people, ordered two ways.','Showing only weighted looks manipulated. Showing both makes the claim checkable.'),
    A('Difficulty mix','What proportion of each person leads were hot, warm, cold.','The audit trail for the weighted score, and it prompts the better question: why did that happen.'),
    A('Waivers you granted','Every penalty this manager waived.','Waiving is legitimate. Selective waiving corrupts a score, so it is counted against the grantor and visible to his principal.')]),
   N('Why we lose','spec','419 losses turned into four actionable things.','',[
    A('Reason, count, and the fact it demanded','Seven controlled reasons.','"Price" tells you nothing. "We quoted 9.4, they had 9.21" tells you the gap is consistent, which makes it a scheme problem.'),
    A('The unreachable line','Fell from 31% of closures to 3.6%.','Nothing changed about the customers. The disposition began demanding six attempts, checked against the ledger.')]),
   N('Response times','spec','The number that predicts every other number.','',[
    A('By source','Because a Meta lead and a walk-in are not the same job.','A single median hides everything. Split, it shows one campaign at 2h14 and another at 19 minutes.'),
    A('Never contacted','441, worth about 39 lakh.','Goes to the principal. A floor manager cannot turn a campaign off.'),
    A('Exclusions, published','Out of hours, outages, consent withdrawn.','Stated rather than silently dropped. The exclusion count is itself watched.')]),
   N('Sources','spec','Which campaigns the floor can actually absorb.','',[
    A('Volume against capacity','Enquiries per source against contact rate.','This is where cheap leads that nobody calls become visible.')])]),

  N('Marketing head','spec','Read only. Campaign performance, no floor detail.','',[
   A('Source performance','Cost per lead and cost per booking.','Read only. He cannot reassign work or open an enquiry record.'),
   A('Creative performance','Which advert produced a delivered car.','The moat: Advito placed the spend, so spend and delivered cars sit in one database.')])]),
 // ============ SALES ============
 N('Sales','built','Four seats. Partially built.',
  'Nine stages: New, Assigned, Contacted, Meeting, Test drive, Quotation, Negotiation, Booked, Delivered. The ladder is shown on every row and at the top of every record, with the current stage lit.',[
  N('Sales consultant','built','Lands on My enquiries.','',[
   A('My enquiries','The book, nine stage chips.','Same standard row as telecalling. Nothing is relearned between departments.'),
   A('Enquiry record','The ledger for one enquiry.','Same screen the telecaller sees, scoped to his own records.'),
   A('Log a visit','Showroom visit, test drive, quotation.','Same disposition mechanics as a call. Writes to the same ledger.'),
   A('Quotation','Freezes the price and scheme versions live at that moment.','A quotation that reprices itself later is worthless in a dispute.'),
   A('Awaiting delivery','Bookings with no car yet.','Read only for him. The delivery chain is another department job.'),
   A('Search','Phone first.','Shared screen, own scope.')]),
  N('Sales team leader','spec','Team scope. Approvals.','',[
   A('Team pipeline','His team book, not his own.','Scope is team.'),
   A('Discount approvals','Requests above his executives limit.','Every approval writes a row with the amount and the reason. Feeds discount leakage on the principal screen.'),
   A('Lead difficulty','Visible to him, hidden from executives.','Visible, it becomes an argument about the assignment.')]),
  N('Sales GM or VP','spec','Department head. Branch and brand scope.','',[
   A('Pipeline by branch','Every rooftop he owns.','Process measures, not outcome. A comparison on cars sold becomes an argument about market conditions.'),
   A('Stage conversion','Where the funnel leaks.','440 never contacted was found here.'),
   A('Cost per booking','By source and by campaign.','Shared with the principal. No product margin.')]),
  N('Sales admin','spec','Task queue seat. One list, large rows, one button.',
   'Not a lesser product: the right one. A clerk who does one thing forty times a day will never open an eleven-item menu.',[
   A('Paperwork queue','What needs a form today.','One action per row.')])]),

 // ============ DELIVERY ============
 N('Delivery','p5','The gap nobody has filled. Every competitor stops at the booking.',
  'Twelve steps, three parallel lanes, four external parties. The promised date is the longest path through it.',[
  N('Delivery coordinator','p5','Lands on the delivery queue.','',[
   A('Delivery queue','Every booking not yet handed over.','The first screen worth demonstrating after telecalling.'),
   A('The three lanes','Finance and insurance · vehicle and registration · preparation.','Run in parallel. The promise is the longest path, recomputed whenever any step moves.'),
   A('Mark a step complete','Advances one lane.','Recomputes the promised date. If it moves, writes a new DeliveryPromise row.'),
   A('Block a step','Requires a reason and a kind.','Internal or external. External blocks are excluded from promise accuracy, and the exclusion count is itself reported so a branch marking everything external is visible.'),
   A('Override the date','Requires a reason.','A date typed with nothing behind it must not be possible.')]),
  N('RTO clerk','p5','Task queue seat. One list, one button.','',[
   A('Registrations due','Chassis, customer, what is needed.','He does one thing many times. He gets one screen.')]),
  N('Accessories desk','p5','Task queue seat.','',[
   A('Fitments due','What to fit, by vehicle.','Blocks the preparation lane if late.')]),
  N('Pre-delivery inspection','p5','Task queue seat.','',[
   A('PDI checklist','Per vehicle.','The last gate before handover.')]),
  N('The customer tracker','p5','One page, no login, a signed link.',
   'It names a human, never shows an internal step name, and never hides a slip. Telling a customer the truth on the 14th is survivable; his discovering it on the 18th is not.',[
   A('Where is my car','Plain language status.','Link expires at delivery plus 30 days.'),
   A('Commercially','This is the referral engine.','Status messages are WhatsApp utility messages, roughly seven times cheaper than marketing messages.')])]),

 // ============ SERVICE ============
 N('Service','p5','The profit centre. Four seats.','',[
  N('Service advisor','p5','Lands on his bays.','',[
   A('Job cards today','Against promised times.','Promise accuracy is his measure, not revenue.'),
   A('Flag an upgrade','Customer looks ready for a new vehicle.','Goes to sales as a potential lead. He never sees the pipeline, the model, the value, or who is handling it. Information flows out of service, never in.'),
   A('Renewals in my bays','Only cars physically with him.','Scoped to his own bays, deliberately.')]),
  N('Service telecaller','p5','Booking and follow-up.','',[
   A('Service due','By last visit and mileage.','Separate queue from sales telecalling. Same mechanics.')]),
  N('Workshop manager','p5','Bay capacity and throughput.','',[
   A('Bay utilisation','Revenue per bay-hour.','The measure that matters here.'),
   A('Recurring failures','Same defect, same model.','Requires the shared defect taxonomy. Controlled from the first job card or this is unbuildable at any price.')]),
  N('Service GM or VP','p5','Department head.','',[
   A('Retention','Customers returning for the second and third service.','The number that predicts the used-car pipeline three years out.')])]),

 // ============ INSURANCE ============
 N('Insurance and renewals','p5','Insurance, warranty, RSA, AMC. Driven by expiry.','',[
  N('Insurance executive','p5','Lands on expiring policies.','',[
   A('Expiring in 30 days','By customer and vehicle.','Sorted by expiry, not by value.'),
   A('Ranked recommendation','Top three, with reasons. No margin figure anywhere.','OPEN QUESTION for Prem. He has asked for ranking by best margin with the margin hidden. The earlier ruling was to rank on merit. Hiding the number does not solve it: the customer sees the premium, and if the top pick is always the dearest he works it out in three calls. Proposed compromise: rank on a blend of claim settlement ratio, cashless cover at our own workshop, price stability and margin as one input of four.'),
   A('Lapse recovery','Already expired.','Still worth calling. Higher difficulty band.')]),
  N('Insurance GM or VP','p5','Department head.','',[
   A('Renewal conversion','By product and by branch.','No margin. That is dealer admin only.')])]),

 // ============ USED CAR ============
 N('Used car','p5','Valuation, stock, retail.','',[
  N('Evaluator','p5','Lands on valuations due.','',[
   A('Valuation','Condition, history, market.','Service history from the shared vehicle record settles it to within about 3%. That is only possible because one Vehicle is shared across departments.'),
   A('Stock ageing','Days in stock against the floor-plan rate.','45 days default, dealer-configurable.')]),
  N('Used car sales','p5','Retail of the stock.','',[
   A('Available stock','What can be sold today.','Same nine stages, same row.')])]),

 // ============ SMALLER DEPARTMENTS ============
 N('Accessories','p5','Attachment at the point of sale, and fitment.','',[
  A('Attach rate by model','What actually sells with what.','Feeds the attached gross figure inside expected value.'),
  A('Fitment queue','Shared with the delivery preparation lane.','A late fitment moves a delivery promise.')]),

 N('Driving school','p5','A separate small business inside the dealership.','',[
  A('Enrolments and batches','Same enquiry mechanics.','A driving school enquiry is a future car buyer. Same customer record.')]),

 N('Fleet','p5','Corporate and bulk.','',[
  A('One deal, many cars','A twelve-vehicle order.','This is why deals closed and cars delivered are two different numbers. A screen treating them as one reports a fleet month as a retail collapse.')]),

 // ============ MANAGEMENT ============
 N('Management','spec','Branch head and dealer principal.','',[
  N('Branch head','spec','One rooftop. Branch scope.','',[
   A('Branch decisions','What needs him today.','Same card mechanics as the principal, scoped to his rooftop.'),
   A('Branch P and L','His own only.','Salary and employee cost are never visible below the principal.'),
   A('His floor comparison','Against other branches, on process.','First response, contact rate, promise accuracy. Not cars sold.')]),
  N('Dealer principal','spec','Every rooftop. Lands on Decisions.','',[
   N('Decisions','spec','Seven to nine cards a morning, each with a rupee figure.',
    'A principal with forty cards reads none of them. The cut is by value and by whether he can still change the outcome.',[
    A('Act','Press the action on the card.','The card closes. A row is written naming him, the action and the amount.'),
    A('Acknowledge with a date','It returns on that date.','Not before, unless one of four triggers fires: the amount grows past 1.5x, a single branch starts breaching alone, a chain doubles, or it is the third consecutive deferral.'),
    A('Delegate','Moves to a named person.','Stays visible to him. A footer counts what he actioned that is still unresolved.'),
    A('Do nothing','Allowed.','There is no dismiss button anywhere. The age of an unexited card is counted and reported, which is how you catch a screen being read and ignored.'),
    A('A walked-up card','Cannot be acknowledged again.','Act or delegate. That closes indefinite deferral of the same problem.')]),
   A('What bookings cost','Cost per booking by source and campaign.','The screen that justifies the invoice, and the only thing on the programme a competitor cannot copy.'),
   A('The delivery pipeline','Booked, no car delivered yet.','Eleven customers who have paid and have no car. Money committed and a promise made, and no principal has ever been shown it as one figure.'),
   A('Compare branches','On process, never outcome.','The reason is printed on the screen, because somebody asks in the first meeting.'),
   A('Why we lose','By reason, with the fact each demanded.','41 to one rival, median gap 19,000, consistent. Consistency makes it a scheme problem.'),
   A('Approvals','Discounts above the branch limit.','Every approval writes a row.'),
   A('People and access','Who can see what.','Includes the Advito audit log: every entry a support person made in his tenant, with their name.'),
   A('Incentives','Computed and exported.','Arth never pays anybody and never touches a bank account.')])]),

 // ============ DEALER ADMIN ============
 N('Dealer admin','spec','The dealer own configuration seat.','',[
  A('Working hours and shifts','Per branch, per day.','Item one in the build order. Every clock in the product runs through it.'),
  A('First response targets and SLAs','Per source.','A portal lead and a walk-in are not the same job.'),
  A('Escalation ladders','Four rungs.','Executive, team leader at 2h, branch head at 6h, principal at 24h with a rupee value attached, because that is what makes a principal act rather than note.'),
  A('Points weights and difficulty bands','Within bounds.','Bounded, and every change is logged.'),
  A('Prices and schemes','Model catalogue.','Monthly refresh proposed by an agent, approved by a human.'),
  A('Figure visibility','Per figure, per role.','Two rows are never configurable: salary is never visible below the principal, and margin is dealer admin only.'),
  A('Product margin','Currently the only seat that sees it.','OPEN QUESTION for Prem: he has asked for money to sit with the dealer principal, grantable downward. The two roles are often the same person. When they are not, this matters, and it needs a ruling.'),
  A('Grant a figure to a role','Cost per lead, cost per conversion, margin.','Every grant writes a row and is reversible.'),
  A('Login methods','Mobile and OTP, or username and password.','Forgot password notifies the manager, who sets a temporary credential. The person must change it on first use: a manager never knows a live password.'),
  A('WhatsApp notifications','Captured at setup or in a profile.','The person chooses which categories. Utility messages, roughly seven times cheaper than marketing ones.'),
  A('Price master','Ex-showroom, per variant.','The dealer own figures are the only authoritative version. RTO, insurance and logistics rules are maintained by Advito per state. Refresh is proposed monthly by an agent and approved by a human, never applied silently.')]),
 // ============ ADVITO ============
 N('Advito','spec','Three separate surfaces, not one admin panel.',
  'Unscoped and recorded as such: it needs its own work order. A vendor who can enter a client data silently should not be trusted with it.',[
  N('Advito Master','spec','Founder. The business behind the product.','',[
   A('Tenants','Every dealer group, with adoption.','Adoption is the churn predictor, not satisfaction. A dealer whose service team has not signed in for nine days is a cancellation in slow motion.'),
   A('Plans and billing','Core, Growth, Scale.','Plans are rows, not code. Existing contracts are pinned to the version they signed. Rates above 20% off need a second approval and are logged.'),
   A('Cost to serve','Per tenant: messages, minutes, transcription, lookups, storage, support hours.','Without it nobody would know that a 20% discount turned one customer into a 3% gross margin.'),
   A('Provisioning','The seven onboarding steps.','Step 3, working hours, is the one that stalls and looks the dullest. Nothing goes live until it is done for every branch.'),
   A('Catalogues','Stages, dispositions, lost reasons, chain steps.','Copied per tenant at provisioning, never referenced across tenants. A dealer changing his list must not affect another dealer.'),
   A('No customer data','Deliberate.','A platform admin has no business reading a dealer enquiries, and gets no shortcut into a tenant.')]),
  N('Advito Support','spec','The most constrained seat on the platform.','',[
   A('Tickets','Work is scoped to a ticket.','Access expires with it. Standing access is the thing that leaks.'),
   A('Entering a tenant','A banner that never disappears.','Names the tenant, the ticket, the expiry, and that the dealer can see everything. A person who cannot forget they are inside a customer account behaves differently.'),
   A('Configuration','Full access. This is the job.','Working hours, lists, seats, visibility.'),
   A('Customer name and phone','Masked by default.','Unmasking is possible and writes a row. Making it impossible would push support to ask the dealer to send data over WhatsApp, which is worse.'),
   A('Enquiry content and notes','Never visible.','Not needed to fix configuration.'),
   A('Pricing, margin, cost to serve','Never visible.','Commercial. Founder only.'),
   A('My audit trail','The same table the dealer sees.','Not a copy, not a summary. The same rows on their screen. An audit log with a vendor-only view is not an audit log.'),
   A('Cannot delete anything','In any tenant, ever.','Append-only by database privilege.')]),
  N('Advito Onboarding','spec','Sets a dealer up end to end before handover.',
   'A separate account from Master, deliberately. Master holds pricing, margin and cost to serve and is the founder alone.',[
   A('The seven provisioning steps','Brands, positions, hours, prices, sources, WhatsApp, existing data.','Step 3, working hours, is the one that stalls and looks the dullest. Nothing goes live until it is done for every branch.'),
   A('OEM catalogue load','Brand chosen, models and variants follow.','Two-wheeler, four-wheeler or commercial. Vehicle type drives the delivery chain variant: EV adds two steps, commercial adds three, two-wheeler removes one.'),
   A('Sees configuration, never customer data','Same rule as support.','Every action appears in the dealer own audit log.')]),
  N('Advito Engineering','spec','Health and errors. No customer data in the clear.','',[
   A('Platform health','Errors, latency, queue depth.','No dealer data.'),
   A('Instruments','Nightly reconciliation, orphan sweep, scale thresholds, third-party watch.','Reconciliation reports disagreements and never silently corrects. A silent auto-correction destroys the evidentiary value of a ledger.')])]),

 // ============ CROSS-CUTTING ============
 N('Shared across every department','spec','Not a workspace. The layer that makes this one system.','',[
  N('The record layer','built','One Customer, one Vehicle, one Household.','',[
   A('One customer record','Shared by every department.','This is why a service advisor can see a renewal and an evaluator can price an exchange to within 3%. Every module keeping its own copy is the thing that breaks first.'),
   A('Ownership','Attaches to activities, never to the customer.','A salesperson does not own a household for life.'),
   A('Household','p6 · needs Service and Household.','"His wife has serviced a Swift here six times" is Phase 6. Until then a weaker true line from data already held.'),
   A('Consent','One row per purpose. Never one tick.','Sales enquiry, service reminders, insurance renewal and offers are four separate permissions. A customer who agreed to service reminders has not agreed to a festive broadcast, and the system refuses to send it.')]),
  N('The accountability layer','built','The ledger, the clocks, the escalations.',
   'This is the product. Everything else is a workspace that writes to it.',[
   A('The ledger','Append-only by privilege.','UPDATE and DELETE revoked from the application role. A correction is a new row. A column that must be written after insert cannot exist on such a table.'),
   A('The clock','Working hours gate all of it.','A lead arriving at 21:40 starts its clock next working morning, and the delay is recorded against the branch rather than the person.'),
   A('Escalation','Four rungs, all configurable.','Executive to team leader at 2h, branch head at 6h, principal at 24h with a rupee value attached.'),
   A('The audit log','Access, permission and export events.','A separate ledger from lead activity. Visible to the dealer, including everything Advito does.')]),
  N('The money layer','p6','Attribution and cost.','',[
   A('Click identifiers captured','Already live from Phase 4.','Cannot be reconstructed later. This is why it was built before the screens that use it.'),
   A('Cost per booking','Marketing cost, exact.','Never merged with total cost per booking, which adds salaries and rent and is directional. Allocate rent and the argument about the allocation destroys the first number, which was solid.'),
   A('Conversions fed back','Delivered cars to Meta and Google.','We do not only measure the spend, we improve it. Cancelling Arth makes the same ad budget worse.')]),
  N('The Exception Cockpit','p7','Deferred by ruling. DDL issued, awaiting authorisation.','',[
   A('Nine aggregate card types','Identity is type times scope, never membership.','A card is the same card whether three branches or five are inside it.'),
   A('ExceptionEvent','Append-only. Closure is a new row.','A closure is never a decision, it is an observation that a condition ended. Enforced by a database check: only SYSTEM may close.')])]),

 // ============ NEVER ============
 N('Deliberately never built','never','Recorded so each request is answered once rather than re-argued every quarter.','',[
  A('Dealer management system','Manufacturer-mandated, five-year build.','An incumbent the dealer cannot remove. We show which jobs wait on which part, which the DMS cannot.'),
  A('Accounting or payroll','Regulated, with statutory filings.','We compute what is payable and export it. Arth never pays anybody and never touches a bank account. An Accounts seat exists, read only, to see the computations and take the export.'),
  A('Full HR','Beyond employment state and handover.','A leaver triggers a structured handover of their open work, and that is the whole HR surface. Requested as a department; recorded as a separate product conversation with a separate cost, not a department in this tree.'),
  A('Spare parts inventory','The DMS owns it.','We show the dependency, not the stock.'),
  A('Body shop and claims','A distinct workflow with distinct counterparties.','A separate product if ever.'),
  A('Telematics','Hardware, and the manufacturer owns the vehicle data.',''),
  A('Our own telephony or speech to text','Licensed businesses with their own regulators.','We integrate.'),
  A('A native mobile app, this cycle','Store review on every release, two codebases.','Responsive web. Revisit when push or camera becomes essential.')])
]);
let SEL=null;
const BADGE={built:['Built','b-built'],spec:['Specified','b-spec'],p5:['Phase 5','b-p5'],
 p6:['Phase 6','b-p6'],p7:['Later','b-p7'],never:['Never','b-never'],act:['','']};
function render(node,parent,path){
 const li=document.createElement('li');
 const d=document.createElement('div');
 const kind=node.s==='act'?'act':(path.length<=1?'dep':(node.c.length?'role':'act'));
 d.className='nd '+kind;
 const hasKids=node.c.length>0;
 const b=BADGE[node.s]||['',''];
 d.innerHTML=`<span class="tw ${hasKids?'':'leaf'}">${hasKids?'+':'·'}</span>
  <span class="lb"><span class="t">${node.l}</span></span>
  ${b[0]?`<span class="bg ${b[1]}">${b[0]}</span>`:''}`;
 li.appendChild(d);
 let ul=null;
 if(hasKids){
  ul=document.createElement('ul'); ul.style.display='none';
  node.c.forEach(c=>render(c,ul,path.concat(node.l)));
  li.appendChild(ul);
 }
 d.onclick=e=>{
  e.stopPropagation();
  if(hasKids){const open=ul.style.display!=='none';
   ul.style.display=open?'none':'block'; d.querySelector('.tw').textContent=open?'+':'\u2212';}
  document.querySelectorAll('.nd.sel').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('sel'));
  d.classList.add('sel'); SEL=node; side(node,path,ul,d);
 };
 d._ul=ul; d._node=node; d._path=path;
 parent.appendChild(li);
}
function side(node,path,ul,el){
 const b=BADGE[node.s]||['',''];
 const kids=node.c.length?`<h4>Inside this (${node.c.length})</h4><div class="kids">`+
  node.c.map((c,i)=>`<a data-i="${i}">${c.l}</a>`).join('')+'</div>':'';
 document.getElementById('side').innerHTML=`
  <div class="eye">${b[0]||'Action'}</div><div class="rl"></div>
  <h2>${node.l}</h2>
  <div class="path">${path.concat(node.l).join(' &rsaquo; ')}</div>
  <div class="what">${node.w}</div>
  ${node.g?`<h4>What happens, and where it goes</h4><div class="${node.s==='act'?'goes':'why'}">${node.g}</div>`:''}
  ${kids}`;
 document.querySelectorAll('#side .kids a').forEach(a=>{
  a.onclick=()=>{ if(ul){ul.style.display='block'; el.querySelector('.tw').textContent='\u2212';}
   const child=ul.children[+a.dataset.i].querySelector('.nd'); child.click();
   child.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});};});
}
function setAll(open){
 document.querySelectorAll('.tree ul').forEach(u=>{if(!u.classList.contains('root'))u.style.display=open?'block':'none';});
 document.querySelectorAll('.tree .tw').forEach(t=>{if(t.textContent!=='\u00b7')t.textContent=open?'\u2212':'+';});
}
const root=document.createElement('ul'); root.className='root';
render(TREE,root,[]); document.getElementById('tree').appendChild(root);
root.querySelector('.nd').click();
document.querySelectorAll('.tree>ul>li>ul').forEach(u=>{u.style.display='block';
 const t=u.parentElement.querySelector('.tw'); if(t)t.textContent='\u2212';});
</script></body></html>

<div class="cover">
  <div class="mark"><span class="rule"></span><b>arth</b><span class="dev">अर्थ</span></div>
  <h1>Project Configuration Book</h1>
  <p class="lede">How the programme is governed, how the environments are built, what is configurable and by whom, what each integration needs, and what to do when something breaks.</p>
  <div class="meta">
    <div>Edition<b>01 · 21 August 2026</b></div>
    <div>Owner<b>Advito Global</b></div>
    <div>Custodian<b>IT Director</b></div>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="toc">

    <li><a href="#s10">The instruments</a></li>
    <div class="part">Part III · The configuration surface</div>
    <li><a href="#s11">Who may change what</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s12">Tenant provisioning</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s13">The seed catalogue</a></li>

    <div class="part">Part V · Operations</div>
    <li><a href="#s17">Runbooks</a></li>
    <li><a href="#s18">Backup, restore and retention</a></li>

<!-- 01 -->
<section id="s1">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 01</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>How to read this book</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Every entry carries a provenance mark. This matters more than the content, because a configuration book that cannot distinguish what is decided from what is assumed will be quoted as fact and act as one.</p>

  <div class="legend">
    <div><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span><br>A product decision. Binding. Changing it needs a written amendment.</div>
    <div><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span><br>Stated to me by the IT Director or the development team. Accurate as reported; not independently checked by me.</div>
    <div><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span><br>My assumption or a normal practice. <b>Treat as a question, not an instruction.</b></div>
    <div><span class="pill p-open">Open</span><br>Nobody has decided. Named here so it is not discovered late.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="warn"><b>I have not seen the repository.</b> Everything in Part II is marked accordingly. Where a cell says <em>Not verified</em>, the IT Director should replace it with the real value rather than let mine stand. That is the intended use of this book: a frame with honest gaps, filled by the person who can see the system.</div>

  <p>Three findings against me on this programme were each a case of asserting rather than checking: a control that did not exist, a colour rule contradicting the Book, and a token that already existed. <b>The marks above are the fix.</b></p>
</section>

<!-- 02 -->
<section id="s2">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 02</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Who decides what</h2>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Party</th><th>Decides</th><th>Cannot decide</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Prem Kumar</b><br><span style="color:var(--n60)">Product owner</span></td>
      <td>Commercial direction, pricing, what is in scope, schema authorisations, anything with a rupee cost</td>
      <td>Nothing is above him. But he authorises in his own words, never through a proxy</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>IT Director</b></td>
      <td>Schema, migrations, infrastructure, work orders, what is in a cycle, query cost, all Part II of this book</td>
      <td>Product intent. What a screen is for</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Product Engineering</b><br><span style="color:var(--n60)">this role</span></td>
      <td>What a screen does, who sees what, workflow, the meaning of a figure, the disposition and stage sets</td>
      <td>Anything in the repository. Anything Brand governs</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Brand</b></td>
      <td>Colour, typography, voice, the mark, the component set</td>
      <td>Workflow, access, data</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Development team</b></td>
      <td>Implementation, structure, tooling, sequencing within a work order</td>
      <td>Product decisions. When a specification is ambiguous, ask rather than choose</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="dark"><span class="eyebrow">The rule that has held all programme</span>
    <b>A reviewer cannot approve his own submission.</b> A schema change goes to the IT Director for review, then to Prem in writing, and nothing is authored until Prem answers in his own words. This was tested once when authorisation lines arrived signed by the reviewer, and it held.</div>

  <h3>When two parties disagree</h3>
  <p>Product intent is settled by the Product Book. Implementation by the Build Specification. Visual by the Brand System. <b>Where a working document and a book disagree, the book governs.</b> Amendments are written, never verbal, and are issued by the party who owns the area.</p>
</section>

<!-- 03 -->
<section id="s3">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 03</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>The standing rules</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Accumulated from live findings. Each exists because something went wrong once.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Rule</th><th>Origin</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Rule 1 · Schema changes are reviewed, then authorised in writing</b><br>IT Director reviews, Prem authorises, nothing authored before</td>
      <td>Standing since the programme began</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>The four labels</b><br>Every assertion about the system carries <code>SCHEMA</code>, <code>WORK ORDER</code>, <code>PROTOTYPE SPEC ONLY</code> or <code>NOT VERIFIED</code></td>
      <td>Two controls were asserted that did not exist</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Read the palette before proposing a token</b><br>A measurement can say a pairing fails. It cannot say the failure is already recorded and answered</td>
      <td>A token was proposed that already existed</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>A safeguard whose safe path does not exist is a pressure</b></td>
      <td>A hard rule with no legitimate exit generates an illegitimate one</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>A threshold about human behaviour is set from real behaviour</b><br>First pilot month, never invented in advance</td>
      <td>Applied three times: the amber threshold, the unknown rate, and the cockpit instruments</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Fail toward visibility</b><br>An access check fails closed. A suppression fails open</td>
      <td>An access check failing closed protects the dealer; a suppression failing closed hides money from him</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Report, never silently correct</b><br>Reconciliation reports disagreements and does not fix them</td>
      <td>A silent auto-correction destroys the evidentiary value of a ledger</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Configuration, not code</b><br>Stages, dispositions, chain steps, plans and thresholds are rows</td>
      <td>If adding the third brand needs a migration, the third brand is never onboarded</td></tr>
  </table>
</section>

<!-- 04 -->
<section id="s4">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 04</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Work orders and cadence</h2>

  <h3>What a work order is</h3>
  <p><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span> Work orders are numbered <code>WO-nn</code>, issued by the IT Director, and name what is in a cycle. <b>The work order is the constraint, not the specification.</b> An eighty-screen prototype and a covering note that says "not a build list" will both be forgotten by the second week; a work order naming eight screens will not.</p>

  <h4>A work order should carry</h4>
  <ul>
    <li>The screens or capabilities in scope, named individually.</li>
    <li>Their data dependencies, and which are unmet.</li>
    <li>The definition of done, per §8 of the Build Specification.</li>
    <li>What is explicitly deferred, so it is not re-argued.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3>Cadence</h3>
  <table>
    <tr><th>Rhythm</th><th>What happens</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Per work order</td><td>Scope issued, built, audited, closed with findings disclosed</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Per deploy</td><td>Migration job runs; scale thresholds reported; drift guard replays migrations</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Nightly</td><td>Reconciliation samples live records and reports disagreements</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Monthly</td><td>Price and scheme refresh proposed by agent, approved by a human</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>First pilot month</td><td>Behavioural thresholds set from measured behaviour</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="note"><b>On disclosure.</b> The development team has twice reported its own failures unprompted, including one command that could have reached production. <b>That is the single most valuable signal about a build.</b> It should stay explicitly welcome, because a team that hides a near-miss fails badly and late.</div>
</section>

<!-- 05 -->
<section id="s5">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 05</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>The environments</h2>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Environment</th><th>Purpose</th><th>Data</th><th>Who may reach it</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Local</b></td><td>Development</td><td>Seeded fixtures only. <b>Never a production copy</b></td><td>Developers</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Scratch</b></td><td>Throwaway experiments and repairs</td><td>Copies made for one task, then destroyed</td><td>Developers</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Staging</b></td><td>Pre-release verification</td><td>Synthetic. Structurally identical to production</td><td>Team and IT Director</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Production</b></td><td>Live</td><td>Real dealer data</td><td>IT Director. Application role only for the app</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>The scratch-to-production incident.</b> A delete aimed at a scratch database read its connection from a file and connected to production. It was stopped by a guard written earlier for an unrelated purpose, <b>which is luck rather than design.</b>
  <br><br><b>Required</b> <span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span> Any destructive command must take its target from an explicit environment argument and refuse to run without one. A connection read from a file is not a target; it is whatever the file happened to contain.</div>

  <h3>Hosting</h3>
  <table>
    <tr><th>Component</th><th>Where</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Database</td><td>Managed Postgres, Singapore region</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Application</td><td>Managed container hosting</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Source</td><td>GitHub organisation</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Data residency for dealer data</td><td><b>India, and it is a sales claim</b></td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>Residency is unresolved and it is commercial, not technical.</b> The login screen states that data is held in Mumbai. If the database is in Singapore, that claim is wrong and a dealer's compliance officer will find it. <b>Either move the region or change the claim. Do not ship both.</b></div>
</section>

<!-- 06 -->
<section id="s6">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 06</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Repository and branching</h2>
  <p><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span> This chapter reflects normal practice for a team of this size. <b>The IT Director should replace it with what is actually in use.</b></p>

  <h3>What matters regardless of the model chosen</h3>
  <ul>
    <li><b>Main is always deployable.</b> If it is not, the deploy gates in Chapter 09 mean nothing.</li>
    <li><b>Migrations are forward-only and never edited after they are applied anywhere.</b> A migration that has run in production is history.</li>
    <li><b>One work order, one branch, one merge.</b> A branch spanning three work orders cannot be reverted cleanly.</li>
    <li><b>Pilot branch naming has never been settled</b> <span class="pill p-open">Open</span> and it was raised during the Phase 4 work. Name a convention before the first pilot, not during it.</li>
  </ul>

  <h3>What must never be committed</h3>
  <p>Credentials of any kind, dealer data of any kind, connection strings, generated build artefacts, and <code>.env</code> files. <span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></p>

  <div class="note"><b>An API key was shared in conversation earlier in this programme and was advised to be rotated.</b> Whether it was rotated is <span class="pill p-open">Open</span>. Keys must never be pasted into a chat, a document, or a ticket. If one is, treat it as compromised and rotate it the same day.</div>
</section>

<!-- 07 -->
<section id="s7">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 07</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Secrets and credentials</h2>
  <p class="lede2">The register below is the shape. The values live in the secret store and never in this book.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Secret</th><th>Used for</th><th>Held by</th><th>Rotation</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Database connection, app role</td><td>Application runtime</td><td>Host secret store</td><td>On staff change</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Database connection, control role</td><td>Migrations, reconciliation</td><td>IT Director</td><td>On staff change</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Meta Marketing API</td><td>Spend and lead ingestion</td><td>Advito ad account</td><td>Per Meta policy</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Google Data Manager API</td><td>Spend and conversions</td><td>Advito ad account</td><td>Per Google policy</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>WhatsApp Cloud API</td><td>Customer messaging</td><td>Per dealer, Advito managed</td><td>On dealer offboarding</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Telephony provider</td><td>Call recording, click to call</td><td>Not yet selected</td><td>n/a</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Vehicle record lookup</td><td>Registration verification</td><td>Advito</td><td>Per provider</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Speech to text</td><td>Sampled transcription</td><td>Advito</td><td>Per provider</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <h3>Four rules</h3>
  <ol class="n">
    <li><b>No human ever holds the application role credential.</b> It is injected at runtime.</li>
    <li><b>Every secret has a named owner.</b> An unowned secret is an unrotatable secret.</li>
    <li><b>A secret that appears in any written channel is compromised.</b> Rotate the same day, no exceptions, no judgement call.</li>
    <li><b>Dealer-scoped secrets are destroyed at offboarding</b>, and the destruction is recorded in the dealer's own audit log.</li>
  </ol>
</section>

<!-- 08 -->
<section id="s8">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 08</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Database rules</h2>

  <h3>Tenant isolation</h3>
  <p><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span> Row-level security is enabled and forced on tenant tables, with policies keyed on a session setting. <b>Isolation is enforced by the database, not by application code</b>, so a missing <code>WHERE</code> clause cannot leak one dealer's data to another.</p>

  <h3>Ledgers</h3>
  <p>Append-only tables are append-only by <b>privilege</b>, not by convention:</p>
<pre>REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON "<b>table</b>" FROM arth_app;
REVOKE UPDATE, DELETE ON "<b>table</b>" FROM arth_control;</pre>
  <p>Under <code>FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY</code> even the table owner has no update or delete. <b>A column that must be written after insert cannot exist on such a table.</b> The correction is a new row. This was found the hard way when a proposed acknowledgement table carried two unwritable columns.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Ledger</th><th>Holds</th><th>State</th></tr>
    <tr><td><code>audit_logs</code></td><td>Access, permission and export events</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Live</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>lead_events</code></td><td>Everything that happened to an enquiry</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Live</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>point_entries</code></td><td>Points earned and lost, with cause</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Live</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>credit_transactions</code></td><td>Billing movements</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Live</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>delivery_promises</code></td><td>Every promised date and who set it</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Required, Phase 5</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><code>exception_events</code></td><td>Cockpit decisions</td><td><span class="pill p-open">DDL issued, awaiting authorisation</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <h3>Money</h3>
  <p><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span> <b>Integer minor units. Paise. Never floating point, anywhere.</b> A group's aggregate exposure clears a 32-bit integer at ₹2.1 crore, so aggregate columns are <code>BIGINT</code>.</p>

  <h3>Derived, never stored</h3>
  <p>Chain state, exception state, the Parked condition, and chain lineage counts. <b>An immutable table cannot repair a bad snapshot</b>, so a computed value written wrong on an append-only row is wrong permanently and propagates forward. Same reasoning as the palette refusing to store contrast ratios.</p>

  <h3>Polymorphic references</h3>
  <p>Where a column points at several tables it can carry no foreign key. <span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span> <b>Every such column requires a stated rule for deletion, merge and rename, and a sweep that closes orphans and reports them.</b> The database cannot enforce it, so something has to look.</p>
</section>

<!-- 09 -->
<section id="s9">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 09</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Deployment gates</h2>
  <p class="lede2">A gate that can be waived under time pressure is not a gate. The list below is short deliberately.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Gate</th><th>Fails when</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Raw colour rule</b></td><td>Any colour literal appears outside the palette file</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Palette completeness</b></td><td>A published colour has no token, or a token has no published colour</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Contrast suite</b></td><td>A text and ground pairing measures below its floor</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Migration drift guard</b></td><td>Replayed migrations do not produce the current schema</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Scale thresholds</b></td><td>A watched table passes its ceiling</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Config key assertion</b></td><td>A configuration key has no renderer, <b>or a renderer has no key</b></td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Threshold bounds</b></td><td>A tenant setting is outside its permitted range</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="dark"><span class="eyebrow">Two properties every gate needs</span>
    <b>Bidirectional.</b> A one-directional check catches the typo that creates an orphan key and misses the renderer left behind looking live.<br><br>
    <b>No exemption list.</b> The moment a gate acquires a file of exceptions, it stops being read and starts being appended to. If a gate is wrong, fix the gate.</div>

  <h3>What a green build does not prove</h3>
  <p>A test against a fixture proves the events that exist add up. <b>It cannot prove every write path emitted one.</b> That is why reconciliation runs against live data nightly, and why a passing suite is a floor rather than a finish.</p>
</section>

<!-- 10 -->
<section id="s10">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 10</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>The instruments</h2>
  <p class="lede2">What watches the system when nobody is looking.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Instrument</th><th>Runs</th><th>Reports</th><th>Mark</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Nightly reconciliation</b></td><td>Nightly, sampled per tenant</td><td>Records rebuilt from the ledger that disagree with current state. <b>Reports, never corrects</b></td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Orphan sweep</b></td><td>Nightly, plus enqueued on scope change</td><td>Polymorphic references pointing at nothing</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Scale thresholds</b></td><td>Every deploy</td><td>Row counts against ceilings</td><td><span class="pill p-rep">Reported</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Third-party watch</b></td><td>Continuous</td><td>API deprecations, policy changes, latency</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Deferral share</b></td><td>Per tenant, per period</td><td>Whether the cockpit is nagging</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified, Phase 7</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Age of unexited cards</b></td><td>Per tenant, per period</td><td><b>Whether a screen is being read and ignored</b></td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified, Phase 7</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Onboarding time</b></td><td>Per dealer</td><td>The best churn predictor available before go-live</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="note"><b>Why the enqueued sweep does not replace the nightly one.</b> An enqueue is a message and messages are lost. If the enqueue fails, an acknowledgement outlives its scope with nothing scheduled to notice. <b>Fast path and guarantee, not fast path instead of guarantee</b>, and the nightly run must report the orphans the enqueue should have caught, or a broken enqueue looks exactly like a working one.</div>
</section>

  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 11</div><div class="srule"></div>

    <tr><td>Targets and their basis</td><td><b>Yes</b></td><td></td><td></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Prices, schemes, model catalogue</td><td><b>Yes</b></td><td>Can import</td><td></td></tr>

  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>A control with a dial the subject can turn is not a control.</b> Cockpit thresholds are bounded, the bounds are asserted in the suite, and <b>the setting is logged and printed on the card it was loosened to delay.</b> The lever is not removed; it is made impossible to pull quietly.</div>
</section>

<!-- 12 -->
<section id="s12">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 12</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Tenant provisioning</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Seven steps. Target twenty-one days. Onboarding time is the best churn predictor available before a dealer has ever used the product.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th></th><th>Step</th><th>Owner</th><th>Blocks</th></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">1</td><td>Brands and rooftops, the org tree</td><td>Advito with the dealer</td><td>Everything</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">2</td><td>Positions and people</td><td>Dealer, Advito reviews</td><td>Assignment, escalation</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">3</td><td><b>Working hours and shifts</b></td><td>Dealer</td><td><b>Every clock in the product</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">4</td><td>Prices and schemes</td><td>Dealer, Advito can import</td><td>Quotations</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">5</td><td>Lead sources and ad accounts</td><td>Advito</td><td>Attribution</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">6</td><td>WhatsApp numbers and templates</td><td>Advito</td><td>All customer messaging</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">7</td><td>Existing customer and vehicle data</td><td>Advito with the dealer</td><td>Household, service history</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="note"><b>Step 3 is the one that stalls, and it looks like the dullest.</b> Without working hours the system penalises a telecaller for a lead that arrived at 21:40, and the floor stops trusting the screen in its first week. <b>Nothing should go live until step 3 is complete for every branch.</b> A dealer stalled at step 3 after four requests is the strongest pre-launch churn signal there is.</p>

  <h3>Migration, honestly</h3>
  <p>A dealer's existing data will contain the same person three times with three spellings and two numbers. <b>Arth shows the duplicates and the dealer decides.</b> An automatic merge that joins two households cannot be unpicked later. Expect a week, expect tedium, and treat any vendor promising a one-click import as either not migrating much or about to corrupt a database.</p>

  <h3>What provisioning creates</h3>
  <p>Templates are <b>copied at provisioning, never referenced.</b> A dealer changing his disposition list must not affect another dealer's. <span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></p>

  <h3>Offboarding</h3>
  <p><span class="pill p-open">Open</span> Not yet specified. It needs: a full data export in a documented format, destruction of dealer-scoped secrets, WhatsApp number release, ad account access removal, and a retention decision for the ledgers. <b>The contract promises free export; the mechanism does not exist.</b></p>
</section>

<!-- 13 -->
<section id="s13">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 13</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>The seed catalogue</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Everything below is rows. If adding to any of it requires a migration, the design has failed.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Set</th><th>Default</th><th>Changed by</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Stages</b></td><td>Nine: New, Assigned, Contacted, Qualified, Test drive, Quotation, Negotiation, Booked, Delivered</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Dispositions</b></td><td>Per department. Sales carries connected, not-connected and closed sets. Service, insurance, used car and delivery each carry their own</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Lost reasons</b></td><td>Seven, controlled. Each demands a specific fact</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Chain steps</b></td><td>Twelve across three lanes. EV adds two, commercial vehicle three, two-wheeler removes one</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Difficulty bands</b></td><td>Hot ×1.0, warm ×1.5, cold ×2.5, very cold ×3.5</td><td>Dealer admin, bounded</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Points per outcome</b></td><td>Test drive 8, visit 5, quotation 4, follow-up 1, postponed 1</td><td>Dealer admin</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Roles and landing workspaces</b></td><td>Twenty-two seats</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Exception types</b></td><td>Nine aggregate types. <b>A config key, not an enum</b></td><td>Advito</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Plans</b></td><td>Core, Growth, Scale, plus per-brand multipliers</td><td>Founder only</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Defect taxonomy</b></td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span> Required in Phase 5. Controlled from the first job card or the recurring-failure card is unbuildable at any price</td><td>Advito</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="dark"><span class="eyebrow">The test for anything proposed as an enum</span>
    <b>Will there ever be a tenth?</b> If yes it is configuration. Nine exception types will become eleven, and if adding one needs a migration, adding one will not happen.<br><br>
    The safeguard is a <b>bidirectional assertion in the test suite</b>: every key has a renderer and every renderer has a key.</div>
</section>

<section id="s14">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 14</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Thresholds and their bounds</h2>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Threshold</th><th>Default</th><th>Bound</th><th>Set from</th></tr>
    <tr><td>First response target</td><td>30 minutes</td><td>Dealer choice</td><td>Dealer preference</td></tr>

    <tr><td>Callback needing a reason</td><td>Beyond 14 days</td><td>Dealer choice</td><td>Dealer preference</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Cockpit magnitude, this deferral</td><td>1.5×</td><td>1.2× to 2.5×</td><td>Bounded, logged, shown on the card</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Cockpit magnitude, chain origin</td><td>2×</td><td>1.5× to 3×</td><td>Bounded, logged</td></tr>

    <tr><td>Used car ageing</td><td>45 days</td><td>Dealer choice</td><td>Floor-plan rate</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Export flagged to admin</td><td>200 records</td><td>Dealer choice</td><td>Visible, never blocked</td></tr>

  </table>

  <div class="note"><b>The standing pattern, applied four times now:</b> a threshold about human behaviour is set from the first month of real behaviour. A number invented in advance will be defended later on no evidence, and nobody has measured what a healthy deferral share looks like at an Indian dealership.</div>
</section>

  <h3>The two that gate features</h3>
  <p><b>Telephony gates the points engine</b>, because the twenty-second connect floor cannot be enforced without call duration, and shipping points without it teaches a floor to game a score before the control exists.</p>
  <p><b>The OEM survey schedule gates a principal-level card.</b> Without it, complaint ranking is a service feature rather than a dealer principal one. <b>Better a service card built on fact than a principal card built on a guess.</b></p>
</section>

<!-- 16 -->
<section id="s16">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 16</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Failure modes</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Each of these will happen. The question is only whether it is planned for.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Failure</th><th>Effect</th><th>Response</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>WhatsApp template rejected</b><br>Policy changed under us</td><td>Messages stop for affected tenants</td><td>Fall back to the previous approved template. Alert engineering. <b>Never silently drop a message</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Ad platform API version deprecated</b></td><td>Spend data stops arriving; attribution goes stale</td><td>Third-party watch flags it months ahead. Migrate on their schedule, not ours</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Vehicle lookup slow or down</b></td><td>Registration verification stalls</td><td>Secondary provider takes traffic. Degrade to manual entry, flagged as unverified</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Reconciliation finds a disagreement</b></td><td>A record and its ledger differ</td><td><b>Report. Never auto-correct.</b> Investigate the write path</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Enqueued sweep does not run</b></td><td>An acknowledgement outlives its scope</td><td>Nightly sweep catches it <b>and reports that the enqueue failed</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>A tenant crosses its scale ceiling</b></td><td>Query paths degrade</td><td>Red build at the next deploy, before a user notices</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Destructive command aimed at the wrong environment</b></td><td>Potential data loss</td><td>Explicit environment argument required. <b>Refuse to run without one</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>A dealer's staff stop logging in</b></td><td>Churn in slow motion</td><td>Adoption per role is watched. <b>This is a visit, not a ticket</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Consent withdrawn</b></td><td>Legal exposure if a message goes out</td><td>Suppression across calls, WhatsApp, SMS and ad audiences within minutes, verified</td></tr>
  </table>
</section>

<!-- 17 -->
<section id="s17">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 17</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Runbooks</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Six. Each should exist as a written procedure before it is needed, not during.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Runbook</th><th>Must cover</th><th>State</th></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Production incident</b></td><td>Who is called, how a tenant is isolated, how a rollback is decided, who tells the dealer</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Data correction</b></td><td>How a wrong record is corrected on an append-only table. <b>By a correcting entry, never an edit.</b> Who authorises it</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Tenant onboarding</b></td><td>The seven steps of Chapter 12, with the responsible party per step</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Partly written</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Tenant offboarding</b></td><td>Export, secret destruction, number release, retention decision</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Open</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Access grant and revoke</b></td><td>Adding a person, removing a leaver, <b>the structured handover of their open work</b></td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified in product</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Advito entering a dealer's account</b></td><td>Ticket reference, time limit, masking, and the log the dealer sees</td><td><span class="pill p-spec">Specified in product</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>Four of six do not exist.</b> The two that do are specified in the product because they are screens. <b>The four missing ones are the ones needed on the worst day of the programme</b>, and the incident runbook in particular should be written before the first dealer goes live rather than during the first outage.</div>

  <h3>The leaver runbook, since it is the most frequent</h3>
  <p>A resignation is a <b>structured handover, not a bulk reassign.</b> Open commitments transfer with their deadlines. The WhatsApp number stays with the dealership. Every session is invalidated immediately on deactivation. The customer receives a message naming their new point of contact. <span class="pill p-spec">Specified</span></p>
</section>

<!-- 18 -->
<section id="s18">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 18</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Backup, restore and retention</h2>

  <table>
    <tr><th>Item</th><th>Position</th><th>State</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Database backups</td><td>Managed provider, automatic</td><td><span class="pill p-nv">Not verified</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Restore, tested</b></td><td>A backup that has never been restored is a hope</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Never tested</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Recovery point objective</td><td>How much data may be lost</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Undefined</span></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Recovery time objective</td><td>How long a dealer may be down</td><td><span class="pill p-open">Undefined</span></td></tr>
  </table>

  <h3>Retention</h3>
  <table>
    <tr><th>Data</th><th>Held</th><th>Note</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Call recordings, ordinary</td><td>90 days</td><td>Storage cost dominates</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Call recordings attached to a case</b></td><td><b>24 months</b></td><td>Evidence in a dispute. <b>Exempt from the purge, and a scheduled job that removes one is a serious failure</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td>Ledgers and audit</td><td>7 years</td><td>Never purged</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Identity documents</td><td>Purpose only, then purged</td><td>Held for a finance application, destroyed at close. Every view logged</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Registration, invoices</td><td>Life of the vehicle with us</td><td>Attached to the vehicle, not the deal</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>The untested restore is the second-largest risk on the programme, behind the trademark.</b> It sits alongside single-person infrastructure and no named successor. Neither is urgent this month and both are on the post-launch audit list for a reason.</div>
</section>

<!-- 19 -->
<section id="s19">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 19</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>Compliance</h2>

  <h3>Consent</h3>
  <p><b>One row per purpose, never one tick for everything.</b> Sales enquiry, service reminders, insurance renewal and offers are four separate permissions. A customer who agreed to service reminders has not agreed to a festive broadcast, and <b>the system refuses to send it</b> rather than leaving that judgement to whoever builds the campaign.</p>

  <h3>Data subject requests</h3>
  <table>
    <tr><th>Request</th><th>Response</th><th>Window</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Copy of my data</td><td>One export across every department, because there is one customer record</td><td>14 days</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Delete my data</td><td><b>Partly refusable.</b> Marketing data erased; tax invoices retained with the statutory reason recorded and told to the customer</td><td>14 days</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Stop contacting me</td><td>Every channel and every ad audience, within minutes</td><td>Immediate</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="warn"><b>The migrated records are the real exposure.</b> Customers imported from a dealer's old system arrive with no consent record. They may be contacted about a vehicle they own, which is a service obligation. <b>They may not be added to any campaign audience.</b> The only clean fix is to ask them once on the next legitimate contact.</div>

  <h3>Certification</h3>
  <p><span class="pill p-open">Open</span> No ISO 27001, no SOC 2, no external penetration test. Not required by the current segment; <b>required by any enterprise dealer group</b>, and the penetration test is deferred with a named trigger at the second client.</p>
</section>

<!-- 20 -->
<section id="s20">
  <div class="eyebrow">Chapter 20</div><div class="srule"></div>
  <h2>The open register</h2>
  <p class="lede2">Everything this book found that nobody has decided. Ordered by cost of delay.</p>

  <table>
    <tr><th></th><th>Open item</th><th>With</th><th>Cost of delay</th></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">1</td><td><b>Trademark search, classes 9 and 42</b></td><td>Prem</td><td><b>Rises weekly.</b> The only risk with nothing holding it</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">2</td><td><b>Production seed not run</b><br>One login, ageing data</td><td>Prem</td><td>Nothing can be demonstrated</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">3</td><td>Data residency claim versus actual region</td><td>Prem and IT Director</td><td>A compliance officer will find it</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">4</td><td><b>Restore never tested</b></td><td>IT Director</td><td>Unknown until the worst day</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">5</td><td>Incident and data-correction runbooks</td><td>IT Director</td><td>Needed on the worst day</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">6</td><td><code>ExceptionEvent</code> authorisation</td><td>Prem</td><td>Blocks Phase 7 only</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">7</td><td>Eight palette tokens, and the on-dark scale</td><td>Brand</td><td>Blocks front-end build gates</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">8</td><td>Telephony provider</td><td>Prem</td><td>Gates the points engine</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">9</td><td>Defect taxonomy</td><td>Advito</td><td><b>Impossible to retrofit</b></td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">10</td><td>Offboarding mechanism</td><td>IT Director</td><td>Contract promises free export</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">11</td><td>Pilot branch naming</td><td>IT Director</td><td>Small, and raised twice</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">12</td><td>Whether the shared API key was rotated</td><td>IT Director</td><td>Assume compromised until confirmed</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">13</td><td>Advito three-surface split</td><td>Unscoped</td><td>Not this cycle</td></tr>
    <tr><td class="rt">14</td><td>Bus factor, no named successor</td><td>Prem</td><td>Structural</td></tr>
  </table>

  <div class="dark"><span class="eyebrow">The two that need somebody today</span>
    <b>The trademark search</b> needs nothing that is not ready and only Prem can start it. Today an unavailable mark costs a brand book, a palette and a domain. After Phase 5 it costs seven workspaces and the name on the signage.<br><br>
    <b>The production seed</b> is built and rehearsed. Until it runs, the access model that distinguishes Arth from a shared spreadsheet cannot be shown to anybody.</div>
</section>

<footer>
  <b>Arth · Project Configuration Book · Edition 01</b><br>
  Advito Global · 21 August 2026. Custodian: the IT Director. Companions: Product Book, Build Specification v1.0, Brand System v2.9, <code>Arth-Platform.html</code>.<br><br>
  <b>Every entry marked Not verified is a question, not an instruction.</b> Replace it with the real value rather than let it stand. Amendments in writing, by the party who owns the area.
</footer>

</div></body></html>
