/* misc panels */
.kv{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:6px 0;
 border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);font-size:12.5px}
.kv:last-child{border:none}
.kv b{font-weight:600;text-align:right}
.sec-t{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 9px}
.toast{position:fixed;left:256px;bottom:20px;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;
 padding:11px 16px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);font-size:13px;z-index:400;
 box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,42,51,.22);opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px);
 transition:all.18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);pointer-events:none}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:420px;background:var(--n00);
 border-left:1px solid var(--n10);z-index:200;transform:translateX(100%);
 transition:transform.2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);overflow-y:auto;
 box-shadow:-8px 0 24px rgba(15,42,51,.1)}
.drawer.open{transform:none}
.drawer-h{padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);display:flex;
 align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--n00)}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(15,42,51,.28);z-index:150;opacity:0;
 pointer-events:none;transition:opacity.18s}
.ov.on{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
.ic{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;
 stroke-linecap:square;stroke-linejoin:miter;flex-shrink:0}
.ic.lg{width:20px;height:20px}
.banner{background:var(--brass-wash);border-bottom:1px solid var(--brass-lift);padding:7px 20px;
 font-size:12.5px;color:var(--brass-pill);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-shrink:0}


.dialer.light{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);color:var(--ink)}
/* .btn.go withdrawn 18 Aug. The Book gives five button variants and none is green.
   Settled is semantic and never decorates. Ink fill measures 15.01:1 against the
   green's 6.83:1, so the Book's own primary also solves the contrast failure better. */
.btn.go{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.btn.go:hover{background:var(--ink-press);border-color:var(--ink-press)}


/* ---------- STANDARD ROW ---------- */
.lst{width:100%}
.lst-h,.lrow{display:grid;
 grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr.9fr.8fr 1.05fr 1.05fr 78px 92px 74px;
 gap:12px;align-items:center}
.lst-h{padding:0 14px 8px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);font-size:9.5px;
 letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);font-weight:600}
.lst-h.rt{text-align:right}
.lrow{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-left:3px solid var(--n20);
 border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:10px 14px;margin-top:7px;cursor:pointer;min-height:58px}
.lrow:hover{border-color:var(--n40)}
.lrow.over{border-left-color:var(--over)}
.lrow.attn{border-left-color:var(--brass)}
.lrow.ok{border-left-color:var(--set)}
.cell{min-width:0}
.cell b{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;
 font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;line-height:1.3}
.cell span{display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:1;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;
 font-size:11.5px;color:var(--n60);overflow:hidden;line-height:1.35}
.cell .pill{white-space:nowrap;display:inline-block}
.cell.rt{text-align:right}
.cell b.bad{color:var(--over)}
.cell b.warnc{color:var(--brass-deep)}
.cell.acts{display:flex;gap:5px;justify-content:flex-end}
.ia{width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid var(--n20);border-radius:var(--r-sm);
 display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--n80);background:var(--n00)}
.ia:hover{border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--ink)}
.body-area .lst-h,.body-area .lrow{
 grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 92px 96px 62px;gap:10px}
.body-area .lst-h span:nth-child(4),.body-area .lrow .cell:nth-child(4){display:none}
@media(max-width:1420px){
 .body-area .lst-h,.body-area .lrow{grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr 1fr 92px 96px 62px}
 .body-area .lst-h span:nth-child(3),.body-area .lrow .cell:nth-child(3){display:none}}
@media(max-width:1360px){
 .lst-h,.lrow{grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr.9fr 1.05fr 1.05fr 78px 92px 74px}
 .lst-h span:nth-child(4),.lrow.cell:nth-child(4){display:none}}
@media(max-width:1160px){
 .lst-h,.lrow{grid-template-columns:1.6fr 1fr 1.05fr 1.05fr 92px 74px}
 .lst-h span:nth-child(3),.lrow.cell:nth-child(3),
 .lst-h span:nth-child(7),.lrow.cell:nth-child(7){display:none}}




/* ---------- SCREEN B: the day panel ---------- */
.daypanel{display:flex;gap:0;background:var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;
 align-items:stretch}
.dp-main{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:20px 22px}
.dp-rule{width:52px;height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin-bottom:12px}
.dp-lead{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:21px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;line-height:1.32;
 max-width:44ch}
.dp-sub{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--on-ink-mut);margin-top:9px;max-width:56ch;line-height:1.5}
.dp-side{width:296px;flex-shrink:0;background:var(--ink-2);padding:20px 20px;
 border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.dp-side-h{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--brass-lift);font-weight:600;
 margin-bottom:11px}
.dp-i{display:flex;gap:9px;padding:7px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
 font-size:12.5px;color:var(--on-ink);align-items:flex-start}
.dp-i:last-child{border:none}
.dp-i i{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--brass);margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0}
.dp-i i.ok{background:var(--set)}
.dp-i i.no{background:var(--over)}
.dp-i span{display:block;color:var(--on-ink-mut);font-size:11.5px;margin-top:1px}
.dp-foot{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-top:none;
 border-radius:0 0 var(--r-md) var(--r-md);padding:11px 22px;font-size:13px;color:var(--n80);
 display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.dp-foot b{color:var(--ink)}
.dp-foot .m{width:3px;align-self:stretch;background:var(--brass);border-radius:2px;flex-shrink:0}
@media(max-width:1080px){.daypanel{flex-direction:column}.dp-side{width:auto;border-left:none;
 border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}}



/* ═══════════ MOTION ═══════════
  Rules. Motion carries information or it does not exist.
  Fast (160-320ms), never bouncy, never looping except a live clock.
  Everything below is disabled entirely under prefers-reduced-motion. */

/* the brass rule draws, because the rule is the brand's structural device */
.rule{transform-origin:left center}
.anim .rule{animation:ruleDraw .34s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both}
@keyframes ruleDraw{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}

/* bars grow from zero, so the length is read as a quantity arriving */
.ch-b i{transition:width .52s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}
.anim .ch-b i{width:0}
.bar-h i{transition:width .52s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)}

/* rows arrive in sequence, fast enough to read as one movement */
@keyframes rowIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.anim .lrow{animation:rowIn .26s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both}
.anim .stat,.anim .qr{animation:rowIn .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1) both}

/* the one live thing: an overdue clock breathes, nothing else does */
@keyframes overduePulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.55}}
.tick{animation:overduePulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}

/* the day panel changes underneath the person rather than reloading */
.dp-lead,.dp-sub,.dp-foot,#dpSide{transition:opacity .2s ease}
.dp-swap .dp-lead,.dp-swap .dp-sub,.dp-swap .dp-foot,.dp-swap #dpSide{opacity:0}

/* pressing a row acknowledges the press */
.lrow{transition:border-color .14s ease,transform .14s ease}
.lrow:active{transform:scale(.996)}
.btn{transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease,transform .1s ease}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.nav-i{transition:background .14s ease,border-color .14s ease}

/* build notes appear and disappear without jumping the layout */
body.notes-off .spec{display:none}
.notes-t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;margin:10px 14px 0;padding:9px 11px;
 border-radius:var(--r-sm);cursor:pointer;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09)}
.notes-t:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.notes-t .lbl{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--on-ink-mut);flex:1;line-height:1.35}
.sw{width:32px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--ink-line);position:relative;flex-shrink:0;
 transition:background .18s ease}
.sw i{position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;
 background:var(--on-ink-dim);transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1),background .18s ease}
.notes-on .sw{background:var(--brass)}
.notes-on .sw i{transform:translateX(14px);background:#fff}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
 .anim .rule,.anim .lrow,.anim .stat,.anim .qr{animation:none}
 .ch-b i,.bar-h i,.lrow,.btn,.dp-lead,.dp-sub,.dp-foot,#dpSide{transition:none}
 .anim .ch-b i{width:auto}
 .tick{animation:none}
}

/* ---------- chart rows ---------- */
.ch{margin-top:10px}
.ch-r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr 84px;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:5px 0}
.ch-r>span:first-child{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n80)}
.ch-b{height:16px;background:var(--n10);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.ch-b i{display:block;height:100%}
.ch-v{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12.5px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
 color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
@media(max-width:1200px){.ch-r{grid-template-columns:130px 1fr 76px;gap:9px}}

.savebar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:16px;padding-top:14px;
 border-top:1px solid var(--n10);flex-wrap:wrap}
.savebar.spacer{margin-left:auto}
.dirty{position:fixed;left:256px;bottom:20px;background:var(--brass-wash);
 border:1px solid var(--brass-lift);color:var(--brass-pill);padding:10px 15px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
 font-size:13px;z-index:399;display:none;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.dirty.on{display:flex}

/* difficulty is manager-and-above only */
body.exec.lrow.diffcell,body.exec.lst-h span:nth-child(7){visibility:hidden}
body.exec #v-pipe.lst-h span:nth-child(7){visibility:hidden}

/* activity entries must look clickable */
.act{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
 cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent}
.act:hover{background:var(--n05);border-color:var(--n10)}
.act.dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--n40);margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0}
.act.dot.hl{background:var(--brass)}
.act.dot.ok{background:var(--set)}
.act.dot.no{background:var(--over)}
.act.go{margin-left:auto;color:var(--n40);flex-shrink:0}
.act:hover.go{color:var(--ink)}
.player{background:var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:12px 14px;color:#fff}
.pbar{height:4px;background:var(--ink-line);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin:9px 0 6px}
.pbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:38%;background:var(--brass)}
.tsc{background:var(--n05);border-left:3px solid var(--n20);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
 font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--n80)}
.tsc b{color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- platform index ---------- */
.idx{position:fixed;inset:0;background:var(--n05);z-index:500;overflow-y:auto;display:none}
.idx.on{display:block}
.idx-h{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:22px 30px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;
 position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2}
.idx-b{padding:26px 30px 60px;max-width:1200px}
.idx-g{margin-bottom:26px}
.idx-g h4{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 4px}
.idx-g.d{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60);margin-bottom:11px}
.idx-l{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(212px,1fr));gap:8px}
.idx-i{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:11px 13px;
 cursor:pointer;border-left:3px solid var(--n20)}
.idx-i:hover{border-color:var(--n50);border-left-color:var(--brass)}
.idx-i b{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600}
.idx-i span{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--n60)}

/* ---------- extra components ---------- */
.split{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start}
.col{flex:1;min-width:0}
.box{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.box h3{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 10px}
.mini{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(148px,1fr));gap:10px}
.stat{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:13px 15px}
.stat.v{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:25px;font-weight:600;line-height:1}
.stat.l{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--n60);margin-top:3px}
.bar-h{height:8px;background:var(--n10);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0}
.bar-h i{display:block;height:100%}
.tl{border-left:2px solid var(--n10);padding-left:14px;margin-left:4px}
.tl-i{position:relative;margin-bottom:14px}
.tl-i::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-19px;top:5px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--n40)}
.tl-i.ok::before{background:var(--set)}
.tl-i.no::before{background:var(--over)}
.tl-i.now::before{background:var(--brass)}
.anno{background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-ink);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:14px 16px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.55}
.anno b{color:#fff}
.anno.eyebrow{color:var(--brass-lift);display:block;margin-bottom:6px}
.rolemenu{margin:6px 14px 0;background:var(--ink-3);border-radius:var(--r-sm);overflow:hidden}
.rolemenu a{display:block;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--on-ink);cursor:pointer;
 border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.rolemenu a:last-child{border:none}
.rolemenu a:hover{background:var(--ink-2);color:#fff}
.rolemenu a.on{color:#fff;font-weight:600}
.rolemenu a small{display:block;color:var(--on-ink-dim);font-size:10.5px;font-weight:400}

/* ---------- phone frames ---------- */
.phones{display:flex;gap:28px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:22px 24px;align-items:flex-start}
.ph{width:340px;flex-shrink:0}
.ph-scr{width:340px;height:700px;background:var(--n05);border:9px solid var(--ink-press);border-radius:32px;
 overflow:hidden;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
 box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(15,42,51,.2)}
.ph-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60);line-height:1.5}
.ph-note b{color:var(--ink);display:block;font-family:var(--disp);font-size:14px;margin-bottom:3px}
.mst{background:var(--ink-press);color:#fff;font-size:10.5px;padding:5px 16px 3px;display:flex;
 justify-content:space-between;font-family:var(--data)}
.mtop{background:var(--n00);border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);padding:11px 15px;
 display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-shrink:0}
.mtop h3{font-family:var(--disp);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;margin:0}
.mbody{flex:1;overflow-y:auto}
.mbar{background:var(--ink);display:flex;flex-shrink:0;padding:6px 0 10px;position:relative;z-index:1}
.mbar a{flex:1;text-align:center;color:var(--on-ink-dim);font-size:9.5px;padding:5px 0;cursor:pointer}
.mbar a.on{color:#fff}
.mbar a.on svg{color:var(--brass)}
.mbar svg{width:20px;height:20px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;display:block;margin:0 auto 3px}
.mrow2{background:var(--n00);border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);border-left:3px solid var(--n20);
 padding:12px 15px}
.mrow2.over{border-left-color:var(--over)}
.mrow2.attn{border-left-color:var(--brass)}
.mrow2.t{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.mrow2.s{font-size:12px;color:var(--n60);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:2px}
.msheet{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:5;background:var(--n00);
 border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;box-shadow:0 -8px 28px rgba(15,42,51,.22);padding:16px 15px 18px;
 max-height:80%;overflow-y:auto;padding-bottom:20px}
.mgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.mdb{border:1px solid var(--n20);border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:13px 10px;font-size:13px;
 font-weight:600;text-align:left;background:var(--n00);min-height:56px}
.mdb small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--n60);margin-top:2px}
.mdb.on{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.mdb.on small{color:var(--on-ink-mut)}
@media(max-width:1100px){.tc-x{display:none}}
@media(max-width:820px){.tc-q{display:none}.side{width:64px}.side.nav-i span,.side.nav-h,
 .ws-pick,.side-foot,.mark b{display:none}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<svg style="display:none">
<symbol id="i-phone" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 4h3.5l1.5 4.5-2.2 1.6a12 12 0 0 0 5.1 5.1l1.6-2.2L20 14.5V18h-3.5C10.7 18 6 13.3 6 7.5z"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-doc" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><path d="M9 12h6M9 16h4"/></symbol>

<symbol id="i-shield" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><circle cx="12" cy="15" r="2.6"/></symbol>
<symbol id="i-scale" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 5v15M6 20h12M12 8l-6 2.5M12 8l6 2.5"/><path d="M3 10.5a3 3 0 0 0 6 0M15 10.5a3 3 0 0 0 6 0"/></symbol>

</svg>

<div class="app">
<!-- ============ SIDEBAR ============ -->
<nav class="side">
 <div class="side-top"><div class="mark"><b>arth</b></div></div>
 <div class="ws-pick" onclick="toggleRoles()">
  <div><small>SIGNED IN AS</small><span id="roleName">Telecaller</span></div>
  <svg class="ic"><use href="#i-chev"/></svg>
 </div>
 <div id="roleMenu" class="rolemenu hidden"></div>
 <div id="navBody"></div>
 <div class="side-foot">
  <div class="who" id="whoName">Ravi Shankar</div>
  <div style="color:var(--on-ink-dim)" id="whoRole">Telecalling · Nagarbhavi</div>
 </div>
</nav>

<div class="main">
<!-- ============ TELECALLING ============ -->
<div class="view" id="v-tele">
 <div class="topbar">
  <h1>Call queue</h1>
  <div class="sub">Ordered by expected value, not by age</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <div class="sub mono" id="clock">09:14</div>
  <button class="btn ghost sm" onclick="toast('Break started, queue paused, no SLA penalties accrue')">Take a break</button>
 </div>
 <div class="banner"><svg class="ic"><use href="#i-clock"/></svg>
  <span><b>3 leads breach first-response SLA in the next 20 minutes.</b> They have been moved to the top of your queue.</span></div>

 <div class="tc">
  <!-- queue -->
  <div class="tc-q">
   <div class="tc-q-h">
    <div class="eyebrow">NEXT UP</div>
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-top:3px">
     <div style="font-family:var(--disp);font-size:17px;font-weight:600" id="qCount">6 shown</div>
     <div class="xs mut mono" id="qDone">of 24 · 0 done</div>
    </div>
   </div>
   <div class="scroll" id="queue"></div>
  </div>

  <!-- call surface -->
  <div class="tc-c">
   <div class="cust-h">
    <div style="flex:1">
     <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:9px"></div>
     <h2 id="cName">Ramesh Kumar</h2>
     <div class="sm mut" id="cMeta">Grand Vitara ZXi+ · enquiry 61 hours old · Nagarbhavi</div>
    </div>
    <div style="text-align:right">
     <div class="xs mut">EXPECTED VALUE</div>
     <div class="mono" style="font-size:19px;font-weight:600" id="cVal">₹11,200</div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <div id="flagBox"></div>

   <!-- dialer: ready -->
   <div class="dialer light" id="dReady">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px">
     <div style="flex:1">
      <div class="xs mut" style="letter-spacing:.14em">CALL 1 OF 24</div>
      <div class="mono" style="font-size:21px;margin:4px 0 2px;color:var(--ink)" id="cPhone">+91 98450 12345</div>
      <div class="xs mut">4th attempt · last call 21 Jul, 3m 12s, no answer</div>
     </div>
     <button class="btn big go" onclick="startCall()">
      <svg class="ic lg"><use href="#i-phone"/></svg>Start call</button>
    </div>
   </div>

   <!-- dialer: live -->
   <div class="dialer hidden" id="dLive">
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px">
     <div class="wave"><i style="animation-delay:0s"></i><i style="animation-delay:.1s"></i><i style="animation-delay:.2s"></i><i style="animation-delay:.3s"></i><i style="animation-delay:.15s"></i></div>
     <div>
      <div class="xs" style="color:var(--on-ink-dim);letter-spacing:.14em">ON CALL · RECORDING</div>
      <div class="tmr" id="tmr">00:00</div>
     </div>
     <div class="spacer"></div>
     <button class="btn danger" onclick="endCall()">End call</button>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:14px;padding-top:13px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink-3)">
     <div class="xs" style="color:var(--on-ink-dim);letter-spacing:.14em;margin-bottom:6px">OFFER RUNNING TODAY ON THIS MODEL</div>
     <div style="font-size:13px">Exchange bonus ₹25,000 · Corporate ₹15,000 · Valid to 31 Aug</div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <!-- prep: what to actually say -->
   <div id="prepBox">
    <div class="card" style="padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px">
     <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:9px"></div>
     <h3 class="sec-t">Before you dial</h3>
     <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:10px">
      <div>
       <div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:6px">WHAT CHANGED SINCE LAST TIME</div>
       <ul style="margin:0;padding-left:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n80);line-height:1.7">
        <li>Exchange bonus rose to ₹25,000 on 01 Aug</li>
        <li>ZXi+ AT now in stock, was a 6-week wait</li>
        <li>Household Swift is due for service in 3 weeks</li>
       </ul>
      </div>
      <div>
       <div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:6px">OPEN QUESTIONS ON THIS ENQUIRY</div>
       <ul style="margin:0;padding-left:16px;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n80);line-height:1.7">
        <li>Variant not confirmed. ZXi+ or ZXi</li>
        <li>Exchange interest not asked</li>
        <li>Finance requirement unknown</li>
       </ul>
      </div>
     </div>
     <div class="note" style="margin:14px 0 0">This customer's wife has serviced a Swift here six times. Open with that, not with the offer.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="padding:16px">
     <h3 class="sec-t">Price, as of today</h3>
     <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Ex-showroom · ZXi+ AT</span><b class="mono">₹16,89,000</b></div>
     <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Road tax · Karnataka</span><b class="mono">₹2,02,680</b></div>
     <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Insurance + registration</span><b class="mono">₹68,720</b></div>
     <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Festive exchange bonus</span><b class="mono" style="color:var(--set)">− ₹25,000</b></div>
     <div class="kv"><span class="mut" style="font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)">On-road today</span><b class="mono" style="font-size:15px">₹19,42,400</b></div>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:8px">Valid to 31 Aug. If this becomes a booking, these exact figures are stored with it, next month's price list will not overwrite them.</div>
    </div>
   </div>

   <!-- disposition -->
   <div class="card hidden" id="dispBox" style="padding:18px">
    <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
    <h3 class="sec-t">What happened on that call?</h3>
    <p class="sm mut" style="margin:0 0 14px">Call recorded 4m 08s. Arth checks what you record here against the recording. <b>Points are multiplied by how hard this lead is</b>, you will see the total after saving.</p>

    <div class="disp-grid" style="margin-bottom:14px">
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="td" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Test drive booked<small>Highest value</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="visit" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Showroom visit agreed<small>Strong outcome</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="quote" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Quotation requested<small>Good outcome</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="fu" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Call again later<small>Date required</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="post" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Postponed the purchase<small>Stays open · revisit date</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="lost" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Not interested<small>Reason required</small></button>
     <button class="dbtn" data-d="nc" onclick="pickDisp(this)">Did not connect<small>No points, no penalty</small></button>
    </div>

    <div id="dispDetail"></div>

    <div class="fld">
     <label>Did you promise the customer anything?</label>
     <input class="inp" id="promise" placeholder="e.g. I will send the on-road price by 6pm">
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:4px">Anything entered here becomes a tracked commitment with a deadline. Unkept commitments cost points.</div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center">
     <button class="btn" onclick="saveDisp()">Save and go to next call</button>
     <button class="btn ghost" onclick="cancelDisp()">Cancel</button>
     <div class="spacer"></div>
     <div class="xs mut">Next: Suresh Nayak · Brezza</div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>

  <!-- context rail -->
  <div class="tc-x">
   <div class="score">
    <div class="xs" style="color:var(--on-ink-dim);letter-spacing:.14em">TODAY'S POINTS</div>
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px">
     <span class="v" id="pts">18</span>
     <span class="xs" style="color:var(--on-ink-mut)">of 45 target</span>
    </div>
    <div style="height:4px;background:var(--ink-3);border-radius:2px;margin-top:9px;overflow:hidden">
     <div id="ptsBar" style="height:100%;width:40%;background:var(--brass)"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="xs" style="color:var(--on-ink-mut);margin-top:7px">6 connected · 1 test drive · 0 penalties</div>
   </div>

   <div class="eyebrow" style="margin-bottom:7px">THIS CUSTOMER</div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Source</span><b>Meta. Festive C2</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Lead cost</span><b class="mono">₹412</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Stage</span><b>Contacted</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Owner</span><b>Ravi Shankar</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">First response</span><b style="color:var(--over)">61h, breached</b></div>

   <div class="eyebrow" style="margin:18px 0 7px">HOUSEHOLD</div>
   <div class="card" style="padding:11px;margin-bottom:6px">
    <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px">Swift VXi · KA 01 MH 4412</div>
    <div class="xs mut">Registered to Sunitha Kumar (wife) · 2019 · serviced here 6 times</div>
   </div>
   <div class="xs mut">Existing service customer. Exchange likely.</div>

   <div class="eyebrow" style="margin:18px 0 7px">HISTORY</div>
   <div class="hist">
    <div class="hist-i hl"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Enquiry created</div><div class="xs mut">01 Aug, 21:48 · Meta lead form, after hours</div></div>
    <div class="hist-i"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Auto-reply sent</div><div class="xs mut">01 Aug, 21:48 · WhatsApp delivered</div></div>
    <div class="hist-i"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Assigned to Ravi Shankar</div><div class="xs mut">02 Aug, 10:15 · round-robin</div></div>
    <div class="hist-i"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Call attempt, no answer</div><div class="xs mut">02 Aug, 11:02 · 0m 14s</div></div>
    <div class="hist-i"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Call attempt, no answer</div><div class="xs mut">03 Aug, 16:40 · 0m 09s</div></div>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

        <option>Searched on Google</option><option>From a car website</option></select>
       <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:4px">Required. Fixed options, never free text, free text makes the field useless within a month.</div></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Interested in</label><select class="inp"><option>Grand Vitara</option><option>Brezza</option><option>Fronx</option></select></div>

        <input type="checkbox" checked style="margin-top:2px">
        <span>The customer agrees to be contacted about this enquiry by call and WhatsApp. Separate permission will be asked before any service or offer messages.</span></label>
       <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:7px">One tick, recorded with the time, the device and the purpose. This is the whole consent requirement for a walk-in.</div>
      </div>
      <button class="btn" style="width:100%;justify-content:center" onclick="toast('Merged into the existing Meta enquiry, the advert keeps its credit and no duplicate is created')">Save walk-in</button>
     </div>
    </div>
    <div class="col">
     <div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">WHY THIS SCREEN EXISTS</span>
      A walk-in is not a source, it is an arrival method. A large share of walk-ins saw an advert days earlier, and today every dealer records them as "walk-in", which snaps the attribution chain permanently.
      <br><br><b>Two mechanisms recover it.</b> Phone-number matching merges the walk-in into the existing enquiry. The "how did you hear" question, with fixed options, catches the rest. What is left after both is genuine passing trade, and that is costed against showroom rent and signage.</div>
     <div class="box" style="margin-top:14px">

       <div class="stat"><div class="v">5</div><div class="l">Genuine passing trade</div></div>
      </div>
     </div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

   <div class="box">
    <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
    <h3>Quote comparison, three tie-ups</h3>
    <table class="t">
     <tr><th>Rank</th><th>Insurer</th><th>Cover</th><th class="rt">IDV</th><th class="rt">Premium</th><th>Why</th></tr>
     <tr><td><span class="pill p-ok">Recommended</span></td><td>Bajaj Allianz</td><td>Comprehensive + zero dep</td><td class="rt">₹7,90,000</td><td class="rt">₹21,900</td><td>Cashless at our workshop · 94% claim settlement · renewed here twice</td></tr>
     <tr><td><span class="pill p-attn">2nd</span></td><td>ICICI Lombard</td><td>Comprehensive + zero dep</td><td class="rt">₹7,90,000</td><td class="rt">₹20,400</td><td>₹1,500 cheaper · claims take longer at our workshop</td></tr>
     <tr><td><span class="pill p-mute">3rd</span></td><td>HDFC Ergo</td><td>Comprehensive</td><td class="rt">₹7,60,000</td><td class="rt">₹18,900</td><td>Cheapest, but no zero depreciation and a lower IDV</td></tr>
    </table>
    <div class="note" style="margin-top:12px"><b>No margin figure appears anywhere.</b> The executive gets a ranking and the reason behind it. Commission is visible to the dealer admin alone.</div>
    <div class="anno" style="margin-top:12px"><span class="eyebrow">HOW THE RANKING IS BUILT</span>
     Margin is one input, never the only one. It is blended with cashless availability at this dealer's own workshop, claim settlement history and cover quality, <b>with the weighting set by the dealer admin.</b>
     <br><br>A purely margin-driven ranking always puts the most expensive policy first, and the executive loses the customer's trust inside a month. That costs the dealer more than the commission gains.</div>
   </div>
   <div class="split">
    <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>Policy history</h3>
     <div class="tl">

      <div class="tl-i ok"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Renewed with Bajaj Allianz</div><div class="xs mut">12 Sep 2025 · ₹20,100 · no claim</div></div>
      <div class="tl-i ok"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Renewed with Bajaj Allianz</div><div class="xs mut">12 Sep 2024 · ₹22,400 · one claim</div></div>
      <div class="tl-i"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Policy issued at delivery</div><div class="xs mut">12 Sep 2023 · sold by this dealership</div></div>
     </div></div></div>
    <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>Renewal cadence</h3>
     <table class="t">
      <tr><th>When</th><th>Channel</th><th>Status</th></tr>
      <tr><td>60 days before</td><td>WhatsApp utility</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Sent</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>30 days before</td><td>Call</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Due 13 Aug</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>15 days before</td><td>WhatsApp + call</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Scheduled</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>7 days before</td><td>Call</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Scheduled</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>1 day before</td><td>WhatsApp</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Scheduled</span></td></tr>
     </table>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">The cadence stops the moment the policy is renewed, and stops permanently if the customer withdraws permission.</div>
    </div></div>

     <b>No login.</b> A signed link that expires when the vehicle is delivered plus 30 days.<br><br>
     <b>Consent is asked here, once</b>, before any status is shown, and it covers delivery updates only. Service and offer messages need their own permission later.<br><br>

     <b>It names a human.</b> Every customer-facing surface names the person responsible, because the alternative is the customer calling the switchboard.<br><br>
     <b>It never hides a slip.</b> Telling a customer the truth on the 14th is survivable. Discovering it on the 18th is not.</div>

   </table>

  <div class="split">
   <div class="col"><div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">THE POINT OF THIS SCREEN</span>
    Every dealer group compares branches on <b>outcomes</b>, cars sold. So every review meeting becomes an argument about market conditions, and nothing changes.
    <br><br>Arth compares <b>process</b>. Kengeri's first response is 41 minutes against a group average of 23, and 32% of its enquiries go untouched for a day. That is not a market condition. That is one telecaller who resigned on 22 July and was never replaced, and it is now visible in a number the branch head cannot argue with.</div></div>

     <div class="tl-i now"><div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">04 Aug, no replacement hired</div><div class="xs mut">Estimated cost of the vacancy so far: ₹1,84,000 in lost bookings</div></div>

    <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:10px">A chain of events, not a dashboard. This is the difference between visibility and accountability.</div>

   <div class="col"><div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">THE AGENT PROPOSES, A HUMAN DISPOSES</span>
    A monthly agent checks manufacturer circulars, state tax slabs, insurance rates and bank rates, and proposes changes. <b>Nothing activates automatically.</b>
    <br><br>If a source cannot be read, the agent says so loudly rather than guessing, a silently failed parse that leaves a stale price on a quotation is far worse than no proposal at all.</div>
   </div>

<div class="view hidden" id="v-adv-tech">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>Advito · Engineering</h1><div class="sub">Health and errors · no customer data in the clear</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-mute">Engineering</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div class="mini" style="margin-bottom:16px">
   <div class="stat"><div class="v" style="color:var(--set)">99.97%</div><div class="l">Uptime, 30 days</div></div>
   <div class="stat"><div class="v">218ms</div><div class="l">API p95</div></div>
   <div class="stat"><div class="v">0.02%</div><div class="l">Error rate</div></div>
   <div class="stat"><div class="v" style="color:var(--brass-deep)">3</div><div class="l">Open incidents</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="box"><div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div><h3>Open items</h3>
   <div class="r over" style="cursor:default"><div class="r-m"><div class="r-t">WhatsApp template rejected by Meta, 2 tenants affected</div>
    <div class="r-s">Template "delivery_delay_v2" · policy change 02 Aug · fallback to v1 active</div></div>
    <span class="pill p-over">Action needed</span></div>
   <div class="r attn" style="cursor:default"><div class="r-m"><div class="r-t">Nightly reconciliation found 2 leads out of step</div>
    <div class="r-s">Rebuilt from the event log · reported only, never auto-corrected</div></div>
    <span class="pill p-attn">Investigating</span></div>
   <div class="r attn" style="cursor:default"><div class="r-m"><div class="r-t">Vehicle lookup provider slow, p95 at 4.1s</div>
    <div class="r-s">Threshold 2s · secondary provider ready to take traffic</div></div>
    <span class="pill p-attn">Watching</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="split">
   <div class="col"><div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">WHY RECONCILIATION RUNS IN PRODUCTION</span>
    A test against a fixture proves the events that exist add up. It cannot prove every write path emitted one. So a nightly job samples real leads per tenant, rebuilds each from its event log, and reports any that disagree.
    <br><br><b>It reports and never corrects.</b> A silent auto-correction would destroy the evidentiary value that is the entire point of the ledger.</div></div>
   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>Third-party watch</h3>
    <table class="t">
     <tr><th>Dependency</th><th>Status</th><th>Note</th></tr>
     <tr><td>Meta Marketing API</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Healthy</span></td><td>v23 · deprecates Feb 2027</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Google Data Manager API</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Healthy</span></td><td>Migrated off Ads API</td></tr>
     <tr><td>WhatsApp Cloud API</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Policy change</span></td><td>Template rules changed 02 Aug</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Vehicle records</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Slow</span></td><td>Secondary provider standing by</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Speech to text</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Healthy</span></td><td>Sampled 20% by default</td></tr>
    </table>
    <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">Platform versions deprecate on their schedule, not ours. This screen exists so that is a planned change rather than an outage.</div>
   </div></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

    <div class="cust-h"><div style="flex:1"><div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:9px"></div>
     <h2 style="font-size:20px">Ramesh Kumar</h2>
     <div class="sm mut">Grand Vitara enquiry · owned by you · consent: sales purpose, captured 01 Aug</div></div></div>
    <div class="box">
     <div style="background:var(--n05);border-radius:6px 6px 6px 2px;padding:11px 13px;max-width:76%;margin-bottom:9px">
      <div class="sm">Hello, thank you for your enquiry about the Grand Vitara. I am Ravi from Nagarbhavi Motors. When would be a good time to call?</div>
      <div class="xs mut mono" style="margin-top:5px">Utility template · 01 Aug 21:48 · delivered</div></div>
     <div style="background:var(--set-w);border-radius:6px 6px 2px 6px;padding:11px 13px;max-width:76%;margin-left:auto;margin-bottom:9px">
      <div class="sm">Ok send me the price</div>
      <div class="xs mut mono" style="margin-top:5px">04 Aug 09:12 · customer</div></div>
     <div class="note" style="margin:12px 0">This reply opens a 24-hour window in which you can send free-form messages without a template. Arth shows the window because messages outside it cost more and must be templated.</div>
     <div class="fld" style="margin:0"><textarea class="inp" rows="3" placeholder="Type a reply, window open for 23h 48m"></textarea></div>
     <div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:9px">
      <button class="btn sm" onclick="toast('Sent. Filed against the enquiry and visible to the team leader.')">Send</button>
      <button class="btn ghost sm" onclick="go('quote')">Attach quotation</button>
     </div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tc-x">
   <div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">THE NUMBER BELONGS TO THE DEALERSHIP</span>
    Once a number is on the official WhatsApp business system it stops working in the app on a handset. The executive chats from inside Arth. That sounds like a restriction, it is the entire point. When he resigns, the conversation stays.</div>
   <div class="eyebrow" style="margin:18px 0 8px">NUMBERS IN USE</div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Senior consultants</span><b>4 dedicated</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Telecalling floor</span><b>1 shared</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Service</span><b>1</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Insurance</span><b>1</b></div>
   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Campaigns</span><b>1</b></div>
   <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:8px">Eight numbers for 84 people. Meta charges per message, not per number, and a shared team inbox gets the same outcome as giving everyone one.</div>
   <div class="eyebrow" style="margin:18px 0 8px">OPT-OUT</div>
   <div class="sm mut">Deepa Shetty replied STOP three hours ago. She has been removed from calls, WhatsApp, SMS and from the advertising audience lists uploaded to Meta, automatically, within minutes, everywhere.</div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ SYSTEM STATES ============ -->
<div class="view hidden" id="v-states">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>System states</h1><div class="sub">The screens people meet on their first day and their worst day</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-mute">Reference</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr));gap:14px">
   <div class="box"><h3>Loading</h3>
    <div style="margin:12px 0"><div class="skel" style="width:62%;margin-bottom:8px"></div>
     <div class="skel" style="width:88%;margin-bottom:8px"></div><div class="skel" style="width:74%"></div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">Skeletons shaped like the content that is coming, never a spinner. Past three seconds, add a line saying what is being fetched.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>Empty, the good kind</h3>
    <div style="padding:20px 0;text-align:center">
     <div class="rule" style="width:36px;margin:0 auto 12px"></div>
     <div style="font-family:var(--disp);font-size:16px;font-weight:600">No enquiries are unassigned</div>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:3px">New ones appear here within a minute of arriving.</div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">States a fact and says what happens next. Never "Nothing to see here!", never an illustration.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>Error</h3>
    <div class="warn" style="margin:12px 0"><b>This enquiry was reassigned while you were editing.</b><br>
     It now belongs to S. Nayak. Your notes are saved as a draft.</div>
    <div class="xs mut">Says what happened, what it means, and what survived. No apology, no blame, no error code unless support needs it.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>No permission</h3>
    <div style="padding:16px 0">
     <div class="sm" style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Branch performance is visible to branch heads and above</div>
     <div class="xs mut">Ask Shalini Bhat if you need access.</div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">Names the person who can grant it. Never a bare error code, and never pretending the screen does not exist.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>Offline</h3>
    <div style="background:var(--ink);color:#fff;padding:11px 13px;border-radius:3px;margin:12px 0;font-size:12.5px">
     Working offline · 3 calls logged will send when you reconnect</div>
    <div class="xs mut">Work is never blocked. A telecaller in a basement showroom keeps working, and the queue syncs when signal returns.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>No results</h3>
    <div style="padding:16px 0">
     <div class="sm" style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">No leads match Whitefield · Fronx · this week</div>
     <div class="xs mut">Try removing "this week", that filter excludes 42 leads.</div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">Repeats the query back and offers the widest filter to drop, with the count it would recover.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>Partial data</h3>
    <div style="padding:12px 0"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between">
     <span class="sm">Cost per booking</span><b class="mono">₹9,200*</b></div>
     <div class="xs mut mono" style="margin-top:4px">*Google spend not yet synced for 03–04 Aug</div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">If a figure is incomplete, it says so beside itself. An incomplete number rendered as final is the fastest way to lose a dealer's trust.</div></div>

   <div class="box"><h3>Destructive confirmation</h3>
    <div style="padding:12px 0">
     <div class="sm" style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Close this enquiry as lost?</div>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-bottom:9px">A reason is required. The enquiry stays in the record permanently and can be reopened.</div>
     <div style="display:flex;gap:7px"><button class="btn danger sm">Mark lost</button><button class="btn ghost sm">Cancel</button></div></div>
    <div class="xs mut">Modals only for decisions that cannot be undone. Everything else is a drawer.</div></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ COMPONENTS ============ -->
<div class="view hidden" id="v-components">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>Component reference</h1><div class="sub">Every control in the product · anything not here goes through review</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-mute">For engineering</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div class="split">
   <div class="col">
    <div class="box"><h3>Buttons</h3>
     <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center">
      <button class="btn">Primary</button><button class="btn go">Call · primary action</button>
      <button class="btn ghost">Secondary</button><button class="btn quiet">Tertiary</button>
      <button class="btn danger">Destructive</button><button class="btn" disabled>Disabled</button></div>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:10px">One primary per screen region. <b>Five variants and no more:</b> Ink fill, Ink border, no border, Overdue fill for destruction, N20 fill for disabled.
          <br><br><b>Withdrawn 18 August:</b> a green action button. Settled is a semantic colour and semantic colour never decorates, so a green button would make green on a row read as clickable rather than as a fact. Ink fill measures 15.01:1 against the green's 6.83:1, which also settles the contrast failure that prompted it.</div></div>

    <div class="box"><h3>Status</h3>
     <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin-bottom:10px">
      <span class="pill p-over">Overdue</span><span class="pill p-attn">Review</span>
      <span class="pill p-ok">Settled</span><span class="pill p-mute">Draft</span><span class="pill p-ink">System</span></div>
     <div class="r over" style="cursor:default"><div class="r-m"><div class="r-t">Row with state</div>
      <div class="r-s">3px left border carries the state, never a filled row</div></div><span class="pill p-over">Overdue</span></div>
     <div class="xs mut">Every status carries a word as well as a colour. Roughly one in twelve Indian men has a colour vision deficiency, and this product is used by floors of forty.</div></div>

    <div class="box"><h3>Inputs</h3>
     <div class="fld"><label>Label always above, always visible</label><input class="inp" placeholder="Placeholders are examples, never labels">
      <div class="help xs mut" style="margin-top:4px">Help text says why the field exists, not what to type.</div></div>
     <div class="fld"><label>With an error</label><input class="inp" style="border-color:var(--over);border-width:1.5px" value="12 Aug 2026">
      <div class="xs" style="color:var(--over);margin-top:4px;font-weight:500">RTO is not complete before this date. Earliest achievable is 18 Aug.</div></div>
     <div class="savebar"><button class="btn" onclick="toast('Specimen only. On a real form this saves and the unsaved bar clears.')">Save</button>
      <button class="btn ghost" onclick="toast('Specimen only')">Discard</button>
      <div class="spacer"></div><span class="xs mut">Every form ends with a save bar in this position</span></div></div>
   </div>

   <div class="col">
    <div class="box"><h3>The rule, our structural device</h3>
     <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:8px"></div>
     <div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">72px section marker</div>
     <div style="height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin:16px 0 8px"></div>
     <div class="sm" style="font-weight:600">Full-width division</div>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:10px">The rule sits <b>above</b> a heading, never below. Devanagari hangs letters from a line; accounting rules a line before a total. Two lengths only, never dotted, never diagonal.</div></div>

    <div class="box"><h3>Numbers</h3>
     <table class="t">
      <tr><th>Item</th><th class="rt">Amount</th></tr>
      <tr><td>Ex-showroom</td><td class="rt">₹16,89,000</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Road tax</td><td class="rt">₹2,02,680</td></tr>
      <tr><td style="font-weight:700">Total</td><td class="rt" style="font-weight:700">₹19,42,400</td></tr>
     </table>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">Tabular figures everywhere, so columns align on the decimal. Indian grouping, ₹12,00,000, never ₹1,200,000. Totals in 700 weight, above the row. Source and period beneath every table.</div></div>

    <div class="box"><h3>Density</h3>
     <table class="t">
      <tr><th>Context</th><th>Text</th><th>Row</th><th>Used by</th></tr>
      <tr><td>Operational</td><td>14px</td><td>44–52px</td><td>Telecalling, service, delivery</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Management</td><td>16px</td><td>generous</td><td>Cockpit, reports</td></tr>
     </table>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">One global density for both is the most common mistake in dealer software. A telecaller wants 40 rows on screen; a dealer principal wants seven cards.</div></div>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ DISPOSITION MATRIX ============ -->
<div class="view hidden" id="v-disp">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>Disposition matrix</h1>
  <div class="sub">Every outcome of every contact · the source of truth the screens are built from</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-attn">Specification</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div class="anno" style="margin-bottom:16px"><span class="eyebrow">WHY THIS EXISTS</span>
   A review found that "postponed the purchase" sat under <b>Not interested</b> and asked for no callback date. That is not one bug, a postponement is a live lead with a future date, and filing it as lost is precisely the disposition fraud the screen was built to prevent.
   <br><br>Patching screens one at a time will keep producing these. This table is exhaustive: every outcome, what it demands, what it earns, where the lead moves, and what happens next. <b>The screens are generated from this, not the other way round.</b></div>

  <div class="box">
   <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
   <h3>Connected, the conversation happened</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Outcome</th><th>Required before saving</th><th class="rt">Base points</th><th>Stage moves to</th><th>Next action created</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Test drive booked</td><td>Slot, vehicle from available fleet</td><td class="rt">+8</td><td>Test drive</td><td>Reminder to customer 2h before · follow-up 2h after</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Showroom visit agreed</td><td>Date and time</td><td class="rt">+5</td><td>Qualified</td><td>Reminder day before · no-show check next morning</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Quotation requested</td><td>Model and variant</td><td class="rt">+4</td><td>Quotation</td><td>Quotation due in 4 working hours</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Wants finance details</td><td>Rough budget or tenure</td><td class="rt">+3</td><td>Qualified</td><td>F&amp;I desk task · callback in 1 day</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Wants exchange valuation</td><td>Current vehicle and registration</td><td class="rt">+3</td><td>Qualified</td><td>Used-car task · valuation due in 1 day</td></tr>
    <tr style="background:var(--brass-wash)"><td><b>Postponed the purchase</b></td><td><b>Revisit date required</b> · reason: funds, festival, model launch, personal</td><td class="rt">+1</td><td><b>Stays open, parked</b></td><td>Call on the revisit date</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Call again later</td><td>Date · must be within 14 days</td><td class="rt">+1</td><td>No change</td><td>Call on that date</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Asked to be contacted later today</td><td>Time</td><td class="rt">+1</td><td>No change</td><td>Call at that time</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="note" style="margin-top:11px"><b>Postponed is not lost.</b> It is a live lead with a future date, and it stays in the pipeline with its own filter. A lead postponed three times is flagged, but as a coaching signal, not a penalty.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
   <h3>Not connected, no conversation</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Outcome</th><th>Required</th><th class="rt">Points</th><th>Stage</th><th>Next action</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Ringing, no response</td><td>Nothing</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>No change</td><td>Retry in 3 hours · max 3 per day</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Busy</td><td>Nothing</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>No change</td><td>Retry in 1 hour</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Switched off or unreachable</td><td>Nothing</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>No change</td><td>Retry next day · WhatsApp sent instead</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Number does not exist</td><td>Second confirmation</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Invalid contact</td><td>Team leader reviews before it can be closed</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Wrong person answered</td><td>Nothing</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Invalid contact</td><td>Team leader reviews</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">A connection under 20 seconds counts as not connected. No points and no penalty either way, so dialling and hanging up gains nothing, and a genuinely unreachable customer costs the executive nothing.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
   <h3>Closed, the lead is dead</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Reason</th><th>Required</th><th class="rt">Points</th><th>Checked against</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Bought from another dealer</td><td>Which dealer · which model</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Recording · also feeds the competitive report</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Bought a different brand</td><td>Which brand</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Recording</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Price, we were too expensive</td><td>What they were quoted elsewhere</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Recording · feeds the pricing report</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Variant or colour not available</td><td>What they wanted</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Stock record</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Finance declined</td><td>Which financier</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>F&amp;I record</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Never a buyer, wrong enquiry</td><td>Free text</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Recording · counted against the source</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Asked not to be contacted</td><td>Nothing</td><td class="rt">0</td><td>Suppresses every channel immediately</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="warn" style="margin-top:11px"><b>Closing is never free.</b> Every reason demands a specific fact, all of them are compared against the recording, and repeated closures in a short window are flagged to the team leader. Protecting a conversion rate by killing hard leads is the oldest trick on a floor, and difficulty scoring removes the incentive entirely.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="split">
   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>Rules that apply to every outcome</h3>
    <ul class="tight">
     <li>Points are multiplied by the lead's difficulty band, see the difficulty screen.</li>
     <li>Any promise typed after the call becomes a tracked commitment with a deadline.</li>
     <li>Every outcome writes an event to the permanent record. Nothing is edited.</li>
     <li>A "call again" date more than 14 days out needs a reason, it is the most common way a dead lead is kept alive on paper.</li>
     <li>Nothing can be saved without an outcome. Skipping is not an option.</li>
    </ul></div></div>
   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>The same matrix, other departments</h3>
    <table class="t">
     <tr><th>Department</th><th>Outcome set</th></tr>
     <tr><td>Service</td><td>Booked · rescheduled · declined · no answer · wants pick-up</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Insurance</td><td>Renewed · quoted · comparing · renewed elsewhere · declined</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Used car</td><td>Valuation agreed · gap too wide · sold elsewhere · undecided</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Delivery</td><td>Step complete · blocked externally · blocked internally · customer unavailable</td></tr>
    </table>
    <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">Same engine, different outcome set per department. Adding a department means adding a matrix row set, configuration, not code.</div>
   </div></div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ DIFFICULTY SCORING ============ -->
<div class="view hidden" id="v-diff">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>Lead difficulty</h1>
  <div class="sub">Hard leads are worth more points · visible to managers only</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-attn">New, in scope</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div class="anno" style="margin-bottom:16px"><span class="eyebrow">THE PROBLEM IT SOLVES</span>
   Executives claim the hot leads and let the cold ones rot. Every points system in sales has this failure, and no amount of monitoring fixes it, the incentive is simply wrong.
   <br><br><b>If a cold lead is worth three times a hot one, working cold leads becomes the rational choice.</b> The dealer's conversion rate on cold and warm improves, which is where the unclaimed revenue in a dealership actually sits.</div>

  <div class="box">
   <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
   <h3>Four bands, computed by the system</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Band</th><th>Typically</th><th class="rt">Multiplier</th><th class="rt">A test drive is worth</th><th>Share of enquiries</th></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="pill p-ok">Hot</span></td><td>Walked in asking for a specific variant, or referred by an existing customer</td><td class="rt">×1.0</td><td class="rt">8 points</td><td>~12%</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="pill p-attn">Warm</span></td><td>Filled a form for one model, answered the first call</td><td class="rt">×1.5</td><td class="rt">12 points</td><td>~31%</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="pill p-over">Cold</span></td><td>Portal lead, three unanswered attempts, no model preference stated</td><td class="rt">×2.5</td><td class="rt">20 points</td><td>~44%</td></tr>
    <tr><td><span class="pill p-ink">Very cold</span></td><td>Revived after 60 days, or previously closed and reopened</td><td class="rt">×3.5</td><td class="rt">28 points</td><td>~13%</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="note" style="margin-top:11px">Multipliers are set by the dealer, not by us. A dealer with strong walk-in traffic will weight differently from one buying most of his enquiries.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="split">
   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>How the band is computed</h3>
    <table class="t">
     <tr><th>Signal</th><th>Effect</th></tr>
     <tr><td>Source, walk-in, referral, portal, cold database</td><td>Strongest single factor</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Whether they answered the first call</td><td>Answered early moves it warmer</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Attempts already made without contact</td><td>Each unanswered attempt moves it colder</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Whether a model or variant was stated</td><td>Specific interest moves it warmer</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Age of the enquiry at assignment</td><td>Older is colder</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Whether it was ever closed and reopened</td><td>Forces the coldest band</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Historical conversion for that source and model</td><td>Adjusts the whole band</td></tr>
    </table>
   </div></div>
   <div class="col">
    <div class="box" style="border-left:3px solid var(--over)"><h3>Two rules that make it safe</h3>
     <p class="sm" style="margin:0 0 10px"><b>1 · The system computes it. No manager can set it.</b> If a manager could, managers would inflate their own team's scores, and within two months the number would mean nothing.</p>
     <p class="sm" style="margin:0"><b>2 · It locks at assignment and never moves.</b> If difficulty could be revised after the outcome is known, it becomes a way to explain away failure, "that one was very cold" said after losing it.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="box"><h3>Who sees it</h3>
     <table class="t">
      <tr><th>Role</th><th>Sees the band</th><th>Sees the multiplier</th></tr>
      <tr><td>Executive</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">No</span></td><td><span class="pill p-mute">No</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>Team leader</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Yes</span></td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Yes</span></td></tr>
      <tr><td>Branch head and above</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Yes</span></td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Yes</span></td></tr>
     </table>
     <div class="xs mut" style="margin-top:9px">The executive sees his points move, not why. Expect the floor to try to reverse-engineer the bands, that is fine, because the only way to score is to genuinely work hard leads.</div>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>

  <div class="box"><h3>What a manager sees</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Executive</th><th class="rt">Hot</th><th class="rt">Warm</th><th class="rt">Cold</th><th class="rt">Very cold</th><th class="rt">Raw points</th><th class="rt">Weighted</th><th>Reading</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Ravi Shankar</td><td class="rt">18</td><td class="rt">44</td><td class="rt">61</td><td class="rt">19</td><td class="rt">412</td><td class="rt" style="color:var(--set);font-weight:600">784</td><td>Works the cold list properly</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Executive B</td><td class="rt">39</td><td class="rt">51</td><td class="rt">12</td><td class="rt">2</td><td class="rt">448</td><td class="rt" style="color:var(--over);font-weight:600">512</td><td>Cherry-picking, highest raw score, lowest effort</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Executive C</td><td class="rt">14</td><td class="rt">38</td><td class="rt">55</td><td class="rt">31</td><td class="rt">386</td><td class="rt" style="color:var(--set);font-weight:600">802</td><td>Best performer once difficulty is counted</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="note" style="margin-top:11px"><b>Read the last two rows.</b> On raw points Executive B looks like the best telecaller on the floor. Weighted, he is the worst, he took the easy leads and left the rest. Executive C looked mediocre for a year. This single table is what makes the difference visible.</div>
  </div>
 </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ ROLE INVENTORY ============ -->
<div class="view hidden" id="v-roles">
 <div class="topbar"><h1>Every role in a dealership</h1>
  <div class="sub">What each one gets, and what they deliberately do not get</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="pill p-attn">Specification</span></div>
 <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
  <div class="anno" style="margin-bottom:16px"><span class="eyebrow">THE DEFECT THIS FIXES</span>
   A review found roles borrowing other departments' screens. A service advisor clicked "Upgrades spotted" and landed in the full sales pipeline. That is not a menu bug. It means the role never had a workspace of its own, so the menu pointed somewhere else.
   <br><br><b>Every role listed as Full below gets its own screens.</b> No role opens another department's workspace, ever.</div>

  <div class="box">
   <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
   <h3>Sales side</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Role</th><th>Access level</th><th>Their day is</th><th>Built</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Telecaller (CRE)</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>A call queue, worked top to bottom</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Sales consultant</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Own enquiries, test drives, quotations</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Receptionist</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Capture arrivals, route them, answer the phone</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Sales team leader</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Assign, approve, unblock, coach</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>F&amp;I executive</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Finance files and insurance at the point of sale</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Delivery coordinator</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Every booked car and what is holding it up</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Sales admin (allocation)</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Task queue</span></td><td>Allocation and dispatch steps only</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>RTO clerk</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Task queue</span></td><td>Registration steps only</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Accessories coordinator</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Task queue</span></td><td>Order and fitment steps only</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>PDI supervisor</td><td><span class="pill p-attn">Task queue</span></td><td>Pre delivery checks only</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
   </table>
   <div class="note" style="margin-top:11px"><b>Task queue is not a lesser product, it is the right one.</b> An RTO clerk does one thing forty times a day. Giving him a full workspace with eleven menu items would guarantee he never opens it. He gets a single list, big rows, and a done button.</div>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
   <h3>Service side</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Role</th><th>Access level</th><th>Their day is</th><th>Built</th></tr>

    <tr><td>Service telecaller</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Service due calls and post service follow up</td><td>Shares the call queue, own outcome set</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Workshop manager</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Bay capacity, technician load, escalations</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Parts coordinator</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Read only</span></td><td>Sees what jobs need which parts. Stock lives in the DMS</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Technician</td><td><span class="pill p-over">No access</span></td><td>Works from a printed job card. A tablet app is a later decision</td><td>No</td></tr>
   </table>
  </div>

  <div class="box">
   <h3>Other departments and management</h3>
   <table class="t">
    <tr><th>Role</th><th>Access level</th><th>Their day is</th><th>Built</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Insurance executive</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Renewals by expiry date</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Used car evaluator</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Valuations, and the gap that loses deals</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Used car sales</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Stock and enquiries. Same shape as sales consultant</td><td>Shares the sales workspace</td></tr>

    <tr><td>Dealer principal</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>Decisions, money, and the weekly review</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Dealer admin</td><td><span class="pill p-ok">Full</span></td><td>People, prices, settings, billing</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Marketing head</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Read only</span></td><td>Attribution and campaign reports</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Accounts</td><td><span class="pill p-mute">Read only</span></td><td>Payouts, commissions, discount reports</td><td>Yes</td></tr>
    <tr><td>HR</td><td><span class="pill p-over">Later</span></td><td>Attendance and incentives. Not in this cycle</td><td>No</td></tr>
   </table>
  </div>

  <div class="split">
   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>The count</h3>

   <div class="col"><div class="box"><h3>Two rules for every role</h3>
    <p class="sm" style="margin:0 0 9px"><b>1. No role opens another department's workspace.</b> If a service advisor needs to know something about sales, sales sends him that one fact. He is never given the sales screen.</p>
    <p class="sm" style="margin:0"><b>2. Every role has a home screen that answers "what do I do now".</b> If the answer for a role is a single list, that list is the whole product for them. A workspace that needs explaining will not be used.</p>

<div class="view hidden" id="v-discount">
 <div class="topbar">
  <button class="btn quiet" onclick="go('quote')"><svg class="ic" style="transform:rotate(180deg)"><use href="#i-chev"/></svg></button>
  <h1>Discount above scheme</h1><span class="pill p-over">Needs approval</span>
  <div class="sub">Ramesh Kumar, Grand Vitara ZXi+ AT</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div><span class="xs mut" id="dSaved">Draft saved 11:42</span></div>
 <div class="body-area">
  <div class="scroll" style="padding:18px 22px;background:var(--n05)">
   <div class="box">
    <div class="rule" style="margin-bottom:10px"></div>
    <h3>The request</h3>
    <table class="t">
     <tr><th>Item</th><th>Approved scheme</th><th>Requested</th><th class="rt">Difference</th></tr>
     <tr><td>Festive exchange bonus</td><td>₹25,000</td><td>₹25,000</td><td class="rt">nil</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Corporate discount</td><td>₹15,000</td><td>₹15,000</td><td class="rt">nil</td></tr>
     <tr><td>Additional dealer discount</td><td>₹0</td><td>₹18,000</td><td class="rt" style="color:var(--over);font-weight:600">₹18,000</td></tr>
     <tr><td style="font-weight:700">Margin on this deal after discount</td><td></td><td></td><td class="rt" style="font-weight:700">₹31,400</td></tr>
    </table>
   </div>

   <div class="box" style="border-left:3px solid var(--brass)">
    <h3>Why you are asking, in your own words</h3>
    <p class="sm mut" style="margin:0 0 12px">This goes on the permanent record with your name against it. Your manager reads this and nothing else, so it has to stand on its own.</p>

    <div class="fld"><label>What is the situation</label>
     <textarea class="inp" rows="3">Customer has a written quote from another Nexa dealer at ₹19,38,000 on road. He showed it to me on his phone. He is in the showroom now with his wife and wants to book today.</textarea></div>

    <div class="fld"><label>Why this customer is worth it</label>
     <textarea class="inp" rows="3">His wife has serviced a Swift with us six times since 2019. If he buys elsewhere we lose the service customer too. He has also agreed to exchange the Swift with us, which we value at ₹4,10,000 against a market of ₹4,45,000.</textarea></div>

    <div class="fld"><label>What you expect to happen if this is approved</label>
     <textarea class="inp" rows="3">He books today at ₹19,52,400. Exchange gives us a Swift with full service history that should retail within 25 days. Insurance and extended warranty both go through us, and the household stays with us for service.</textarea></div>

    <div class="fld"><label>What happens if it is refused</label>
     <textarea class="inp" rows="2">He goes to the other dealer this evening. I would put the chance of losing him at about 70 percent.</textarea></div>

    <div class="fld"><label>What else you tried first</label>
     <select class="inp"><option>Offered accessories instead of cash discount, refused</option>
      <option>Offered extended warranty instead, refused</option>
      <option>Offered a higher exchange value, refused</option>
      <option>Nothing else tried</option></select></div>

    <div class="warn"><b>You are bound by what you have written.</b> If this is approved and the deal does not close, this request is reviewed against what actually happened. Repeatedly overstating the risk of losing a customer is visible over time and it costs your credibility on the next request.</div>

    <div class="savebar">
     <button class="btn" onclick="toast('Sent to Shalini Bhat. She has 2 hours before it escalates to the branch head.')">Send for approval</button>
     <button class="btn ghost" onclick="markSaved('dSaved')">Save draft</button>
     <button class="btn quiet" onclick="go('quote')">Cancel</button>
     <div class="spacer"></div>
     <span class="xs mut">Approvals above 20 percent need a second signature</span>
    </div>
   </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tc-x">
   <div class="anno"><span class="eyebrow">WHY WRITING IT MATTERS</span>
    Today a discount is agreed on WhatsApp or shouted across a floor, and the dealership finds out what it actually gave away at month end.
    <br><br>Asking the consultant to write the case does three things. The manager can decide in thirty seconds instead of asking questions. The reasoning is on the record if the deal is queried later. And the consultant is bound by his own words, which quietly stops the weakest requests from ever being sent.</div>

   <div class="kv"><span class="mut">Approved</span><b>5</b></div>
