.eyebrow{
  font-family:var(--body);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);
  margin:0 0 10px;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;margin:0;line-height:1.15;
  font-variation-settings:"wdth" 100}
h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.6vw,42px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{font-size:22px;margin-bottom:8px}
h4{font-size:15px;font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.01em}
p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:66ch}
.lede{font-size:19px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--n80);max-width:62ch}
.small{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--n60);line-height:1.55}
.mono{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.01em;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
em{font-style:italic}

section{padding:76px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--n10)}
section:first-of-type{border-top:none}
.sec-head{margin-bottom:40px}
.num{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;color:var(--brass);
  letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}

/* ===== COVER ===== */
.cover{background:var(--ink);color:var(--n05);padding:0;border:none}
.cover .wrap{padding-top:100px;padding-bottom:88px}
.logo-lockup{display:inline-block;position:relative;padding-top:18px}
.logo-lockup::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;
  height:4px;background:var(--brass);
  transform-origin:left;animation:draw .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}
@keyframes draw{from{transform:scaleX(0)}to{transform:scaleX(1)}}
.logo-word{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;
  font-variation-settings:"wdth" 90;
  font-size:clamp(76px,12vw,150px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:.005em;
  color:var(--n00);display:block}
.cover-sub{margin-top:30px;font-size:19px;color:var(--brass-lift);max-width:52ch}
.cover-meta{margin-top:52px;color:#7FA0A9;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.devanagari{font-family:"Anek Devanagari",serif;font-size:44px;color:#7FA0A9;
  font-weight:400;margin-top:8px;display:block}

/* ===== GRID HELPERS ===== */
.grid{display:grid;gap:22px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
@media(max-width:900px){.g3,.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:620px){.g2,.g3,.g4{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wrap{padding:0 20px}}

.card{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:24px}
.card--ink{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--n05)}
.card--ink h3,.card--ink h4{color:var(--n00)}
.card--ink .small{color:#9FB6BD}

/* ===== COLOUR ===== */
.sw{border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--n10);
  background:var(--n00)}
.sw-chip{height:110px;display:block}
.sw-body{padding:14px 16px 16px}
.sw-name{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;margin-bottom:2px}
.sw-hex{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;color:var(--n60);
  text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.sw-role{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45}

.ramp{display:flex;border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--n10)}
.ramp div{flex:1;height:64px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;
  padding-bottom:6px;font-family:var(--data);font-size:9.5px}

/* ===== TYPE SPECIMEN ===== */
.spec{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:28px}
.spec-line{font-family:var(--display);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.1;
  margin-bottom:6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.scale-row{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;padding:14px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10)}
.scale-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.scale-tag{font-family:var(--data);font-size:11px;color:var(--n60);
  min-width:132px;flex-shrink:0}

table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px}
th{text-align:left;font-weight:600;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);padding:0 12px 10px 0;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
td{padding:11px 12px 11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);
  vertical-align:top;color:var(--n80)}
td:first-child{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.num-cell{font-family:var(--data);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}

/* ===== DO / DON'T ===== */
.dd{border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:20px 22px;border:1px solid}
.do{background:var(--settled-wash);border-color:#BBD7CB}
.dont{background:var(--overdue-wash);border-color:#E5C3BD}
.dd-tag{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:10px}
.do .dd-tag{color:var(--settled)}
.dont .dd-tag{color:var(--overdue)}
.dd p{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--n90)}
.dd p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ===== UI DEMO ===== */
.demo{background:var(--n05);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:22px}
.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--n00);
  border:1px solid var(--n10);border-left:3px solid var(--n20);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:14px 16px;margin-bottom:10px}
.row--attn{border-left-color:var(--brass)}
.row--over{border-left-color:var(--overdue)}
.row--ok{border-left-color:var(--settled)}
.row-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.row-t{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
.row-s{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60)}
.row-v{font-family:var(--data);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  font-weight:500;font-size:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px}
.pill-over{background:var(--overdue-wash);color:var(--overdue)}
.pill-ok{background:var(--settled-wash);color:var(--settled)}
.pill-attn{background:var(--brass-wash);color:#7A5716}

.btn{display:inline-block;font-family:var(--body);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;
  padding:10px 20px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);border:1px solid var(--ink);
  background:var(--ink);color:var(--n00);text-decoration:none}
.btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:2px}

.logo-tile{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);
  padding:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:150px}
.logo-tile--ink{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.logo-tile--brass{background:var(--brass);border-color:var(--brass)}

.mark{display:inline-block;position:relative;padding-top:9px;align-self:flex-start;width:fit-content}
.mark::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;
  background:currentColor}
.mark span{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;
  font-variation-settings:"wdth" 90;font-size:42px;line-height:.95;
  letter-spacing:.01em;display:block}

.icon-sq{width:74px;height:74px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--ink);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.icon-sq .mark{color:var(--brass)}
.icon-sq .mark span{font-size:34px;color:var(--n00)}

blockquote{margin:0;padding:22px 26px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--n00);
  border-radius:var(--r-md);font-family:var(--display);font-size:21px;
  line-height:1.4;font-weight:500}

.footer{background:var(--ink);color:#7FA0A9;padding:40px 0;font-size:12.5px;
  letter-spacing:.03em;border:none}
ul.tight{margin:0;padding-left:18px}
ul.tight li{margin-bottom:7px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--n80)}
code{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12.5px;background:var(--n10);
  padding:1px 5px;border-radius:2px;color:var(--n90)}
pre{background:var(--ink-deep);color:#CBD9DC;padding:20px;border-radius:var(--r-md);
  overflow-x:auto;font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ COVER ============ -->
<section class="cover">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="logo-lockup"><span class="logo-word">arth</span></div>
    <span class="devanagari">अर्थ</span>
    <p class="cover-sub">Brand Guide, Volume 1: Core — the identity system for the enquiry accountability platform for automobile dealer groups. Read with Volume 2: Application.</p>
    <div class="cover-meta">ADVITO GLOBAL · INTERNAL · VERSION 1.1 · AUGUST 2026 · AUDITED</div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 01 THE NAME ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">01</span><h2>The name is the strategy</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div>
        <p class="lede">अर्थ — <em>artha</em> — is one of the four Puruṣārthas of Sanātana Dharma. It is the pillar concerned with material prosperity and the means of livelihood, earned by legitimate means.</p>
        <p>The word carries two senses at once: <strong>meaning</strong>, and <strong>wealth</strong>. A dealership's enquiry data has always had both and delivered neither — thousands of records that mean nothing and produce no traceable money.</p>
        <p>This is not decoration on top of a software product. It is the product's thesis, and it should govern every design decision in this book. Arth exists to give a dealer's numbers <em>meaning</em>, and to trace them to <em>wealth</em>.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%">
        <h3 style="font-size:19px">What follows from the name</h3>
        <ul class="tight" style="margin-top:14px">
          <li style="color:#C4D5D9"><strong style="color:#fff">Legitimacy matters.</strong> Artha is wealth earned properly. Arth records who did the work, honestly, and will not flatter anyone.</li>
          <li style="color:#C4D5D9"><strong style="color:#fff">Purpose over activity.</strong> Forty calls is activity. One delivered car is artha.</li>
          <li style="color:#C4D5D9"><strong style="color:#fff">Permanence.</strong> A record that can be quietly rewritten has no meaning. Nothing in Arth is silently edited.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 02 VISION / MISSION ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">02</span><h2>Vision, mission, position</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card sr"><h3>Vision</h3>
        <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;color:var(--n80)">An Indian automobile retail industry where no rupee of marketing spend is untraceable, no enquiry is unowned, and no promise made to a customer is unrecorded.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>Mission</h3>
        <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;color:var(--n80)">To connect the money leaving a dealer's bank account to the car leaving his showroom — and to name who was responsible at every step in between.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>Position</h3>
        <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;color:var(--n80)">The enquiry accountability system for dealer groups. Not a CRM. A CRM reports what happened; Arth holds people to account for it.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div style="margin-top:26px">
      <blockquote>Other systems tell you your telecaller made forty calls. Arth tells you those forty calls cost ₹9,200 and produced one delivered car.</blockquote>
      <p class="small" style="margin-top:10px">The single line that should survive every rewrite of our marketing. If a piece of communication does not eventually arrive at this idea, it is off-brand.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 03 PRINCIPLES ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">03</span><h2>Five design principles</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">These decide arguments. When a design choice is contested, the principle higher on this list wins.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card sr"><h3>1. Evidence, not assertion</h3>
        <p class="small">Every claim carries its number, its source and its date. We do not use superlatives we cannot substantiate. Visually this means data is never decorated — no gradients on charts, no 3D, no glow.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>2. Silence when nothing is wrong</h3>
        <p class="small">A screen covered in coloured alerts trains people to ignore alerts. Arth shows what needs a decision and stays quiet otherwise. Colour is a scarce resource, spent only where money is at stake.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>3. Permanence over polish</h3>
        <p class="small">The interface should feel like a bound ledger, not a dashboard. Rules and edges rather than shadows and float. Nothing should look like it could be swiped away.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>4. Built here, for here</h3>
        <p class="small">Indian scripts are first-class, never an afterthought bolted onto a Latin design. Rupees, lakhs and crores are native units. The vernacular of the showroom floor is our vocabulary.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>5. Respect the operator</h3>
        <p class="small">A telecaller looks at this for nine hours. A dealer principal looks at it for ninety seconds. Both deserve a screen built for their actual day — high legibility, low fatigue, no cleverness.</p></div>
      <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%"><h3>The tiebreaker</h3>
        <p class="small">When two principles conflict, ask which choice a sceptical dealer principal would call honest. Arth's whole commercial position rests on being the vendor that does not flatter. Losing that costs more than any feature gains.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 04 THE MARK ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">04</span><h2>The mark</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">A wordmark with a rule across the top. One stroke, carrying two traditions.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="align-items:start">
      <div>
        <p><strong>In Devanagari, every letter hangs from a horizontal line</strong> — the <em>shirorekha</em>. It is the script's defining feature: the line comes first, and the letters are suspended from it.</p>
        <p><strong>In accounting, a total is ruled.</strong> A single line under a figure means it is summed; a double rule means it is final and closed.</p>
        <p>Arth's mark applies the shirorekha to Latin letters. The word <em>arth</em> is set in lowercase and hangs from a solid rule. It reads simultaneously as a Devanagari construction, a ledger total, and the beam of a weighing scale.</p>
        <p class="small">It is deliberately not a symbol. A dealer principal has been shown a hundred abstract swooshes. A ruled word looks like a document, which is exactly what Arth is.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="grid g2" style="gap:16px">
        <div class="logo-tile"><span class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="color:var(--ink)">arth</span></span></div>
        <div class="logo-tile logo-tile--ink"><span class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="color:#fff">arth</span></span></div>
        <div class="logo-tile logo-tile--brass"><span class="mark" style="color:var(--ink)"><span style="color:var(--ink)">arth</span></span></div>
        <div class="logo-tile"><div class="icon-sq"><span class="mark"><span>a</span></span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:34px">
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Construction</h4>
        <p class="small">Anek Latin SemiBold, width axis 90. The rule is 7% of the cap height, sits at 0.22× cap height above the x-height line, and spans the full advance width of the word — never wider, never narrower.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Clear space</h4>
        <p class="small">Minimum clear space on all four sides equals the height of the letter <code>a</code>. Nothing enters this area — no tagline, no rule, no edge of a photograph.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Minimum sizes</h4>
        <p class="small">Wordmark: 22&nbsp;px on screen, 16&nbsp;mm in print. Below that the rule breaks up — use the square monogram instead. Monogram: 16&nbsp;px minimum.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:22px">
      <div class="dd do"><div class="dd-tag">Correct</div>
        <p>Ink on light, white on Ink, Ink on Brass.</p>
        <p>Rule always Brass on light and dark backgrounds; Ink when the field is Brass.</p>
        <p>Always lowercase, always with the rule. The rule is not optional — it is the mark.</p></div>
      <div class="dd dont"><div class="dd-tag">Never</div>
        <p>Never set in capitals, never in another typeface, never italic.</p>
        <p>Never add a gradient, shadow, outline, bevel or glow.</p>
        <p>Never place on a photograph without a solid Ink panel behind it.</p>
        <p>Never stretch, rotate, or change the rule's weight or width.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 05 COLOUR ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">05</span><h2>Colour</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Two brand colours, one neutral ramp, two semantic states. Deliberately small — a palette this restricted is what makes a single Brass mark on a screen mean something.</p></div>

    <h4 style="margin-bottom:16px">Core</h4>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="sw"><span class="sw-chip" style="background:#0F2A33"></span>
        <div class="sw-body"><div class="sw-name">Ink</div><div class="sw-hex">#0F2A33</div>
          <p class="sw-role">The primary. Ledger ink — a deep petrol that is neither corporate navy nor harsh black. All headings, all body text, all primary surfaces. If in doubt, use Ink.</p></div></div>
      <div class="sw"><span class="sw-chip" style="background:#B07F2C"></span>
        <div class="sw-body"><div class="sw-name">Brass</div><div class="sw-hex">#B07F2C · text #8F6620</div>
          <p class="sw-role">The accent. The brass of a shop weighing scale and a temple vessel — prosperity, measurement, <em>artha</em>. Means one thing only: <strong>money is at stake here, look.</strong></p></div></div>
      <div class="sw"><span class="sw-chip" style="background:#2E5C68"></span>
        <div class="sw-body"><div class="sw-name">Slate</div><div class="sw-hex">#2E5C68</div>
          <p class="sw-role">Structural secondary. Eyebrows, labels, secondary rules, chart series two. Never used for large fills — it is a supporting voice, not a brand colour.</p></div></div>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 16px">Neutrals — desaturated Ink, never pure grey</h4>
    <div class="ramp">
      <div style="background:#FFFFFF;color:#6B7C80">00</div>
      <div style="background:#F1F4F4;color:#6B7C80">05</div>
      <div style="background:#E3E9E9;color:#6B7C80">10</div>
      <div style="background:#C9D3D4;color:#263D45">20</div>
      <div style="background:#9FADB0;color:#0F2A33">40</div>
      <div style="background:#6B7C80;color:#fff">60</div>
      <div style="background:#47585D;color:#fff">80</div>
      <div style="background:#263D45;color:#fff">90</div>
    </div>
    <p class="small" style="margin-top:12px">Every neutral is Ink with saturation removed, so the whole system shares one hue family. Pure or warm greys are off-brand — they make Brass look dirty.</p>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 16px">Semantic — only two states</h4>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="sw"><span class="sw-chip" style="background:#B23B2E"></span>
        <div class="sw-body"><div class="sw-name">Overdue</div><div class="sw-hex">#B23B2E</div>
          <p class="sw-role">A commitment has been broken — an SLA breached, a delivery date missed, a lead untouched past its window. Deep lac red, not emergency red. Used rarely enough that it still startles.</p></div></div>
      <div class="sw"><span class="sw-chip" style="background:#27735A"></span>
        <div class="sw-body"><div class="sw-name">Settled</div><div class="sw-hex">#27735A</div>
          <p class="sw-role">Confirmed, delivered, closed, paid. Deep verdant, never a bright SaaS green. Confirmation should feel like a stamp, not a celebration.</p></div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:26px">
      <h3>Why there is no amber warning state</h3>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;line-height:1.6">Most operational software uses a red / amber / green traffic light. Within weeks every screen is half amber and the signal is worthless — which is the exact failure the Exception Cockpit was designed to avoid.</p>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:0">Arth expresses urgency through <strong style="color:#fff">position and weight</strong> — what is at the top of the list, and how heavily it is set — not through a third colour. Where a "needs attention" signal is genuinely required, it is <strong style="color:var(--brass-lift)">Brass</strong>, which unifies accent and warning under one honest meaning: <em>there is money here.</em></p>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 16px">Usage rules</h4>
    <table>
      <tr><th>Rule</th><th>Detail</th></tr>
      <tr><td>Brass is never body text</td><td>Measured 3.55:1 on white — below the 4.5:1 floor. Brass is for rules, fills, icons, single figures and the mark only. Where brass must carry a word, use Brass Deep #8F6620 (5.14:1). See Volume 2 §00.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>The 90/8/2 split</td><td>Roughly 90% neutral, 8% Ink, 2% Brass on any screen. If Brass occupies more than a fiftieth of a layout, something is wrong.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Semantic colour never decorates</td><td>Overdue and Settled appear only where they state a fact about a record. They are never used for visual interest, category coding or charts.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>No gradients, anywhere</td><td>Not in the UI, not in charts, not in marketing. A ledger does not have gradients.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Contrast floor</td><td>4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for interface elements and chart strokes. Ink on N05 measures 13.57:1 and white on Ink 15.01:1 — both AAA. Every pairing in the system is measured in Volume 2 §09.</td></tr>
    </table>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 06 TYPOGRAPHY ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">06</span><h2>Typography</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Three faces, three jobs. All open source, all free to embed, all with genuine Indic support.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Display — Anek Latin</h4>
        <p class="small">Ek Type, Mumbai. A ten-script superfamily where Devanagari, Kannada and Latin were designed <em>simultaneously</em> rather than matching Indic to a pre-made Latin. Headings, the mark, large figures. Width axis 90 for headings, 100 for everything else.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Interface — IBM Plex Sans</h4>
        <p class="small">Body copy, labels, buttons, tables. Engineered rather than friendly, with excellent tabular figures and long-session legibility. Weights 400 / 500 / 600 only — never 300, never 800.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Data — IBM Plex Mono</h4>
        <p class="small">Chassis numbers, enquiry IDs, timestamps, audit entries, amounts in dense tables. The ledger voice. Anything a person might read aloud to verify a record is set in Mono.</p></div>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 14px">Specimen</h4>
    <div class="spec">
      <div class="spec-line" style="font-size:clamp(34px,6vw,66px);font-weight:600;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 90">Cost per booking</div>
      <div class="spec-line" style="font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,44px);font-weight:500">Every enquiry has an owner</div>
      <div class="spec-line" style="font-size:clamp(20px,3vw,30px);font-weight:400;color:var(--n80)">and a clock running against it</div>
      <p style="font-family:var(--data);font-size:22px;margin:20px 0 0;color:var(--brass);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">₹9,200 · 1,000 → 33 · KA-01-AB-1234</p>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 14px">Multi-script — one voice across three scripts</h4>
    <div class="spec">
      <div style="font-family:'Anek Latin';font-size:38px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">Enquiry accountability</div>
      <div style="font-family:'Anek Devanagari';font-size:38px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px">पूछताछ की जवाबदेही</div>
      <div style="font-family:'Anek Kannada';font-size:38px;font-weight:600">ವಿಚಾರಣೆಯ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ</div>
      <p class="small" style="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0">Kannada ships first, then Hindi. Because all three scripts share one skeleton, a screen switched to Kannada keeps its typographic voice instead of looking like a translation.</p>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin:36px 0 14px">Type scale</h4>
    <div class="card">
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">Display / 44 / 600 / w90</span><span style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:44px;font-weight:600;font-variation-settings:'wdth' 90">Page title</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">H2 / 28 / 600</span><span style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:28px;font-weight:600">Section heading</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">H3 / 20 / 600</span><span style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:20px;font-weight:600">Card heading</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">Body / 16 / 400</span><span style="font-size:16px">Default reading size for prose</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">UI / 14 / 400–600</span><span style="font-size:14px">Interface default — tables, forms, buttons</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">Caption / 12.5 / 400</span><span style="font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60)">Secondary detail and helper text</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">Eyebrow / 11 / 600 / .16em</span><span style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate)">Category label</span></div>
      <div class="scale-row"><span class="scale-tag">Data / Mono 12.5</span><span class="mono">ENQ-2026-08-004417 · 04 Aug 2026, 11:42</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:22px">
      <div class="dd do"><div class="dd-tag">Always</div>
        <p><strong>Tabular lining figures on every number.</strong> <code>font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums</code>. Columns of rupees must align on the decimal or the table is unreadable.</p>
        <p>Indian digit grouping: ₹12,00,000 — never ₹1,200,000.</p>
        <p>Sentence case for headings and buttons.</p></div>
      <div class="dd dont"><div class="dd-tag">Never</div>
        <p>Never all-caps for anything longer than a three-word eyebrow.</p>
        <p>Never a fourth typeface. Never Inter, Poppins, Montserrat or Roboto.</p>
        <p>Never letter-spacing on body text, and never negative tracking below 20px.</p>
        <p>Never italic in the interface — italics are for prose only.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 07 THE RULE ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">07</span><h2>The rule — our structural device</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div>
        <p class="lede">The same stroke that sits above the wordmark organises every layout. A 2px Brass rule sits <strong>above</strong> a heading, never below it.</p>
        <p>Almost every brand underlines. Arth overlines, because that is what Devanagari does and what a ledger does before a total is entered. It is a small inversion, and it makes a page recognisable at a glance from across a room.</p>
        <p class="small"><strong>Rules:</strong> 2px, Brass on light surfaces, Brass on Ink, Ink on Brass. Length is either 72px for a section marker or 100% of the column for a full division. Never any other length, never diagonal, never dotted, never a gradient.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <div class="sr" style="--w:72px;margin-bottom:30px"><span class="num">SECTION MARKER</span><h3>72px rule</h3><p class="small" style="margin:0">Used above section and card headings.</p></div>
        <div class="sr sr--full" style="margin-bottom:30px"><h3>Full-width rule</h3><p class="small" style="margin:0">Used above major divisions and dark panels.</p></div>
        <div class="sr sr--ink" style="--w:72px"><h3>Ink rule</h3><p class="small" style="margin:0">Used where Brass would be too loud, or above table headers.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 08 UI APPLICATION ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">08</span><h2>The interface</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">The Exception Cockpit, shown in the system. Note how little colour is present — and how much the little that is present says.</p></div>

    <div class="demo">
      <div class="sr" style="--w:72px;margin-bottom:18px">
        <span class="num">TODAY · NAGARBHAVI GROUP</span>
        <h3 style="font-family:var(--display)">7 things need a decision</h3>
      </div>

      <div class="row row--over">
        <div class="row-main">
          <div class="row-t">7 bookings past promised delivery</div>
          <div class="row-s">Blocking: RTO desk (5), finance disbursement (2)</div>
        </div>
        <span class="pill pill-over">Overdue</span>
        <span class="row-v">₹4,20,000</span>
      </div>

      <div class="row row--attn">
        <div class="row-main">
          <div class="row-t">Creative C3 — Festive Offer</div>
          <div class="row-s">₹38,000 spent, 0 bookings in 21 days · portfolio average 1 per ₹9,400</div>
        </div>
        <span class="pill pill-attn">Review</span>
        <span class="row-v">₹38,000</span>
      </div>

      <div class="row row--attn">
        <div class="row-main">
          <div class="row-t">11 enquiries, no contact</div>
          <div class="row-s">Whitefield · all assigned to R. Kumar · all over 48 hours</div>
        </div>
        <span class="pill pill-attn">Reassign</span>
        <span class="row-v">₹1,01,200</span>
      </div>

      <div class="row row--ok">
        <div class="row-main">
          <div class="row-t">Saturday workshop rebalanced</div>
          <div class="row-s">14 jobs moved to Tuesday · capacity now 88%</div>
        </div>
        <span class="pill pill-ok">Settled</span>
        <span class="row-v">—</span>
      </div>

      <div style="margin-top:20px;display:flex;gap:10px">
        <a href="#" class="btn">Open the queue</a>
        <a href="#" class="btn btn--ghost">Send to branch heads</a>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-top:26px">
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Corners</h4><p class="small">3px on controls, 5px on containers. Not zero — that reads as a spreadsheet. Not 12px — that reads as a consumer app.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Elevation</h4><p class="small">Borders, not shadows. One 1px N10 border. Shadow is permitted only on genuinely floating layers — modals and menus.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Density</h4><p class="small">Operational screens are dense: 14px text, 44px rows. Management screens breathe. Never one setting for both.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Status marker</h4><p class="small">A 3px left border on a row carries state. Never fill an entire row with a semantic colour.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 09 DATA ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">09</span><h2>Numbers and charts</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Arth is a numbers product. How figures are set matters more here than in almost any other brand decision.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Table conventions</h4>
        <table>
          <tr><th>Campaign</th><th style="text-align:right">Spend</th><th style="text-align:right">Bookings</th><th style="text-align:right">Cost / booking</th></tr>
          <tr><td>Grand Vitara — Search</td><td class="num-cell">₹1,84,000</td><td class="num-cell">20</td><td class="num-cell">₹9,200</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Brezza — Meta lead form</td><td class="num-cell">₹96,200</td><td class="num-cell">13</td><td class="num-cell">₹7,400</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Festive Offer — C3</td><td class="num-cell">₹38,000</td><td class="num-cell">0</td><td class="num-cell" style="color:var(--overdue);font-weight:600">₹38,000</td></tr>
        </table>
        <p class="small" style="margin-top:14px;margin-bottom:0">Numbers right-aligned and tabular. Header underscored with a 2px Ink rule. Semantic colour used on exactly one figure — the one that is wrong.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card">
        <h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Chart rules</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li>Ink is series one. Slate is series two. Brass is <em>only</em> the series being argued about.</li>
          <li>No gridlines unless the reader must compare across a gap. No axis lines heavier than 1px N20.</li>
          <li>Label the bars directly. A legend is an admission that the chart failed.</li>
          <li>Never a pie chart, never a donut, never a gauge, never 3D.</li>
          <li>Always state the period and the source beneath the chart, in Mono.</li>
          <li>Zero baseline always. A truncated axis is dishonest, and honesty is the entire brand.</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 10 VOICE ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">10</span><h2>Voice</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Arth speaks the way a good auditor speaks: precise, unhurried, unimpressed, and never unkind.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g4">
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Plain</h4><p class="small">Short sentences. Ordinary words. If a dealer principal would not use the word, we do not use it.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Specific</h4><p class="small">"₹4.2 lakh at risk across 7 bookings" — never "several issues detected".</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Direct</h4><p class="small">We say what is wrong and who owns it. We do not soften a number to protect anyone.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Never smug</h4><p class="small">Arth reports failures without commentary. No congratulation, no scolding, no exclamation marks.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:24px">
      <div class="dd do"><div class="dd-tag">We write</div>
        <p>"11 enquiries at Whitefield have had no contact for over 48 hours."</p>
        <p>"This campaign has spent ₹38,000 and produced no bookings in 21 days."</p>
        <p>"Delivery moved to 22 August. Finance disbursement is pending."</p>
        <p>"You cannot reduce this plan below the tenant's current usage."</p></div>
      <div class="dd dont"><div class="dd-tag">We never write</div>
        <p>"Oops! Something went wrong 😕"</p>
        <p>"Supercharge your dealership with AI-powered insights!"</p>
        <p>"Great job team — you're crushing it this month!"</p>
        <p>"Leverage our robust, end-to-end, next-generation platform."</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:24px">
      <h3>Errors and empty states</h3>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;margin-bottom:0">An error says what happened and what to do — it does not apologise, and it never blames the user. An empty screen is an instruction, not a mood: <em style="color:#fff">"No enquiries are unassigned. New ones will appear here."</em> Not "Nothing to see here!"</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 11 WHAT ARTH IS NOT ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">11</span><h2>What Arth never looks like</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Every competitor in this market has made the same visual choices. Making them too would waste the only cheap differentiation available to us.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not generic SaaS</h4><p class="small">No cobalt-blue gradients, no floating 3D cards, no isometric illustrations of people pointing at charts, no purple.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not automotive cliché</h4><p class="small">No speedometers, no chequered flags, no speed lines, no chrome, no car silhouettes, no steering wheels.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not devotional</h4><p class="small">The name is rooted in Sanātana Dharma; the identity is not religious. No saffron, no diyas, no mandalas, no om. The philosophy shows in the discipline, not the decoration.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not startup-cute</h4><p class="small">No mascots, no emoji, no rounded bubble type, no confetti on success, no "we're on a mission to disrupt".</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not stock photography</h4><p class="small">No handshakes, no diverse teams laughing at laptops, no gleaming showrooms shot in California. If we cannot photograph an actual dealership, we use no photograph.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4 style="color:var(--overdue)">Not AI-branded</h4><p class="small">No sparkle icons, no glowing orbs, no neural-network motifs. Arth uses AI where it pays; it does not sell AI.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 12 IMAGERY & ICONS ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">12</span><h2>Imagery and icons</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card sr"><h3>Photography</h3>
        <p class="small">Real dealerships, real people, shot in available light. The service reception at 8am. A telecalling floor. A delivery ceremony. Hands on a keyboard, a job card, a set of keys.</p>
        <p class="small">Documentary, not aspirational. Slightly desaturated, never HDR. Faces are permitted only with written consent, and never a customer's face without it.</p>
        <p class="small" style="margin-bottom:0"><strong>If no honest photograph exists, use a rule and a number instead.</strong> An empty Ink panel with one figure on it is always better than a stock image.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h3>Icons</h3>
        <p class="small">1.5px stroke, square cut ends, 24px grid, no fills. Ink by default; Brass only when the icon marks something needing action.</p>
        <p class="small">Drawn from the dealership's own objects where possible — a job card, a key, a challan, a bay, a scale — rather than generic abstractions.</p>
        <p class="small" style="margin-bottom:0">One icon per idea across the whole product. If two screens mean the same thing, they use the same icon, always.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 13 TOKENS ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">13</span><h2>Tokens for the build</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:14px">Hand this section to engineering. Colours are defined once, here, and referenced by name — never as raw hex in a component.</p></div>
<pre>:root {
  /* Core */
  --arth-ink:          #0F2A33;   /* primary surface, all text */
  --arth-ink-deep:     #08191F;   /* code blocks, deepest panels */
  --arth-slate:        #2E5C68;   /* labels, eyebrows, series 2 */
  --arth-brass:        #B07F2C;   /* accent — money at stake */
  --arth-brass-deep:   #8F6620;   /* the only brass permitted as text */
  --arth-brass-lift:   #D0A155;   /* brass on dark backgrounds */
  --arth-brass-wash:   #F3E7CE;   /* brass pill background */

  /* Neutrals — desaturated Ink */
  --arth-n00: #FFFFFF;  --arth-n05: #F1F4F4;
  --arth-n10: #E3E9E9;  --arth-n20: #C9D3D4;
  --arth-n40: #9FADB0;  --arth-n50: #748689;  /* control borders — 3.81:1 */
  --arth-n60: #5A6C71;  /* caption text — 4.97:1 */
  --arth-n80: #47585D;  --arth-n90: #263D45;

  /* Semantic — two states only */
  --arth-overdue:      #B23B2E;   --arth-overdue-wash: #F6E3E0;
  --arth-settled:      #27735A;   --arth-settled-wash: #DEEDE7;

  /* Type */
  --arth-display: "Anek Latin", "Anek Devanagari", "Anek Kannada", sans-serif;
  --arth-body:    "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --arth-data:    "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;

  /* Structure */
  --arth-rule:    2px;            /* the shirorekha rule — never varies */
  --arth-r-sm:    3px;            /* controls */
  --arth-r-md:    5px;            /* containers */
  --arth-border:  1px solid var(--arth-n10);

  /* Space — 4px base */
  --arth-s1: 4px;  --arth-s2: 8px;  --arth-s3: 12px;
  --arth-s4: 16px; --arth-s5: 24px; --arth-s6: 32px;
  --arth-s7: 48px; --arth-s8: 64px;
}

/* Mandatory on every numeric cell in the product */
.arth-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: right; }</pre>
      <p class="small" style="margin-top:16px">Fonts are SIL Open Font Licence and self-hostable — no CDN dependency and no licence fee at any scale. Anek is by Ek Type, Mumbai; IBM Plex by IBM.</p>
    </div>
</section>

<!-- ============ 14 GOVERNANCE ============ -->
<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">14</span><h2>Keeping it honest</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Who decides</h4><p class="small">Brand decisions sit with Product Engineering, the same as product decisions. A visual change that contradicts this book needs the same written sign-off as a schema change.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>Reviewed quarterly</h4><p class="small">Alongside the external requirements review. Colours and type do not change; applications and examples are added as the product grows.</p></div>
      <div class="card sr"><h4>The test</h4><p class="small">Cover the logo. If the screen could belong to any other dealer CRM, it has drifted. Ink, the rule, tabular figures and the near-absence of colour should be enough to identify it.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:24px">
      <h3>One sentence to remember</h3>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:16px;margin-bottom:0">Arth should look like the most trustworthy document in the dealership — because being trusted with the truth about a dealer's money is the whole business.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="color:#fff;font-size:26px">arth</span></span>
    <p style="margin-top:22px;margin-bottom:0">ARTH BRAND BOOK · VERSION 1.0 · AUGUST 2026 · ADVITO GLOBAL · INTERNAL</p>
  </div>
</footer>

</body>
</html>
