<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Arth — Brand Guide, Volume 2: Application</title>
<style>
@font-face{font-family:"Anek Latin";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:100 800;font-stretch:75% 125%;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"Anek Devanagari";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:100 800;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"Anek Kannada";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:100 800;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:400;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:500;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"IBM Plex Sans";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:600;font-display:swap}@font-face{font-family:"IBM Plex Mono";src:url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format("woff2");font-weight:400;font-display:swap}
:root{
  --ink:#0F2A33; --ink-deep:#08191F; --slate:#2E5C68;
  --brass:#B07F2C; --brass-deep:#8F6620; --brass-lift:#D0A155; --brass-wash:#F3E7CE;
  --n00:#FFFFFF; --n05:#F1F4F4; --n10:#E3E9E9; --n20:#C9D3D4;
  --n40:#9FADB0; --n50:#748689; --n60:#5A6C71; --n80:#47585D; --n90:#263D45;
  --overdue:#B23B2E; --overdue-wash:#F6E3E0;
  --settled:#27735A; --settled-wash:#DEEDE7;
  --rule:2px; --r-sm:3px; --r-md:5px;
  --display:"Anek Latin",system-ui,sans-serif;
  --deva:"Anek Devanagari",serif; --kan:"Anek Kannada",serif;
  --body:"IBM Plex Sans",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --data:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--n05);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);
  font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 32px}
@media(max-width:620px){.wrap{padding:0 20px}}

.sr{position:relative;padding-top:20px}
.sr::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:var(--w,72px);
  height:var(--rule);background:var(--brass)}
.sr--full::before{width:100%}
.sr--ink::before{background:var(--ink)}

h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;margin:0;line-height:1.15}
h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3.4vw,40px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
h3{font-size:21px;margin-bottom:8px}
h4{font-family:var(--body);font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 8px;
  letter-spacing:.005em}
p{margin:0 0 14px;max-width:68ch}
.lede{font-size:18.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--n80);max-width:64ch}
.small{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--n60);line-height:1.55}
.tiny{font-size:12px;color:var(--n60);line-height:1.5}
.mono{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12.5px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.num{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;color:var(--brass-deep);
  letter-spacing:.1em;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.eyebrow{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--slate);margin:0 0 10px}

section{padding:72px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--n10)}
.sec-head{margin-bottom:36px}
.grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.g23{grid-template-columns:2fr 3fr}
@media(max-width:940px){.g3,.g4,.g23{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.g2,.g3,.g4,.g23{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

.card{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:22px}
.card--ink{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#DCE7EA}
.card--ink h3,.card--ink h4{color:#fff}
.card--ink .small,.card--ink .tiny{color:#9FB6BD}
.demo{background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:22px}
.demo--grey{background:var(--n05)}

table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13.5px}
th{text-align:left;font-weight:600;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);padding:0 10px 9px 0;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:10px 10px 10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);vertical-align:top;color:var(--n80)}
td:first-child{color:var(--ink);font-weight:500}
.numc{font-family:var(--data);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;text-align:right}
.pass{color:var(--settled);font-weight:600}
.fail{color:var(--overdue);font-weight:600}

.dd{border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:18px 20px;border:1px solid}
.do{background:var(--settled-wash);border-color:#BBD7CB}
.dont{background:var(--overdue-wash);border-color:#E5C3BD}
.dd-tag{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:9px}
.do .dd-tag{color:var(--settled)} .dont .dd-tag{color:var(--overdue)}
.dd p{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:14px;color:var(--n90)} .dd p:last-child{margin:0}

/* --- component specimens --- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-family:var(--body);
  font-weight:600;font-size:14px;padding:9px 18px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);
  border:1px solid var(--ink);background:var(--ink);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;
  text-decoration:none;line-height:1.3}
.btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink)}
.btn--quiet{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:transparent;padding:9px 10px}
.btn--danger{background:var(--overdue);border-color:var(--overdue)}
.btn--sm{font-size:13px;padding:6px 13px}
.btn[disabled],.btn--off{opacity:.42;pointer-events:none}
.btn:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible{
  outline:2px solid var(--brass);outline-offset:2px}

.field{margin-bottom:16px;max-width:340px}
.field label{display:block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px;color:var(--n90)}
.inp{width:100%;font-family:var(--body);font-size:14px;padding:9px 11px;
  border:1px solid var(--n50);border-radius:var(--r-sm);background:var(--n00);color:var(--ink)}
.inp--err{border-color:var(--overdue);border-width:1.5px}
.help{font-size:12px;color:var(--n60);margin-top:5px}
.err{font-size:12px;color:var(--overdue);margin-top:5px;font-weight:500}

.pill{display:inline-block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px}
.p-over{background:var(--overdue-wash);color:var(--overdue)}
.p-ok{background:var(--settled-wash);color:var(--settled)}
.p-attn{background:var(--brass-wash);color:#7A5716}
.p-mute{background:var(--n10);color:var(--n80)}

.row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;background:var(--n00);
  border:1px solid var(--n10);border-left:3px solid var(--n20);
  border-radius:var(--r-sm);padding:12px 14px;margin-bottom:8px}
.row--attn{border-left-color:var(--brass)}
.row--over{border-left-color:var(--overdue)}
.row--ok{border-left-color:var(--settled)}
.row-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.row-t{font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.row-s{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--n60)}
.row-v{font-family:var(--data);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-weight:500;
  font-size:13.5px;white-space:nowrap}

.tabs{display:flex;gap:2px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10);margin-bottom:16px}
.tab{padding:9px 15px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:500;color:var(--n60);
  border-bottom:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}
.tab--on{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;border-bottom-color:var(--brass)}

.skel{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--n10) 25%,var(--n05) 50%,var(--n10) 75%);
  background-size:200% 100%;animation:sh 1.4s linear infinite;border-radius:2px;height:11px}
@keyframes sh{0%{background-position:200% 0}100%{background-position:-200% 0}}

.tok{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10)}
.tok:last-child{border:none}
.tok-b{background:var(--brass);border-radius:1px;flex-shrink:0;height:14px}
.tok-n{font-family:var(--data);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--n60);min-width:150px}

.swatch{border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--n10);background:var(--n00)}
.swatch b{display:block;height:74px}
.swatch div{padding:11px 13px}
.swatch .h{font-family:var(--data);font-size:11px;color:var(--n60);text-transform:uppercase}

pre{background:var(--ink-deep);color:#CBD9DC;padding:18px;border-radius:var(--r-md);
  overflow-x:auto;font-family:var(--data);font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.65;margin:0}
code{font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;background:var(--n10);padding:1px 5px;
  border-radius:2px;color:var(--n90)}
ul.tight{margin:0;padding-left:17px}
ul.tight li{margin-bottom:6px;font-size:14px;color:var(--n80)}

.icon-cell{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:16px 8px}
.icon-cell span{font-size:11px;color:var(--n60);text-align:center;line-height:1.3}
svg.ic{display:block}

.cover{background:var(--ink);color:#DCE7EA;border:none;padding:96px 0 84px}
.mark{display:inline-block;position:relative;padding-top:12px;align-self:flex-start;width:fit-content}
.mark::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:4px;background:var(--brass)}
.mark span{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-variation-settings:"wdth" 90;
  display:block;line-height:.95;color:#fff}
.footer{background:var(--ink);color:#7FA0A9;padding:38px 0;font-size:12.5px;border:none}

.toc{columns:2;column-gap:40px}
@media(max-width:640px){.toc{columns:1}}
.toc a{display:block;padding:6px 0;font-size:14px;color:var(--n80);text-decoration:none;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10)}
.toc a:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* --- responsive containment (audit fix) --- */
.grid > *{min-width:0}
.card,.demo{overflow-wrap:break-word}
.table-scroll,.demo,.card{max-width:100%}
@media(max-width:760px){
  table{display:block;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;font-size:12.5px}
  table thead,table tbody,table tr{display:table;width:100%;table-layout:fixed}
  th,td{white-space:normal}
  pre{font-size:10px}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
  .toc{columns:1}
  th,td{padding-right:6px}
}
.toc a b{font-family:var(--data);font-size:11px;color:var(--brass-deep);margin-right:10px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<section class="cover">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="mark"><span style="font-size:clamp(56px,9vw,104px)">arth</span></div>
    <p class="lede" style="color:var(--brass-lift);margin-top:26px;max-width:56ch">
      Brand Guide — Volume 2: Application. Product interface, icons, social, print, and everything the identity has to survive contact with.</p>
    <p style="color:#7FA0A9;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;margin:34px 0 0">
      ADVITO GLOBAL · INTERNAL · VERSION 1.0 · AUGUST 2026 · AUDITED</p>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">CONTENTS</span><h2>What is in this volume</h2></div>
    <nav class="toc">
      <a href="#s00"><b>00</b>Errata to Volume 1</a>
      <a href="#s01"><b>01</b>Foundations — space, radius, elevation</a>
      <a href="#s02"><b>02</b>Grid and page shells</a>
      <a href="#s03"><b>03</b>Components</a>
      <a href="#s04"><b>04</b>States — loading, empty, error</a>
      <a href="#s05"><b>05</b>Navigation and IA</a>
      <a href="#s06"><b>06</b>Forms and validation</a>
      <a href="#s07"><b>07</b>Data display and charts</a>
      <a href="#s08"><b>08</b>Motion</a>
      <a href="#s09"><b>09</b>Accessibility</a>
      <a href="#s10"><b>10</b>Responsive and mobile web</a>
      <a href="#s11"><b>11</b>Icon system</a>
      <a href="#s12"><b>12</b>Elements and patterns</a>
      <a href="#s13"><b>13</b>Social media</a>
      <a href="#s14"><b>14</b>Print and physical</a>
      <a href="#s15"><b>15</b>Email and WhatsApp</a>
      <a href="#s16"><b>16</b>Presentations</a>
      <a href="#s17"><b>17</b>Photography</a>
      <a href="#s18"><b>18</b>Asset management</a>
      <a href="#s19"><b>19</b>Audit report</a>
    </nav>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 00 ERRATA -->
<section id="s00">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">00</span><h2>Errata to Volume 1</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Volume 1 was audited for contrast after publication. Three values failed. They are corrected here, and Volume 1 is superseded on these three points only.</p></div>
    <table>
      <tr><th>Token</th><th>Was</th><th>Now</th><th>Why</th></tr>
      <tr><td>N60 — caption text</td><td class="mono">#6B7C80</td><td class="mono">#5A6C71</td>
        <td>Measured 3.94:1 on the app background. Below the 4.5:1 floor for body text. Now 4.97:1.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>N50 — control border <em>(new)</em></td><td class="mono">—</td><td class="mono">#748689</td>
        <td>N20 at 1.53:1 is fine for a decorative card edge but fails the 3:1 floor for an input boundary, which is a meaningful interface element. N50 measures 3.81:1.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Brass Deep <em>(new)</em></td><td class="mono">—</td><td class="mono">#8F6620</td>
        <td>Brass at #B07F2C is 3.55:1 on white and cannot legally be text. Brass Deep measures 5.14:1 for the rare case where brass must be a word.</td></tr>
    </table>
    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:22px">
      <h3>The rule this creates</h3>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;margin:0">Brass is a <strong style="color:#fff">fill and a rule</strong>, not a typeface colour. Ink on a Brass fill measures 4.23:1 — permitted for the wordmark and headings 24px and above, never for body copy. When brass must carry a word, it is Brass Deep.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 01 FOUNDATIONS -->
<section id="s01">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">01</span><h2>Foundations</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g23">
      <div class="card">
        <h4>Space — 4px base</h4>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s1 · 4px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:4px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s2 · 8px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:8px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s3 · 12px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:12px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s4 · 16px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:16px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s5 · 24px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:24px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s6 · 32px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:32px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s7 · 48px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:48px"></span></div>
        <div class="tok"><span class="tok-n">--s8 · 64px</span><span class="tok-b" style="width:64px"></span></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0">Nothing between these values. If a layout needs 18px, the layout is wrong.</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:20px">
          <h4>Radius and edge</h4>
          <p class="small">Two radii only. <code>3px</code> on anything a person clicks. <code>5px</code> on anything that contains other things. Zero radius reads as a spreadsheet; 12px reads as a consumer app. Arth is neither.</p>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:14px;align-items:flex-end">
            <div><div style="width:70px;height:40px;background:var(--ink);border-radius:3px"></div><p class="tiny" style="margin:6px 0 0">3px control</p></div>
            <div><div style="width:70px;height:56px;background:var(--n00);border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:5px"></div><p class="tiny" style="margin:6px 0 0">5px container</p></div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card">
          <h4>Elevation — borders, not shadows</h4>
          <p class="small">Level 0 is flat on the background. Level 1 is a 1px N10 border. Level 2, reserved for layers that genuinely float above the page — modal, menu, date picker — adds <code>0 8px 24px rgba(15,42,51,.14)</code>. There is no level 3.</p>
          <p class="small" style="margin:0">A ledger does not have depth. Cards that float make an operational screen feel provisional, and Arth's whole claim is that its record is permanent.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Breakpoints</h4><p class="tiny mono" style="line-height:1.9;margin:0">sm  480<br>md  768<br>lg  1024<br>xl  1280<br>xxl 1600</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Z-index</h4><p class="tiny mono" style="line-height:1.9;margin:0">base      0<br>sticky   100<br>drawer   200<br>modal    300<br>toast    400</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Line length</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Prose caps at 68 characters. Table cells never wrap to a third line — truncate with a tooltip instead.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Touch targets</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">44×44px minimum on any surface reachable by a finger, including the responsive web build. Desktop-only controls may go to 32px.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 02 GRID -->
<section id="s02">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">02</span><h2>Grid and page shells</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Three shells cover every screen in the product. A fourth means the information architecture has gone wrong.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card"><h4>Shell A — Work queue</h4>
        <pre style="font-size:10.5px;padding:14px">┌──────┬────────────────────┐
│ nav  │ filter bar         │
│      ├────────────────────┤
│ 240  │ ▸ row              │
│      │ ▸ row              │
│      │ ▸ row              │
└──────┴────────────────────┘</pre>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:10px 0 0">Telecalling, service, insurance, delivery. Dense rows, 44px high, filter bar sticky.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Shell B — Record</h4>
        <pre style="font-size:10.5px;padding:14px">┌──────┬───────────┬────────┐
│ nav  │ record    │ context│
│      │ tabs      │ 320    │
│ 240  │ content   │ history│
│      │           │ vehicle│
└──────┴───────────┴────────┘</pre>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:10px 0 0">One customer, one enquiry, one job card. The right rail always shows the shared core: household, vehicle, history.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Shell C — Cockpit</h4>
        <pre style="font-size:10.5px;padding:14px">┌──────┬────────────────────┐
│ nav  │ period selector    │
│      ├────────────────────┤
│ 240  │ decision cards     │
│      │ (max 15, ranked)   │
└──────┴────────────────────┘</pre>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:10px 0 0">Management. Generous spacing, one decision per card, ranked by rupee value.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Column grid</h4>
        <p class="small">12 columns, 24px gutters, 32px page margin. Content maximum 1440px — beyond that the sidebar holds and the content column centres. Never full-bleed: a table 2400px wide is unreadable.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Two densities, chosen by shell</h4>
        <p class="small"><strong>Operational</strong> (A and B): 14px text, 44px rows, 12px cell padding. <strong>Management</strong> (C): 16px text, generous padding, 24px between cards. One global density setting for both is the most common mistake in dealer software.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 03 COMPONENTS -->
<section id="s03">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">03</span><h2>Components</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Every control in the product, with its states. If a screen needs something not on this page, it goes through design review before it is built.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="demo"><h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Buttons</h4>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center">
          <button class="btn">Assign to me</button>
          <button class="btn btn--ghost">Cancel</button>
          <button class="btn btn--quiet">View history</button>
          <button class="btn btn--danger">Mark lost</button>
          <button class="btn btn--off">Disabled</button>
          <button class="btn btn--sm">Small</button>
        </div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:14px 0 0">One primary button per screen region. Ghost for the paired secondary. Quiet for tertiary actions inside a row. Danger only for actions that destroy or close a record — never for "delete filter".</p>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:8px 0 0"><strong>Labels are verbs and they never change.</strong> The button that says "Assign" produces a toast that says "Assigned".</p>
      </div>
      <div class="demo"><h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Inputs</h4>
        <div class="field"><label for="d1">Customer phone</label>
          <input class="inp" id="d1" value="98450 12345"><p class="help">Used to match walk-ins to existing enquiries.</p></div>
        <div class="field"><label for="d2">Promised delivery date</label>
          <input class="inp inp--err" id="d2" value="12 Aug 2026"><p class="err">RTO step is not complete before this date. Earliest achievable is 18 Aug.</p></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Labels sit above, always visible — never a placeholder as a label. Help text explains why the field exists, not what to type.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="demo"><h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Status pills</h4>
        <div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px">
          <span class="pill p-over">Overdue</span>
          <span class="pill p-attn">Review</span>
          <span class="pill p-ok">Settled</span>
          <span class="pill p-mute">Draft</span>
        </div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:14px 0 0">Square corners, 2px radius — a pill is a stamp, not a bubble. Uppercase is permitted here because it is never more than one word.</p>
        <h4 style="margin:20px 0 12px">Tabs</h4>
        <div class="tabs"><span class="tab tab--on">Open</span><span class="tab">Won</span><span class="tab">Lost</span><span class="tab">All</span></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">The active tab is marked by a Brass rule beneath it — the shirorekha inverted, deliberately, because a tab hangs from the content rather than the content from it.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="demo"><h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">Rows — the workhorse</h4>
        <div class="row row--over"><div class="row-main"><div class="row-t">Ramesh Kumar — Grand Vitara</div><div class="row-s">No contact for 61 hours · R. Kumar</div></div><span class="pill p-over">Overdue</span><span class="row-v">₹11,200</span></div>
        <div class="row row--attn"><div class="row-main"><div class="row-t">Suresh Nayak — Brezza</div><div class="row-s">Test drive done, no quotation issued</div></div><span class="pill p-attn">Review</span><span class="row-v">₹9,400</span></div>
        <div class="row row--ok"><div class="row-main"><div class="row-t">Lakshmi Rao — Fronx</div><div class="row-s">Delivered 02 Aug · promise met</div></div><span class="pill p-ok">Settled</span><span class="row-v">₹8,100</span></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0">State lives in a 3px left border. A row is never filled with a semantic colour — twenty filled rows is a colour field, not a signal.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Modal</h4><p class="tiny">Only for a decision that cannot be undone. 480px, Ink header rule, primary action right. Never for information — that is a drawer.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Drawer</h4><p class="tiny">Right side, 420px, for context that supports the current screen without leaving it. Closes on Escape. Never nested.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Toast</h4><p class="tiny">Bottom left, 4 seconds, one line, past tense. Never for errors — an error needs somewhere to stay.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 04 STATES -->
<section id="s04">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">04</span><h2>States</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Most software is designed for the screen that is full of data. Arth's users will meet these screens on their first day, and on their worst day.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="demo"><h4>Loading</h4>
        <div style="margin:14px 0"><div class="skel" style="width:60%;margin-bottom:9px"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:88%;margin-bottom:9px"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:74%"></div></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Skeletons in the shape of the content that is coming, never a spinner. Over 3 seconds, add a line saying what is being fetched.</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><h4>Empty — the good kind</h4>
        <div style="padding:22px 0;text-align:center">
          <div style="width:38px;height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin:0 auto 14px"></div>
          <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 6px">No enquiries are unassigned</p>
          <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">New enquiries appear here within a minute of arriving.</p></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">States a fact and says what happens next. Never "Nothing to see here!", never an illustration.</p></div>
      <div class="demo"><h4>Error</h4>
        <div style="border-left:3px solid var(--overdue);background:var(--overdue-wash);padding:14px;border-radius:var(--r-sm);margin:14px 0">
          <p style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 4px;color:var(--n90)">This enquiry was reassigned while you were editing.</p>
          <p class="tiny" style="margin:0;color:var(--n80)">It now belongs to S. Nayak. Your notes are saved as a draft.</p></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Says what happened, what it means, and what survived. No apology, no blame, no error code unless support needs it.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>No permission</h4><p class="tiny">"Branch performance is visible to branch heads and above. Ask your manager to change your access." Never a bare 403.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Offline</h4><p class="tiny">A persistent Ink bar: "Working offline. 3 calls logged will sync when you reconnect." Work is never blocked.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>No results</h4><p class="tiny">Repeat the query back and offer the widest filter to drop. "No leads match 'Whitefield · Fronx · this week'."</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Partial data</h4><p class="tiny">If a figure is incomplete, say so beside it in Mono. Never render an incomplete number as though it were final.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 05 NAV -->
<section id="s05">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">05</span><h2>Navigation</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g23">
      <div class="demo demo--grey">
        <div style="background:var(--ink);border-radius:var(--r-md);padding:18px 16px;width:100%;max-width:250px">
          <div class="mark" style="margin-bottom:20px"><span style="font-size:22px">arth</span></div>
          <p style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#7FA0A9;margin:0 0 8px">WORKSPACE</p>
          <div style="background:#1B3D48;border-radius:3px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;color:#fff;margin-bottom:16px">Sales — Nagarbhavi ▾</div>
          <p style="font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#7FA0A9;margin:0 0 8px">TODAY</p>
          <div style="font-size:13.5px;color:#fff;padding:7px 10px;border-left:2px solid var(--brass);background:#16333D;border-radius:0 3px 3px 0;margin-bottom:3px">My queue <span style="float:right;font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px">24</span></div>
          <div style="font-size:13.5px;color:#B9CCD1;padding:7px 10px;border-left:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:3px">Unassigned <span style="float:right;font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px">7</span></div>
          <div style="font-size:13.5px;color:#B9CCD1;padding:7px 10px;border-left:2px solid transparent;margin-bottom:3px">Follow-ups due <span style="float:right;font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px">41</span></div>
          <div style="font-size:13.5px;color:#B9CCD1;padding:7px 10px;border-left:2px solid transparent">Overdue <span style="float:right;font-family:var(--data);font-size:12px;color:#E39B90">5</span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px"><h4>The sidebar is Ink, always</h4>
          <p class="small" style="margin:0">240px, Ink field, white type. It is the one persistently dark surface in the product — it frames the work the way a ledger's binding frames its pages, and it makes the light content area feel like paper.</p></div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px"><h4>Navigation is by question, not by object</h4>
          <p class="small" style="margin:0">"My queue", "Follow-ups due", "Overdue" — not "Leads", "Contacts", "Reports". A telecaller does not think in database tables. Counts sit right-aligned in Mono so the eye can scan them as a column.</p></div>
        <div class="card"><h4>Workspace switcher, not a menu tree</h4>
          <p class="small" style="margin:0">A person switches between departments and branches, and the whole navigation changes with them. Depth is capped at two levels everywhere. If something needs a third level, it belongs in a filter.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 06 FORMS -->
<section id="s06">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">06</span><h2>Forms and validation</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card"><h4>Rules</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li>Label above, always visible. Placeholders are examples, never labels.</li>
          <li>Mark optional fields, not required ones — most fields are required.</li>
          <li>Validate on blur, never on keystroke. Nobody wants to be corrected mid-word.</li>
          <li>Errors appear beneath the field, and the field border thickens as well as changes colour, so the state does not depend on colour alone.</li>
          <li>One column. Two-column forms cause skipped fields.</li>
          <li>Never clear a form on error. Ever.</li>
        </ul></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Error copy — the pattern</h4>
        <p class="small"><strong>What happened · what it means · what to do.</strong></p>
        <table style="margin-top:8px">
          <tr><th>Instead of</th><th>Write</th></tr>
          <tr><td>"Invalid input"</td><td>"Enter a 10-digit mobile number without the country code."</td></tr>
          <tr><td>"Required field"</td><td>"A lost reason is needed before this enquiry can be closed."</td></tr>
          <tr><td>"Error 403"</td><td>"You can view this branch but not reassign its leads."</td></tr>
          <tr><td>"Save failed"</td><td>"Not saved — you are offline. This will send when you reconnect."</td></tr>
        </table></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 07 DATA -->
<section id="s07">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">07</span><h2>Data display</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Arth is a numbers product. How a figure is set matters more here than in almost any other brand decision.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g23">
      <div class="demo">
        <table>
          <tr><th>Campaign</th><th class="numc">Spend</th><th class="numc">Bookings</th><th class="numc">Cost / booking</th></tr>
          <tr><td>Grand Vitara — Search</td><td class="numc">₹1,84,000</td><td class="numc">20</td><td class="numc">₹9,200</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Brezza — Meta lead form</td><td class="numc">₹96,200</td><td class="numc">13</td><td class="numc">₹7,400</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Festive Offer — C3</td><td class="numc">₹38,000</td><td class="numc">0</td><td class="numc" style="color:var(--overdue);font-weight:600">₹38,000</td></tr>
          <tr><td style="font-weight:700">Total</td><td class="numc" style="font-weight:700">₹3,18,200</td><td class="numc" style="font-weight:700">33</td><td class="numc" style="font-weight:700">₹9,642</td></tr>
        </table>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0;font-family:var(--data)">1 Jul – 31 Jul 2026 · Meta Ads API, Google Ads API · pulled 04 Aug 11:42</p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px"><h4>Number rules</h4>
          <ul class="tight">
            <li>Tabular figures everywhere. <code>font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums</code>.</li>
            <li>Indian grouping — ₹12,00,000, never ₹1,200,000.</li>
            <li>Right-aligned in tables, left-aligned in cards.</li>
            <li>Totals in 700 weight, above the row, never below in a separate box.</li>
            <li>Source and period beneath every table and chart, in Mono. This is a brand rule, not a nicety — it is what "evidence, not assertion" looks like.</li>
            <li>Semantic colour on the one figure that is wrong. Never on a whole column.</li>
          </ul></div>
        <div class="card"><h4>Charts</h4>
          <ul class="tight">
            <li>Ink is series one, Slate series two, Brass only the series being argued about.</li>
            <li>Label bars directly. A legend admits the chart failed.</li>
            <li>Zero baseline always. A truncated axis is dishonest, and honesty is the brand.</li>
            <li>Never a pie, donut, gauge, radar or 3D anything.</li>
            <li>No gridlines unless the reader must compare across a gap.</li>
          </ul></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 08 MOTION -->
<section id="s08">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">08</span><h2>Motion</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Arth moves as little as possible. Motion in an operational product is a cost paid by someone doing the same task four hundred times a day.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g4">
      <div class="card"><h4>Durations</h4><p class="tiny mono" style="line-height:1.9;margin:0">instant   0ms<br>quick   120ms<br>base    180ms<br>enter   240ms<br>never  &gt;300ms</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Easing</h4><p class="tiny mono" style="line-height:1.9;margin:0">out&nbsp;&nbsp;cubic-bezier<br>&nbsp;&nbsp;(.2,.7,.2,1)<br><br>in-out&nbsp;&nbsp;(.4,0,.2,1)</p><p class="tiny" style="margin:8px 0 0">No bounce. No spring. No overshoot.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>What may animate</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Drawer and modal entry. Row removal after an action. Toast in and out. Skeleton shimmer. The wordmark rule, once, on first load.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>What never animates</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Numbers counting up. Charts drawing themselves. Page transitions. Anything on hover other than a colour change. Anything decorative.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:20px">
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;margin:0"><code style="background:#16333D;color:#D0A155">prefers-reduced-motion</code> is honoured everywhere, with no exceptions and no "reduced" fallback animation. When it is set, transitions become instant.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 09 ACCESSIBILITY -->
<section id="s09">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">09</span><h2>Accessibility</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Target is WCAG 2.2 AA. Measured, not assumed — every pairing below was computed, and the three that failed are corrected in section 00.</p></div>
    <table><tr><th>Pairing</th><th>Fg</th><th>Bg</th><th class="numc">Ratio</th><th>Grade</th></tr><tr><td>Body text on app background</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">13.57</td><td class="pass">AAA</td></tr><tr><td>Body text on card</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="numc">15.01</td><td class="pass">AAA</td></tr><tr><td>Secondary text on background</td><td class="mono">#47585D</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">6.73</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Caption text on background <span class="tiny">— corrected to #5A6C71 (4.97)</span></td><td class="mono">#6B7C80</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">3.94</td><td class="fail">FAIL</td></tr><tr><td>Caption on card</td><td class="mono">#6B7C80</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="numc">4.36</td><td class="">UI only</td></tr><tr><td>Eyebrow label on background</td><td class="mono">#2E5C68</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">6.67</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>White on Ink panel</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="numc">15.01</td><td class="pass">AAA</td></tr><tr><td>Brass accent text on Ink</td><td class="mono">#D0A155</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="numc">6.37</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Brass text on white <span class="tiny">— brass is a fill, not text; see 00</span></td><td class="mono">#B07F2C</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="numc">3.55</td><td class="">UI only</td></tr><tr><td>Brass text on background [expect FAIL] <span class="tiny">— brass is a fill, not text; see 00</span></td><td class="mono">#B07F2C</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">3.21</td><td class="">UI only</td></tr><tr><td>Overdue text on white</td><td class="mono">#B23B2E</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="numc">5.90</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Overdue pill text</td><td class="mono">#B23B2E</td><td class="mono">#F6E3E0</td><td class="numc">4.77</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Settled text on white</td><td class="mono">#27735A</td><td class="mono">#FFFFFF</td><td class="numc">5.70</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Settled pill text</td><td class="mono">#27735A</td><td class="mono">#DEEDE7</td><td class="numc">4.71</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Brass pill text</td><td class="mono">#7A5716</td><td class="mono">#F3E7CE</td><td class="numc">5.35</td><td class="pass">AA</td></tr><tr><td>Ink on Brass fill</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="mono">#B07F2C</td><td class="numc">4.23</td><td class="">UI only</td></tr><tr><td>Border on background [UI 3:1] <span class="tiny">— control borders now #748689 (3.81)</span></td><td class="mono">#C9D3D4</td><td class="mono">#F1F4F4</td><td class="numc">1.38</td><td class="fail">FAIL</td></tr><tr><td>Brass rule on Ink [UI 3:1]</td><td class="mono">#B07F2C</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="numc">4.23</td><td class="">UI only</td></tr></table>
    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-top:22px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Never colour alone</h4><p class="tiny">Every status carries a word as well as a colour. A pill reads "Overdue"; the left border is a reinforcement, not the signal. Roughly 1 in 12 Indian men has a colour vision deficiency, and this product is used by telecalling floors of forty.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Focus is visible and Brass</h4><p class="tiny">2px Brass outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. Never removed. The whole product is keyboard-operable, because a fast telecaller does not use a mouse.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Language and script</h4><p class="tiny">Every page declares <code>lang</code>. Kannada and Hindi content is marked so screen readers switch voice. Numbers stay in Latin digits in all three languages — that is what dealers actually read.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<!-- 10 RESPONSIVE -->
<section id="s10">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">10</span><h2>Responsive and mobile web</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">There is no native app in this cycle. The web build must therefore work properly on a phone, because a sales consultant is on the showroom floor and an RTO clerk is at the RTO.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card"><h4>Below 768px</h4><p class="tiny">Sidebar collapses to a bottom bar with four destinations. Right rail moves below the record. Tables become stacked cards — never a horizontal scroll on a phone.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>What must work one-handed</h4><p class="tiny">Log a call. Change a stage. Add a note. Book a test drive. Mark a delivery step complete. These five are the phone product; everything else may require a desktop.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Field conditions</h4><p class="tiny">Designed for a 2019 Android phone on 4G in a basement showroom: 44px targets, no hover dependency, tolerant of a dropped connection, and readable in direct sunlight — which is why the interface is dark-on-light, not the reverse.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card card--ink sr" style="--w:100%;margin-top:20px">
      <h3>On dark mode</h3>
      <p class="small" style="font-size:15px;margin:0">Arth does not ship a dark theme. The Ink sidebar is the dark surface; the content area is paper. A ledger is dark ink on light paper, and inverting it would break the metaphor the whole identity rests on. Revisit only if operators ask, and never before the product is complete.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 11 ICONS -->
<section id="s11">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">11</span><h2>Icon system</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Drawn from the dealership's own objects — a job card, a key, a number plate, a scale — rather than generic software abstractions.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:24px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Grid</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">24×24, live area 20×20 with a 2px margin. Icons are drawn on whole and half pixels only.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Stroke</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">1.5px, square caps, mitre joins. No fills, no two-tone, no rounded caps.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Colour</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Ink by default, N60 when inactive, Brass only when the icon marks something needing action.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>One idea, one icon</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">If two screens mean the same thing they use the same icon, always. New icons go through review.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g4" style="gap:14px">
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><path d="M9 12h6M9 16h4"/></svg><span>Enquiry</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 4h3.5l1.5 4.5-2.2 1.6a12 12 0 0 0 5.1 5.1l1.6-2.2L20 14.5V18h-3.5C10.7 18 6 13.3 6 7.5z"/></svg><span>Call</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 18h9a3 3 0 0 0 0-6H9a3 3 0 0 1 0-6h9"/><circle cx="6" cy="18" r="1.6"/><circle cx="18" cy="6" r="1.6"/></svg><span>Test drive route</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M9 4h6v3H9z"/><path d="M9 5.5H6V20h12V5.5h-3"/><path d="M9 11h6M9 15h4"/></svg><span>Job card</span></div>

      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="3.2"/><path d="M11.2 12H20M17 12v3M20 12v3"/></svg><span>Delivery / key</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="8"/><path d="M7 12h2M11 12h2M15 12h2"/></svg><span>Vehicle</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><circle cx="12" cy="15" r="2.6"/></svg><span>Policy</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="14"/><path d="M8 5v14M11 9h6M11 13h6"/></svg><span>Ledger</span></div>

      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M12 5v15M6 20h12M12 8l-6 2.5M12 8l6 2.5"/><path d="M3 10.5a3 3 0 0 0 6 0M15 10.5a3 3 0 0 0 6 0"/></svg><span>Accountability</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M4 20h16M8 20v-4h8v4M6 16h12M12 16V8M9 8h6"/></svg><span>Service bay</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><circle cx="12" cy="8.5" r="3.2"/><path d="M5 20a7 7 0 0 1 14 0"/></svg><span>Owner</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8"/><path d="M12 7.5V12l3 2"/></svg><span>SLA clock</span></div>

      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M4 4h16"/><path d="M12 20V9M8 13l4-4 4 4"/></svg><span>Escalate</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M10 14.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0-5l2-2a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 5 5l-1 1"/><path d="M14 9.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 0 5l-2 2a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-5-5l1-1"/></svg><span>Attribution link</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M6 3h8l4 4v14H6z"/><path d="M14 3v4h4"/><path d="M9 14l2.2 2.2L16 11.5"/></svg><span>Consent</span></div>
      <div class="icon-cell"><svg class="ic" width="40" height="40" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#0F2A33" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="square" stroke-linejoin="miter"><path d="M7 5h10M7 9h10M14 5c3.2 0 3.2 8-2 8H7l8.5 7"/></svg><span>Amount</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:22px">
      <div class="dd do"><div class="dd-tag">Correct</div>
        <p>Optically balanced within the 20px live area, not mathematically centred.</p>
        <p>Paired with a label wherever space allows. An unlabelled icon is a guess.</p>
        <p>Exported as SVG with <code>currentColor</code> so a single file serves every state.</p></div>
      <div class="dd dont"><div class="dd-tag">Never</div>
        <p>Never mix a filled icon into the set for emphasis — use colour instead.</p>
        <p>Never a steering wheel, speedometer, chequered flag or chrome badge.</p>
        <p>Never an AI sparkle. Never an emoji standing in for an icon.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 12 ELEMENTS -->
<section id="s12">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">12</span><h2>Elements and patterns</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card"><h4>The rule</h4>
        <div class="sr" style="--w:72px;margin:16px 0 0"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">72px section marker</p></div>
        <div class="sr sr--full" style="margin:16px 0 0"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Full-width division</p></div>
        <div class="sr sr--ink" style="--w:72px;margin:16px 0 0"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Ink, above table headers</p></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:16px 0 0">Two lengths only. Never dotted, never diagonal, never a gradient.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>The stamp</h4>
        <div style="border:1.5px solid var(--settled);color:var(--settled);display:inline-block;padding:6px 14px;border-radius:2px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.06em;transform:rotate(-3deg);margin:16px 0">DELIVERED · 02 AUG</div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0">For closed, settled and delivered records on printed and PDF output only — never in the interface. A slight rotation is permitted here and nowhere else in the system.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>The ledger field</h4>
        <div style="height:88px;margin:16px 0;border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,var(--n00) 0 21px,var(--n10) 21px 22px)"></div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">A ruled field, 22px pitch, N10 lines. Used as a background on covers, dividers and the back of printed pieces. Never behind live text.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Panels</h4><p class="small" style="margin:0">The Ink panel is the brand's strongest device after the rule. Use it for a single idea that must land — a quote, a warning, a principle. One Ink panel per screen or page. Two competes; three is wallpaper.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>The number block</h4>
        <div style="display:flex;gap:26px;margin:6px 0 12px">
          <div><p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:34px;font-weight:600;margin:0;line-height:1">₹9,200</p><p class="tiny" style="margin:2px 0 0">Cost per booking</p></div>
          <div><p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:34px;font-weight:600;margin:0;line-height:1;color:var(--overdue)">61h</p><p class="tiny" style="margin:2px 0 0">Longest untouched lead</p></div>
        </div>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Figure in Anek 600, label beneath in 12px N60. Never the reverse order, never a large label above a small number.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 13 SOCIAL -->
<section id="s13">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">13</span><h2>Social media</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Arth's buyer is a dealer principal who is sceptical of software marketing. Our social presence should look like published evidence, not like advertising.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g3" style="margin-bottom:24px">
      <div class="card"><h4>LinkedIn — primary</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Where dealer principals, GMs and OEM people are. Benchmarks, findings, plain-language explainers. Two posts a week. No hiring posts dressed as thought leadership.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Instagram — secondary</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Recruitment and industry visibility, not selling. Documentary photography of real dealerships, a number, a caption. No reels of the product UI.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>YouTube — later</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Short screen-recorded walkthroughs with a real voice, no music, no motion graphics. Only once the product is in a dealership.</p></div>
    </div>

    <h4 style="margin-bottom:14px">The three post templates. There is no fourth.</h4>
    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--ink);padding:26px 22px;aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between">
          <div><div style="width:44px;height:3px;background:var(--brass);margin-bottom:16px"></div>
            <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.3">Of 1,000 enquiries at a typical Bengaluru showroom</p>
            <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:52px;font-weight:600;color:var(--brass-lift);margin:0;line-height:1">33</p>
            <p style="font-size:12px;color:#9FB6BD;margin:4px 0 0">became a delivered car</p></div>
          <p style="font-family:var(--data);font-size:9.5px;color:#7FA0A9;margin:0">ARTH · DEALER FUNNEL STUDY 2026</p>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:14px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>A. The number.</strong> One finding, one figure, one source line. Our most-used format.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--n00);padding:26px 22px;aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10)">
          <div><div style="width:44px;height:3px;background:var(--brass);margin-bottom:16px"></div>
            <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 10px;line-height:1.25">Cost per lead is a vanity metric</p>
            <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--n80);margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.5">The cheapest leads are usually the worst ones. Every dealer principal suspects this. Almost none can prove it.</p>
            <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--n80);margin:0;line-height:1.5">A lead is not a car. Only one of those can be banked.</p></div>
          <div><p class="tiny mono" style="margin:0 0 10px;font-size:9px;color:var(--n60)">ARTH · ON MEASUREMENT · 03</p>
          <div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)">arth</span></div></div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:14px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>B. The statement.</strong> One opinion we will defend, in plain words. Never more than 30 words.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--n05);padding:26px 22px;aspect-ratio:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--n10)">
          <div><p style="font-family:var(--data);font-size:9.5px;color:var(--slate);letter-spacing:.14em;margin:0 0 14px">FROM THE FIELD</p>
            <div style="height:100px;background:var(--n20);border-radius:3px;margin-bottom:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center"><span class="tiny">documentary photograph</span></div>
            <p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--n80);margin:0;line-height:1.5">Service reception, 8:10am. The busiest ninety minutes of a dealership's week.</p></div>
          <div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)">arth</span></div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:14px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>C. The photograph.</strong> Real dealership, honest caption. Never stock, never a customer's face without consent.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-top:22px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Formats and sizes</h4>
        <table>
          <tr><th>Placement</th><th>Pixels</th><th>Safe area</th></tr>
          <tr><td>Square post</td><td class="mono">1080×1080</td><td>96px all sides</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Portrait post</td><td class="mono">1080×1350</td><td>96px sides, 130 top/bottom</td></tr>
          <tr><td>LinkedIn landscape</td><td class="mono">1200×627</td><td>72px all sides</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Story / vertical</td><td class="mono">1080×1920</td><td>250px top, 320px bottom</td></tr>
          <tr><td>LinkedIn banner</td><td class="mono">1584×396</td><td>Mark left, clear of the avatar</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Profile mark</td><td class="mono">400×400</td><td>Square monogram, Ink field</td></tr>
        </table></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Rules</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li>The rule sits top-left on every asset. It is how a post is recognised at thumbnail size.</li>
          <li>Every claim carries its source and period, in Mono, at the foot. No exceptions — this is the brand.</li>
          <li>Never name a client. "A 5-rooftop Maruti group in Bengaluru" is the correct form.</li>
          <li>No hashtag stacks, no engagement bait, no emoji, no rocket.</li>
          <li>Captions under 60 words. If it needs more, it is an article.</li>
          <li>Never post a product screenshot containing real customer data — use the seeded demo tenant.</li>
        </ul></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 14 PRINT -->
<section id="s14">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">14</span><h2>Print and physical</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Dealer principals still sign things on paper. Printed material is often the first Arth artefact in a showroom, and it should feel like a document worth keeping.</p></div>

    <div class="grid g2" style="margin-bottom:22px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Colour for print</h4>
        <table>
          <tr><th>Colour</th><th>Hex</th><th>CMYK</th><th>Pantone (nearest)</th></tr>
          <tr><td>Ink</td><td class="mono">#0F2A33</td><td class="mono">88 62 50 55</td><td class="mono">5463 C</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Brass</td><td class="mono">#B07F2C</td><td class="mono">26 47 96 6</td><td class="mono">7557 C</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Slate</td><td class="mono">#2E5C68</td><td class="mono">83 51 41 15</td><td class="mono">5473 C</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Overdue</td><td class="mono">#B23B2E</td><td class="mono">21 88 90 10</td><td class="mono">7620 C</td></tr>
          <tr><td>Settled</td><td class="mono">#27735A</td><td class="mono">83 30 68 13</td><td class="mono">7726 C</td></tr>
        </table>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0">CMYK values are conversions and must be proofed before a first run. Pantone references are nearest matches for one- and two-colour work, not exact.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Stock and finish</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li><strong>Business card</strong> — 88×55mm, 400gsm uncoated, Ink flood one side, mark in brass foil. No spot UV, no rounded corners, no gloss.</li>
          <li><strong>Letterhead</strong> — A4, 100gsm uncoated, mark top-left, full-width Brass rule at 22mm, footer in 8pt Mono.</li>
          <li><strong>Folder and brochure</strong> — 250gsm uncoated, matt laminate only if it must survive a workshop.</li>
          <li><strong>Never</strong> gloss, metallic card, embossed plastic or a gradient on any printed surface.</li>
        </ul>
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:10px 0 0">Uncoated stock is the whole point — Arth is a document, not a brochure. Brass foil on Ink is the one permitted indulgence and it appears on the business card alone.</p></div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g3">
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--ink);aspect-ratio:88/55;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between">
          <div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="font-size:22px">arth</span></div>
          <p style="font-family:var(--data);font-size:8px;color:#7FA0A9;margin:0;letter-spacing:.1em">ADVITO GLOBAL · BENGALURU</p>
        </div>
        <div style="background:var(--n00);aspect-ratio:88/55;padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;border-top:1px solid var(--n10)">
          <div style="width:34px;height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin-bottom:10px"></div>
          <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin:0">Prem Kumar</p>
          <p class="tiny" style="margin:1px 0 8px">Founder</p>
          <p class="tiny mono" style="margin:0;font-size:9.5px;line-height:1.6">prem@advito.global<br>+91 98450 00000<br>arthcrm.com</p>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:12px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>Business card</strong> — 88×55mm, both faces.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--n00);aspect-ratio:210/297;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column">
          <div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass);margin-bottom:6px"><span style="font-size:17px;color:var(--ink)">arth</span></div>
          <div style="height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin:12px 0 16px"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:70%;margin-bottom:7px;animation:none;background:var(--n10)"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:7px;animation:none;background:var(--n10)"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:92%;margin-bottom:7px;animation:none;background:var(--n10)"></div>
          <div class="skel" style="width:60%;animation:none;background:var(--n10)"></div>
          <div style="margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--n10);padding-top:8px"><p class="tiny mono" style="margin:0;font-size:7px">ADVITO GLOBAL PVT LTD · NAGARBHAVI, BENGALURU 560072 · GSTIN 29XXXXXXXXXXXZX</p></div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:12px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>Letterhead</strong> — A4. Rule at 22mm, footer 8pt Mono.</p></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card" style="padding:0;overflow:hidden">
        <div style="background:var(--ink);aspect-ratio:210/297;padding:20px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 25px,rgba(255,255,255,.028) 25px 26px)">
          <div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="font-size:18px">arth</span></div>
          <div><p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;line-height:1.25">What each enquiry actually cost</p>
            <p class="tiny" style="margin:0;color:#9FB6BD">A field guide for dealer principals</p></div>
          <p class="tiny mono" style="margin:0;color:#7FA0A9;font-size:7px">ARTH · 2026</p>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:12px"><p class="tiny" style="margin:0"><strong>Cover</strong> — Ink with the ledger field at 4.5% opacity.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="grid g4" style="margin-top:20px">
      <div class="card"><h4>Signage</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Brushed brass or powder-coated Ink letters, no backlighting, no acrylic box. Minimum 90mm cap height. The rule is a separate machined bar, not printed.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Exhibition</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">One Ink wall, one number, one line. No product screenshots on a backdrop — nobody reads a UI from four metres.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>ID and lanyard</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Ink card, monogram top-left, name in Anek 600, role in 10pt. Photograph optional. Plain woven lanyard, no print.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Invoices and contracts</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Letterhead grid, all figures in Mono with tabular numerals, totals in 700 weight. The stamp element is permitted on paid invoices.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 15 EMAIL -->
<section id="s15">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">15</span><h2>Email and WhatsApp</h2>
      <p class="lede" style="margin-top:12px">Most people will meet Arth's voice in a notification, not in the product. These are read on a phone, in a corridor, in ten seconds.</p></div>
    <div class="grid g23">
      <div class="demo">
        <p class="tiny" style="margin:0 0 10px;font-family:var(--data)">TRANSACTIONAL EMAIL — 600px</p>
        <div style="border:1px solid var(--n10);border-radius:var(--r-md);overflow:hidden;max-width:420px">
          <div style="background:var(--ink);padding:16px 20px"><div class="mark" style="color:var(--brass)"><span style="font-size:16px">arth</span></div></div>
          <div style="padding:20px;background:var(--n00)">
            <div style="width:40px;height:2px;background:var(--brass);margin-bottom:12px"></div>
            <p style="font-family:var(--display);font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin:0 0 10px">7 bookings are past their promised delivery date</p>
            <p style="font-size:13.5px;color:var(--n80);margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.55">Five are waiting on the RTO desk and two on finance disbursement. Together they represent ₹4,20,000 of delivery value.</p>
            <p style="font-size:13.5px;color:var(--n80);margin:0 0 16px;line-height:1.55">The oldest has been open for 19 days.</p>
            <a href="#" class="btn btn--sm">Open the queue</a>
            <p class="tiny" style="margin:16px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--n10)">Sent because you are the dealer principal for Nagarbhavi Group. Change what you receive in Settings.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px"><h4>Email rules</h4>
          <ul class="tight">
            <li>Subject lines are the finding, not a label. "7 bookings past promised delivery" — not "Your daily Arth summary".</li>
            <li>One idea, one action, one button. Never two competing links.</li>
            <li>Always say why the person received it and how to change it.</li>
            <li>Plain-text fallback for every send. Many dealer inboxes strip images.</li>
            <li>Never a marketing email from a product address.</li>
          </ul></div>
        <div class="card"><h4>WhatsApp templates</h4>
          <p class="small">Meta requires approved templates, which suits the voice — short, factual, no ornament. Utility templates for status, and they are also roughly seven times cheaper than marketing templates, which is a design constraint worth honouring.</p>
          <div style="background:var(--settled-wash);border-radius:6px 6px 6px 2px;padding:12px 14px;max-width:300px;margin-top:12px">
            <p style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--n90);line-height:1.5">Your Grand Vitara is at the RTO for registration.</p>
            <p style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--n90);line-height:1.5">Finance approved · Insurance issued · Registration in progress</p>
            <p style="font-size:13.5px;margin:0;color:var(--n90);line-height:1.5">Expected delivery: 18 August.</p>
            <p style="font-family:var(--data);font-size:10px;color:var(--n60);margin:8px 0 0">Track: arth.link/d/8K2M</p>
          </div>
          <p class="tiny" style="margin:12px 0 0">No emoji, no exclamation marks, no "Dear valued customer". The dealership's name appears, not ours — Arth is the rail, not the sender.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 16 PRESENTATIONS -->
<section id="s16">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">16</span><h2>Presentations</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g4">
      <div class="card"><h4>Structure</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Ink for openers, section breaks and closers. Light for everything else. A dark slide signals "a new argument starts here" and loses that meaning if overused.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>One idea per slide</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">The heading is the claim, and the slide is its evidence. If the heading is a noun ("Architecture") rather than a claim, the slide is not finished.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Never</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">No bullet lists longer than six. No clip art, no stock photography, no slide transitions, no logos of clients.</p></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>Fallback fonts</h4><p class="tiny" style="margin:0">Anek and Plex may not be installed on a client machine. Decks that leave the building are exported to PDF, always.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 17 PHOTOGRAPHY -->
<section id="s17">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">17</span><h2>Photography</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g2">
      <div class="card"><h4>What we photograph</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li>The service reception at 8am, when it is genuinely busy.</li>
          <li>A telecalling floor mid-shift — headsets, screens, a whiteboard.</li>
          <li>Hands: a job card, a set of keys, a challan, a keyboard.</li>
          <li>A delivery, with the family, with written consent.</li>
          <li>The RTO desk and its paperwork. Nobody photographs this, and it is where the product's best story lives.</li>
        </ul></div>
      <div class="card"><h4>How</h4>
        <ul class="tight">
          <li>Available light. Slightly desaturated. Never HDR, never a filter, never flare.</li>
          <li>Documentary distance — we observe, we do not stage.</li>
          <li>Faces only with written consent, and never a customer's face without it.</li>
          <li>No handshakes, no laughing teams around a laptop, no gleaming empty showroom.</li>
          <li><strong>If no honest photograph exists, use an Ink panel and a number.</strong> That is always better than stock.</li>
        </ul></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 18 ASSETS -->
<section id="s18">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="sec-head sr"><span class="num">18</span><h2>Asset management</h2></div>
    <div class="grid g23">
      <div class="card"><h4>Naming</h4>
        <pre style="margin:10px 0 0">arth_[type]_[variant]_[colour]_[size].[ext]

arth_logo_wordmark_ink_full.svg
arth_logo_wordmark_white_full.svg
arth_logo_monogram_ink_512.png
arth_icon_jobcard_24.svg
arth_social_number_1080x1080_v2.png
arth_print_card_88x55_cmyk.pdf</pre>

for every colour value. This document's colour tables are generated from it.

## PART 0 — How to use this book

This is the single source of truth for the Arth brand. It replaces Brand Guide Volume 1 and Volume 2, which are withdrawn on publication of this document.

## What this book is

Arth is the enquiry accountability platform for automobile dealer groups. This book governs how it looks, how it speaks, how it is built and how it is sold. If a decision about appearance, wording or naming is contested, the answer is here. If it is not here, it goes to Brand before it ships.

Every rule in this book exists because of a decision that was already made. Nothing is aspirational. Where a rule does not yet exist, it appears in the Deferred Register in Part 9 with the reason and the trigger for writing it — so that an absence is visibly a decision rather than an oversight.

## Who reads what

Nobody reads this cover to cover except Brand. Find your row.

| Team                                 | Read in full                                                                                | Reference when needed                                                                                                                                     |
|--------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Engineering / IT**                 | Part 3 Identity · Part 5 Interface · Part 6 Tenancy · Part 9 Operations                     | Part 4 for all UI copy and AI output rules. Part 2 for naming anything in code. Tokens in 9.1 are the only permitted source of colour and spacing values. |
| **Social media**                     | Part 4 Language · Part 7.1 Social · Part 7.5 Photography                                    | Part 3 for the mark, colour and type. Part 8 for what may and may not be claimed, and for client naming rules.                                            |
| **Creative / design**                | Part 3 Identity · Part 5 Interface · Part 7 Communications                                  | Part 1 for why the system is shaped this way. Part 2 before naming or lockup work. Part 6 for partner and tenant lockups.                                 |
| **Production (print, video, photo)** | Part 7.3 Print · Part 7.4 Video · Part 7.5 Photography · Part 9.2 Assets                    | Part 3.2 for colour, including CMYK and Pantone conversions. Part 8 for consent and usage rights.                                                         |
| **Sales**                            | Part 1 Foundation · Part 4.1 Voice · Part 7.6 Sales collateral                              | Part 2 for tier names. Part 8 for claims and boilerplate.                                                                                                 |
| **Everyone**                         | Part 1.4 The five principles. They decide arguments. Read them once and remember the order. |                                                                                                                                                           |

## Decision rights

| Area                                                                 | Owner                                                  | Escalation      |
|----------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| Identity, voice, naming, brand architecture, external communications | Brand                                                  | CEO             |
| Interface application, tokens in code, component behaviour           | Product Engineering, governed by this book             | Brand, then CEO |
| Tenant configuration limits                                          | Brand sets the fence · Engineering enforces it in code | CEO             |
| Legal wording, trademark, consent copy                               | Brand + external counsel                               | CEO             |

A visual change that contradicts this book requires the same written sign-off as a database schema change. That is not a metaphor — it is the process.


#### Relationship to `VISUAL-DIRECTION.md`

This book governs appearance, wording and naming. `docs/design/VISUAL-DIRECTION.md` is subordinate to it and is reduced to the product-specific rules this book does not cover. **Where the two disagree, this book wins.** Adopted by Decision Memo 10, 10 August 2026.


## A test for every rule in this book


#### A safeguard whose safe path does not exist is not a safeguard. It is a pressure.

Before a rule forbids something, check that the permitted alternative it points to actually exists. A rule that says *do not do X, do Y instead* where Y has not been built does not prevent X — it makes X the only available action while declaring it wrong, which trains people to work around the book.


This was found in this book rather than reasoned about in advance. 4.4 forbids Arth from generating a reason a customer did not buy *unless a human recorded it*, and no field existed for a human to record one. The rule was not protecting anything; it was creating pressure to infer what it forbade inferring. See 4.3.

**Applies to every rule written from here.** When a rule names an alternative, the alternative is either shipped, or the dependency is recorded beside the rule as 4.3 now records its own.

**The test asks two things, not one.** Does the alternative exist — and can the person bound by the rule reach it? A rule pointing at an artefact that exists but has not been delivered fails in the same way as one pointing at an artefact never built. The reader cannot act either way, and the difference is invisible from where they sit. **Existence is the author's answer; reachability is the reader's, and the reader's is the one that governs.**


**The test caught its author on first use.** The triggered review written into 4.3 in the same revision as this test points at a query that does not exist — nothing counts recurring text or raises anything. Brand had replaced a review nobody performs with a review nothing raises, which is the quieter failure and therefore the worse one. The dependency is now recorded at 4.3. Noted here because a test that only ever catches other people is not being applied.


## Proposing a change

Open a pull request against the brand repository. State the rule being changed, the reason, and which of the five principles supports it. Token changes are reviewed like schema changes. Reviewed quarterly alongside the external requirements review: colour and type do not change; applications and examples are added as the product grows.

## When to stop revising

This book was revised nine times in two days. Every revision closed something real, and the sequence still had to be stopped — because the returns had moved into the book's own machinery, and because a book that runs far ahead of the product starts documenting decisions about things nobody has built. **That is the aspirational writing Part 0 forbids, arriving by a route nobody watches.**

**The rule: a revision should arise from something built, not from something written.** A screen rendered, a rule meeting the person it governs, an instrument catching something in production. A revision whose only source is the previous revision is a signal to stop.

Reviewed quarterly regardless, per the cadence below.

## Version

THE ARTH BRAND SYSTEM · VERSION 2.9 · AUGUST 2026 · ADVITO GLOBAL · INTERNAL
Supersedes Brand Guide Vol 1 (v1.1), Vol 2 (v1.0) and this book at v2.0 through v2.8. Three contrast corrections previously carried as errata are absorbed into the body. Change history is in Part 9.4; decisions considered and rejected are in Part 9.6.


## PART 1 — Foundation

### 1.1  The name is the strategy


अर्थ — artha

One of the four Puruṣārthas of Sanātana Dharma. The pillar concerned with material prosperity and the means of livelihood, earned by legitimate means.


The word carries two senses at once: **meaning**, and **wealth**. A dealership's enquiry data has always had both and delivered neither — thousands of records that mean nothing and produce no traceable money.

This is not decoration on top of a software product. It is the product's thesis, and it governs every design decision in this book. Arth exists to give a dealer's numbers meaning, and to trace them to wealth.

#### What follows from the name

| Principle                 | Consequence                                                                                            |
|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Legitimacy matters**    | Artha is wealth earned properly. Arth records who did the work, honestly, and will not flatter anyone. |
| **Purpose over activity** | Forty calls is activity. One delivered car is artha.                                                   |
| **Permanence**            | A record that can be quietly rewritten has no meaning. Nothing in Arth is silently edited.             |

### 1.2  Vision, mission, position

|              |                                                                                                                                                                |
|--------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
